english: Petrinja lies near the Kupa River in central Croatia. Its medieval inhabitants received privileges from Duke Koloman in 1240. The old fortress was abandoned and destroyed in 1543 to prevent its capture by Ottoman forces. In 1592 the Ottomans built a new fortress at the confluence of the Petrinjčica and Kupa, establishing the site of the later town. Croatian forces took the fortress in 1594, and craftsmen and merchants subsequently settled around it. In 1773 Maria Theresa designated Petrinja a craft guild centre for the Military Frontier. From 1809 to 1813 it formed part of the French-administered Illyrian Provinces, a period during which it served as a trading and transport centre.
simp_chinese: 彼得里尼亚位于克罗地亚中部库帕河附近。1240年，公爵科洛曼授予当地居民特权。为防止奥斯曼军队占领，旧堡于1543年被弃守并毁坏。1592年，奥斯曼人在彼得林奇察河与库帕河汇合处修建新堡，形成后来城镇的所在地。克罗地亚军队于1594年夺取堡垒，随后工匠和商人逐渐在周围定居。1773年，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚将彼得里尼亚定为军事边疆的手工业行会中心。1809年至1813年，它属于法国管理的伊利里亚诸省，并成为贸易和交通中心。

english:
Petrovaradin occupies a rocky height on the right bank of the Danube. The site has held fortifications since Roman times, and in the thirteenth century King Béla IV endowed a Cistercian abbey here. Its commanding position later made it a stronghold on the frontier between the Habsburg and Ottoman empires, protected by an extensive system of bastions and underground passages.

The Ottomans captured Petrovaradin in 1526. After the Habsburgs established control in the late seventeenth century, they began a vast new fortress, laying its foundation stone in 1692. Work continued for much of the eighteenth century, creating upper and lower fortifications and a bridgehead across the river. In 1716, while construction was still underway, Prince Eugene of Savoy defeated an Ottoman army near the fortress. The completed defences stood among the monarchy's great strongholds on the Danube.
simp_chinese:
彼得罗瓦拉丁占据多瑙河右岸一处岩石高地。自罗马时代起，这里便有防御工事；十三世纪，国王贝拉四世在此捐建了一座熙笃会修道院。险要的地势后来使它成为哈布斯堡与奥斯曼帝国边境上的重要据点，棱堡和地下通道构成了庞大的防御体系。

奥斯曼人于1526年攻占彼得罗瓦拉丁。十七世纪末哈布斯堡人建立统治后，开始营建一座规模宏大的新堡垒，于1692年奠基。工程持续了十八世纪的大部分时间，建成上下两层防御工事和河对岸的桥头堡。1716年，堡垒尚未完工，萨伏依的欧根亲王便在附近击败奥斯曼军队。建成后的防御设施成为哈布斯堡王朝在多瑙河上的重要要塞之一。

english:
Petrove lies in the northern Black Sea steppe. Across the wider steppe, river valleys provided resources and routes between dispersed settlements and grazing grounds.

During the early modern period, the wider steppe was part of the world of the Zaporizhian Cossacks and their relations with the Crimean Khanate, the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth and Muscovy. Raids, diplomacy and trade crossed unstable boundaries. Eighteenth-century Russian expansion brought military administration and new agricultural settlements; the suppression of the Zaporizhian Sich marked a major political change.
simp_chinese:
彼得罗韦位于黑海北部草原。更广阔的草原地区中，河谷提供水源与资源，也连接分散聚落和牧地。

近代早期，更广阔的草原是扎波罗热哥萨克活动的地区，他们与克里米亚汗国、波兰立陶宛联邦和莫斯科之间存在复杂关系。劫掠、外交与贸易跨越不稳定的边界。十八世纪俄罗斯扩张带来军事管理和新的农业聚落，扎波罗热塞契遭撤除也是重要政治变化。

english:
Petrovsk stands on the Medveditsa, on the route between Saratov and Penza. Founded by decree of Peter I in 1698, it was a fortress intended to protect the region from Crimean Tatar raids and the disorder that threatened travellers on the road. Its square enclosure had double oak walls and eight roofed towers. Outlying settlements and watch posts helped guard the roads through the surrounding river country.

The fortress formed the centre of a line that stretched between settlements on the Atkara, Serdoba and Volga. Cossack guards and ploughing soldiers settled nearby, protecting both the roads and forests reserved for shipbuilding. As Russian settlement advanced beyond the old frontier, Petrovsk continued as a district town. The fortress itself was abolished in 1782, but the town remained a centre for the communities along the Medveditsa.
simp_chinese:
彼得罗夫斯克位于梅德韦季察河畔，坐落在萨拉托夫与奔萨之间的道路上。它于1698年奉彼得一世之命建立为堡垒，旨在保护当地免受克里米亚鞑靼人的袭击，并防范威胁过路行人的骚乱。堡垒呈方形，围有双层橡木墙和八座带顶的塔楼。外围聚落与哨所共同守卫周围河谷的道路。

这座堡垒是连接阿特卡拉河、谢尔多巴河与伏尔加河沿线聚落的一条防线中心。哥萨克守卫和耕兵在附近定居，保护道路及保留供造船使用的森林。随着俄罗斯人的定居地越过旧边疆继续向外扩展，彼得罗夫斯克仍作为县城延续下来。堡垒于1782年撤销，但城镇依然是梅德韦季察河沿岸居民的地方中心。

english: Petrovsk lies beside the Sara River southwest of Rostov, on the route towards Pereyaslavl. The village of Petrovskoye is recorded as early as 1207, in the old Rostov country of forests, rivers and cultivated land. In 1777 it was raised to town status as Petrovsk and made the centre of its own district. That district was abolished in 1796, leaving Petrovsk a town within the Rostov district, but the old village remained a place on the road between the two historic centres.
simp_chinese: 彼得罗夫斯克位于罗斯托夫西南的萨拉河畔，坐落在通往佩列亚斯拉夫尔的道路上。彼得罗夫斯科耶村早在1207年便见于记载，属于森林、河流和农田交错的古老罗斯托夫地区。1777年，村庄升为彼得罗夫斯克城镇，成为一县的中心。1796年该县被撤销，彼得罗夫斯克转为罗斯托夫县内的城镇，但这座古村仍处在两座历史中心之间的道路上。

english: Petrovskoye stands on the Kalaus among the hills of the northern Caucasian foreland. Founded in the second half of the eighteenth century, it grew near an existing Tatar settlement. Local tradition links the village's name to an early settler, Petro Pisarenko, who came from the Zaporizhian country. By 1789 Petrovskoye was recorded as a village in the Alexandrov district. Its position on the river placed it among the communities forming as Russian settlement expanded across the steppe.
simp_chinese: 彼得罗夫斯科耶位于高加索北部前陆的丘陵间，坐落在卡劳斯河畔。村庄建于十八世纪下半叶，在已有的鞑靼聚落附近发展。地方传统将村名与早期定居者彼得罗·皮萨连科联系起来，他来自扎波罗热地区。到1789年，彼得罗夫斯科耶已作为亚历山德罗夫地区的村庄见于记载。它位于河畔，是俄罗斯定居活动向草原扩展时形成的社区之一。

english: Pétursvík belonged to the Norse Eastern Settlement in southern Greenland, in the fjord country near a lake and a broad valley. The medieval account of Ívar Bárðarson describes a church at Pétursvík holding the neighboring settlement of Vatnsdalr. A large convent dedicated to Saint Olaf and Saint Augustine lay farther up the fjord. Farms and religious estates occupied the sheltered land between ice, mountains and sea, combining livestock with the resources of the surrounding waters.
simp_chinese: 佩图尔斯维克属于格陵兰南部的北欧东部聚落，位于湖泊与宽阔谷地附近的峡湾地区。伊瓦尔·巴尔达松的中世纪记述称，佩图尔斯维克教堂拥有邻近的瓦特恩斯达尔聚落。一座献给圣奥拉夫和圣奥古斯丁的大修道院位于峡湾更深处。农场与宗教地产占据冰雪、山岭和海洋之间较受庇护的土地，居民饲养牲畜，也利用周围水域的资源。

english: Peureulak, or Perlak, lay on the northeastern coast of Sumatra, where merchants sailing the Malacca Strait encountered communities of the island's interior. Marco Polo described Ferlec at the end of the thirteenth century as a place visited by Muslim traders, with inhabitants who had adopted Islam. Later Javanese sources named Parllak among the places connected to Majapahit. Local traditions preserve memories of an early Muslim kingdom here, though its beginnings remain debated.
simp_chinese: 佩鲁拉克又称珀拉克，位于苏门答腊东北岸，航行于马六甲海峡的商人在这里与岛屿内陆社群相遇。十三世纪末，马可·波罗描述斐烈克是穆斯林商人常到访之地，部分居民已信奉伊斯兰教。后来的爪哇文献将帕尔拉克列为与满者伯夷有关的地方。当地传统保存了早期穆斯林王国的记忆，但其起源仍有争议。

english: Pew'jeg lies in the wooded hills between Gaspé Bay and Percé on the Gaspé Peninsula. In 1534 Jacques Cartier entered Gaspé Bay, where he encountered Mi'kmaq people who had come to fish. To the south, the great limestone mass of Percé Rock rises from the waters off the coast.
simp_chinese: 佩维格位于加斯佩半岛的林木丘陵，介于加斯佩湾与佩尔塞之间。1534年，雅克·卡蒂埃驶入加斯佩湾，在那里遇到前来捕鱼的米克马克人。南面的近海中，庞大的石灰岩体佩尔塞岩从水面耸起。

english: The rock of Peyre rises above the Gévaudan, once crowned by the castle of a powerful baronial family. The barony's seat stood near Saint-Sauveur-de-Peyre, with its keep on the rocky height. During the Wars of Religion the fortress became a target for the army of the Duke of Joyeuse, which took it in 1586 after a difficult siege. Its ruins recall the strength of the mountain lordship and the violence of the conflict.
simp_chinese: 佩尔岩峰耸立在热沃当高地之上，山顶曾有一个强大男爵家族的城堡。男爵领治所位于圣索沃尔德佩尔附近，主塔建在岩石高处。宗教战争期间，堡垒成为茹瓦耶兹公爵军队的目标，经过艰难围攻后于1586年被攻取。残垣令人想起这个山区领地的力量，以及那场冲突的惨烈。

english:
Peyrusse-le-Roc was a fortified settlement in Rouergue, southern France. It served as the seat of a large bailiwick and benefited from silver-bearing mines, fairs and markets. Medieval communities lived within overlapping jurisdictions of royal officers, nobles, and religious institutions, while the surrounding valleys and uplands supplied agricultural produce and livestock.

During the Hundred Years' War, Rouergue was affected by the rivalry between the French and English crowns, as well as by the activities of armed companies. Fortifications and local privileges could help communities negotiate security, although warfare disrupted cultivation and trade. The early modern centuries brought further religious and political strains, particularly during the French Wars of Religion. Over time, stronger royal administration altered the balance between local liberties and central authority. The Revolution later dismantled older corporate and seigneurial structures. Peyrusse's regional history thus reflects the changing role of a fortified rural settlement within a countryside shaped by agricultural production, commercial connections, and the demands of competing powers.
simp_chinese:
佩吕斯勒罗克是法国南部鲁埃格的一处设防聚落，曾为范围广大的司法辖区中心，并从含银矿、集市和定期交易中获益。中世纪居民生活在王室官员、贵族及宗教机构相互交叠的管辖关系中；周围山谷与高地则提供农产品和牲畜。

百年战争期间，鲁埃格受到法国和英国王权竞争的影响，也遭到武装团伙活动的冲击。城防与地方特权有时帮助社群争取安全，但战争仍破坏耕作和贸易。近代早期又出现宗教与政治紧张，法国宗教战争尤其带来压力。随着王室行政加强，地方自由和中央权力之间的平衡逐渐改变。法国大革命后来拆除了旧有等级、领主权与团体制度。因此，理解佩吕斯可以着眼于设防乡村聚落作用的变化：农业生产和商业联系支撑其日常生活，不同政治力量提出的财政、军事与行政要求则不断改变居民处境。

english: Pfaffenhofen lies on the Ilm in the Bavarian countryside. Its oldest surviving seal dates from 1333, but the town suffered destruction in the War of the Cities in 1388, when its church and castle were also laid waste. Centuries later, during the War of the Austrian Succession, armies met here again. On 15 April 1745 Austrian forces under Karl Josef Batthyány defeated the French under General Ségur, bringing the fighting in Bavaria to an end.
simp_chinese: 普法芬霍芬位于巴伐利亚乡间的伊尔姆河畔。城镇留存的最早印章可追溯至1333年，但1388年城市战争期间，城镇连同教堂和城堡遭到毁坏。几个世纪后，奥地利王位继承战争的军队再次在此交战。1745年四月十五日，卡尔·约瑟夫·巴特亚尼率领的奥地利军队击败塞居尔将军的法国军队，结束了巴伐利亚的战事。

english: Pgotapesg lies among the lakes of central Newfoundland, close to the lake once called Red Indian Lake. The Exploits River flows east from the lake towards Notre Dame Bay. In 1819 settlers captured the Beothuk woman Demasduit on its shore; her husband Nonosabasut was killed trying to secure her release.
simp_chinese: 普戈塔佩斯格位于纽芬兰中部的湖泊之间，靠近曾被称为红印第安湖的湖泊。埃克斯普洛伊茨河从湖中向东流往圣母湾。1819年，殖民者在湖岸俘获贝奥图克女子德马斯杜伊特；她的丈夫诺诺萨巴苏特试图救她时遭到杀害。

english: Phakant lies on the Uru River in the jade-bearing hills of northern Burma. The surrounding deposits yield jadeite, a stone prized for its colour and toughness. The nearby town of Mogaung became an important centre for the trade, linking the mines to markets beyond the mountains. Under the Konbaung kings, jade formed part of the region's commerce and brought revenue to the Burmese crown.
simp_chinese: 帕敢坐落在缅甸北部玉石山区的乌茹河畔。附近矿床出产硬玉，其色泽和坚韧质地深受珍视。邻近的孟拱成为重要的玉石交易中心，将矿区与山外市场联系起来。贡榜王朝时期，玉石已是当地贸易的一部分，并为缅甸王室带来收入。

english: Phakphok lies in the eastern hills of Nepal, in the country known as Limbuwan or Yakthung Laaje, the land of the Limbu-speaking people. Tradition names Phakphok as the seat of Mung Tai Chi Emay Hang, a ruler of Ilam, among the local kingdoms of Limbuwan. After fighting between Limbu rulers and the expanding Gorkha kingdom, an agreement in 1774 brought Limbuwan into the kingdom of Nepal.
simp_chinese: 法克福克位于尼泊尔东部丘陵，属于称为林布万或亚克吞拉杰的地区，意为林布语居民的土地。传统称，伊拉姆统治者蒙泰奇·埃迈杭以法克福克为驻地，他是林布万地方诸王之一。林布统治者与不断扩张的廓尔喀王国交战后，1774年的协定使林布万并入尼泊尔王国。

english:
Phalaborwa is a country of copper and iron, worked by miners and smiths for many centuries. At Lolwe, or Loolekop, ore was dug from the hill, while smelting took place both near the mines and at settlements such as Shankare and Putwana. Iron and copper required different furnaces and methods, leaving traces of skilled work across the landscape.

Between the sixteenth and nineteenth centuries, metal production continued at mines and homesteads across the district. Iron slag accumulated in great heaps at the site known as Square, while metal goods circulated through local and wider trading networks, reaching the Indian Ocean coast through intermediaries. In 1725 François de Cuiper sought the mountain of copper and iron, evidence that its reputation had reached people far beyond Phalaborwa.
simp_chinese:
法拉博瓦盛产铜与铁，矿工和铁匠在这里劳作了许多世纪。人们在洛卢韦，即洛勒科普山开采矿石，并在矿山附近及尚卡雷、普特瓦纳等聚落冶炼。铁和铜使用不同的炉子与方法，熟练劳动的痕迹散布在各处。

16世纪至19世纪，地区各处的矿山和宅院继续生产金属。名为斯夸尔的遗址堆积了大量炼铁炉渣，金属制品则在地方及更广的贸易网络中流通，经由中间人抵达印度洋海岸。1725年，弗朗索瓦·德屈佩尔曾寻找这座铜铁之山，显示其名声已传至法拉博瓦之外。

english: Phalvardhika, later known as Phalodi, lies on the edge of the Thar Desert between Jodhpur and Jaisalmer. The settlement is associated with a fifteenth-century foundation and grew around a fort in the dry Marwar country. Its position on routes across western Rajasthan connected it with desert trade, while local wells supported habitation in a region of sparse rainfall. The older name survives in accounts of the town’s beginnings.
simp_chinese: 帕尔瓦尔迪卡后来称帕洛迪，位于焦特布尔与杰伊瑟尔梅尔之间的塔尔沙漠边缘。聚落的创建与十五世纪有关，并围绕干燥马尔瓦尔地区的一座堡垒发展。它处在穿越拉贾斯坦西部的道路上，与沙漠贸易相连；在降雨稀少的地区，水井维持着居民生活。较早的地名保存在有关城镇起源的记载中。

english: Phan Thiết Bay lies on the south-central coast of Vietnam, between the headlands of Mũi Né and Kê Gà. Sandy shores and dunes line the coast, while shallow banks extend into the sea in parts of the bay. Rivers reach the shore at Phan Thiết and Phú Hải, breaking through the coastal strip. The headlands and hills behind them offer prominent landmarks to ships following the Vietnamese coast.
simp_chinese: 潘切湾位于越南中南部海岸，介于美奈角和鸡屿角两处岬角之间。沙岸与沙丘沿着海湾伸展，部分浅滩从岸边延伸到海中。河流在潘切和富海穿过狭窄的滨海地带，注入湾内。两处岬角及其后方的丘陵轮廓清晰，为沿越南海岸航行的船只提供了醒目的地标。

english:
Phanat lies in the lowlands east of the Gulf of Siam, in a region of old settlements and waterways. Nearby stood the ancient town of Phra Rot, a centre of the Dvaravati period. Buddhist objects found in the area include an image carved from dark stone, a reminder of the religious art that flourished among the towns of the eastern plain. Earthworks and other remains preserve traces of communities that lived here long before the later Siamese kingdom arose.

The later city of Chonburi lies here.
simp_chinese:
帕纳位于暹罗湾以东的低地，周围分布着古老聚落与水道。附近曾有堕罗钵底时期的城邑帕罗。当地发现的佛教器物包括一尊以深色石材雕刻的佛像，显示东部平原诸城曾兴盛的宗教艺术。土垣和其他遗存保留了更早时期居民的痕迹，他们在后来的暹罗王国兴起前便已生活于此。

后来的春武里即位于此地。

english: Phander lies in a high valley on the route from Gilgit towards the Shandur Pass and Chitral. Here the Gilgit River divides into several channels as it enters the valley, joining again beyond it. Four lakes lie among the surrounding mountains, the largest bearing the name of Phander. The river and the pass give the valley a place along a route through the rugged country between Gilgit and Chitral.
simp_chinese: 潘德尔位于一处高山河谷，从吉尔吉特出发，经过尚杜尔山口可通往吉德拉尔。吉尔吉特河进入河谷时分成数条水道，离开后又重新汇合。群山之间有四座湖泊，最大的一座以潘德尔命名。河流和山口使这片谷地成为吉尔吉特与吉德拉尔之间崎岖山路的一部分。

english: Phang Nga Bay lies on the Andaman coast of the Malay Peninsula. Steep limestone islands rise from its sheltered waters, their cliffs shaped by the slow wearing away of rock. Mangrove forests, estuaries and tidal mudflats line the bay’s low shores, while seagrass grows in shallow water. The islands and waterways form a striking landscape between the mainland and the larger island of Phuket to the southwest.
simp_chinese: 攀牙湾位于马来半岛的安达曼海岸。陡峭的石灰岩岛屿从避风水面升起，岩石长期受侵蚀，形成悬崖峭壁。红树林、河口和潮间泥滩沿海湾低岸分布，浅水中生长着海草。群岛与水道在大陆和西南方的普吉大岛之间构成独特的海上景观。

english: Phąkéska Wakpá is a Lakota name for the Platte River, whose broad and shallow channels flow eastward across the Great Plains. The river gathers water from the mountains through its North and South forks and spreads across a sandy bed in Nebraska. Its valley offered a passage between the high plains and the Missouri, crossing a landscape used by many Indigenous peoples for hunting, travel and trade.
simp_chinese: 潘克斯卡瓦克帕是普拉特河的拉科塔语名称。这条河以宽阔浅水的河道向东流过大平原，南北两支汇集山地水流，在内布拉斯加的沙质河床上展开。河谷是高平原与密苏里河之间的通道，穿越许多原住民族用于狩猎、旅行和贸易的地区。

english:
Phanom Rung rises above the southern Khorat plain on the summit of an extinct volcano. Its Khmer sanctuary, built principally of pink sandstone, was dedicated to Shiva and conceived as an earthly image of his mountain home. A long processional way, serpent bridges and stairways lead to the central tower, whose carved pediments and lintels depict Hindu gods and episodes from the great epics.

The sanctuary took shape over several centuries. Its earliest brick foundations date to the tenth century, while the main tower was built in the twelfth by Narendraditya, a relative of King Suryavarman II. Later additions included two library buildings. Reservoirs and channels collected water from the volcanic heights for the communities and rice fields on the plain below, linking the sacred mountain with its surrounding settlements.
simp_chinese:
攀侬蓝耸立在呵叻平原南部一座死火山的山顶。高棉神庙主要以粉红色砂岩建造，供奉湿婆，被构想为神山在人间的形象。漫长的参道、蛇桥与阶梯通向中央塔殿，山花和门楣上雕刻着印度教神祇与史诗故事。

神庙历经数世纪逐步建成。最早的砖建筑基址可追溯至十世纪，主塔则由苏利耶跋摩二世的亲属那连陀罗底耶于十二世纪建造。后来的增建包括两座藏经楼。蓄水池与水道收集火山高地的水，供给山下平原的聚落和稻田，将圣山与周围居民联系起来。

english:
Phari stands high at the head of the Chumbi Valley, beneath the mountain routes linking Tibet with Bhutan and Sikkim. Its dzong guarded a settlement on the road toward Gyantse and Lhasa, while the route over Tremo La connected it with Paro. The cold heights limited cultivation, and travellers relied on animals and provisions brought across the passes.

Tibetan accounts associate Phari’s early fortress and markets with the Sakya governor Phakpa Balzang in the fourteenth century. Later the town remained a staging place on the road between Bhutan and central Tibet. Envoys George Bogle and Samuel Turner crossed the Bhutanese pass on their journeys to Tibet in the eighteenth century, and Thomas Manning passed through Phari in 1811. Merchants and travellers shared the difficult road between the high plateau and the valleys to the south.
simp_chinese:
帕里位于春丕河谷的高处，靠近连接西藏、不丹和锡金的山路。宗堡守卫着这处通往江孜和拉萨道路上的聚落，穿过德莫拉山口的道路则通向帕罗。高寒限制了耕种，旅人依赖牲畜和从山口另一侧运来的补给。

藏文记载将帕里早期的堡垒和市场与十四世纪萨迦派官员帕巴贝桑联系在一起。此后，这座城镇仍是不丹与藏中之间道路上的歇脚地。十八世纪，使者乔治·博格尔和塞缪尔·特纳前往西藏时经过不丹山口；托马斯·曼宁也于1811年途经帕里。商人与旅人共同走过连接高原和南方山谷的艰难道路。

sources.title: 1919 Trip into Chumbi Valley Tibet by Buchanan from GJv53 s.pdf

english:
Phayao stands on the shore of Phayao Lake in the northern Thai basin country. It developed as a semi-independent mueang, or principality, among other centres of the northern uplands. Rice fields, waterways and surrounding hills connected the town with rural communities and neighbouring valleys; temples and their patrons also shaped local life.

Phayao's political traditions later became connected with the northern kingdom of Lanna. During the early modern period, Burmese influence and repeated warfare changed the balance of power across northern Thailand. Population movements and demands for labour and supplies could disrupt settlements. Later relationships between northern rulers and Bangkok added another political framework, while communities continued to cultivate the basin and maintain temples.
simp_chinese:
帕尧位于泰国北部盆地的帕尧湖畔，曾作为半独立的孟，即地方政体，在北方诸中心之间发展。稻田、水道和周围丘陵将城镇与乡村及邻近河谷相连，寺庙和施主也影响着地方生活。

帕尧的政治传统后来与兰纳王国相连。近代早期，缅甸势力和反复战争改变泰北的权力格局，人口迁移以及对劳力和补给的需求也可能扰乱聚落。此后北方统治者与曼谷的关系又带来新的政治框架，居民则继续在盆地中耕作和维系寺庙。

english: Phayuha Khiri lies on the upper central plain south of Nakhon Sawan, where scattered hills rise above the Chao Phraya river country. The area contains traces of ancient settlement dating to the Dvaravati period, when communities occupied the waterways of central Thailand. Buddhist monuments and older remains testify to a long history of habitation in the region. The river flows south from the junction of the northern rivers towards the towns and fields of the lower plain.
simp_chinese: 帕育哈吉里位于那空沙旺以南的中部平原北端，零散的丘陵高出湄南河沿岸地带。这里保有堕罗钵底时期的古代定居痕迹，当时泰国中部水道沿岸已有许多社区。佛教建筑和更早的遗存见证了这片地区悠久的居住历史。河水从北方诸河的汇合处向南流去，通往下游平原的城邑与田野。

english: Phelps Lake is a shallow oval lake amid the wetlands of the Carolina coastal plain. Indigenous people made and used dugout canoes along its northern and western shores over many centuries. Some of these craft remained buried in the lake bed, preserved by acidic water and sediment; the largest found measures thirty-seven feet. Their ages span thousands of years, with the most recent dated to around 1400.
simp_chinese: 费尔普斯湖是一座浅而椭圆的湖泊，坐落在卡罗来纳海岸平原的湿地之中。许多个世纪以来，原住民在湖泊北岸和西岸制作、使用独木舟。一些船只埋藏在湖底，因酸性湖水与沉积物而保存下来；发现的最大一艘长达三十七英尺。这些船只跨越数千年，年代最近的一艘约为1400年。

english: The Phetchabun Mountains form part of the western rim of the Khorat Plateau. Their ridges rise between the plateau and the valleys of central Siam, separating the Chi and Mun drainage from rivers flowing toward the Chao Phraya. Forested slopes and steep passes make a natural barrier, while streams descend from the high ground to feed the plains on either side.
simp_chinese: 碧差汶山脉构成呵叻高原西缘的一部分。山脊耸立在高原与暹罗中部河谷之间，将奇河、蒙河流域与流向湄南河的水系分隔开来。森林覆盖的山坡和险峻山口形成天然屏障，溪流则从高地流下，滋养两侧平原。

sources.title: 02ทะเบียนรายนามพื้นที่ชุ่มน้ำEng-3.pdf

english:
Phetchaburi stands on a river near the western shore of the Gulf of Siam, where the lowlands meet the hills of the Malay Peninsula. Earlier known as Phrip Phri, it was an important coastal centre before the rise of Ayutthaya. A fortified town, temples and access to routes across the peninsula made it a significant southern centre of the Siamese kingdom.

Under Ayutthaya, Phetchaburi served as an administrative town and a home to skilled artists. Wat Ko Kaeo Suttharam, founded in the seventeenth century, received murals in 1734 during the reign of King Borommakot. After Burmese forces captured Ayutthaya in 1767, people fleeing the capital came to Phetchaburi, bringing with them traditions of the fallen court. Its temples preserve a rich record of the Buddhist art and craftsmanship of the period.
simp_chinese:
碧武里坐落于暹罗湾西岸附近的河流边，平原在此与马来半岛山地相接。这里早先称为披立披，是阿瑜陀耶兴起以前的重要沿海中心。城墙、寺庙和通往半岛另一侧的道路，使它成为暹罗王国南方的重要城邑。

阿瑜陀耶时期，碧武里是行政中心，也聚集了技艺精湛的工匠。十七世纪建立的阁觉素他兰寺，在波隆摩哥王统治时期的1734年增绘了壁画。1767年缅甸军队攻陷阿瑜陀耶后，一些逃离王都的人来到碧武里，带来了已覆灭宫廷的传统。当地寺庙保留了这一时期佛教艺术与工艺的丰富记录。

english: The Philippine Sea stretches between the Philippines, Japan and the island chains of the western Pacific. Its waters are part of the circulation that feeds the warm Kuroshio along the eastern side of Asia. From the sixteenth century, Spanish galleons crossed this sea between the Mariana Islands and the Philippines, completing the western end of a long voyage from Acapulco to Manila.
simp_chinese: 菲律宾海横亘在菲律宾、日本与西太平洋岛链之间。这里的水域属于补给亚洲东岸暖流黑潮的海洋循环。十六世纪起，西班牙大帆船在马里亚纳群岛与菲律宾之间横渡此海，完成从阿卡普尔科到马尼拉的漫长航程的西段。

english:
Phimai is an old walled town on the Khorat Plateau, celebrated for its great Khmer sanctuary. Unlike many Angkorian temples, the sandstone complex was built for Mahayana Buddhist worship, though Hindu figures also appear among its carvings. Its southern entrance faces the route toward Angkor, connecting the town to the Khmer capital through a network of roads and religious foundations.

The sanctuary developed between the eleventh and thirteenth centuries. Its towers, galleries and gateways made Phimai a major centre of Khmer art on the plateau. After the decline of Angkorian power, the town remained a regional centre. Under Siamese rule it exercised authority over neighbouring settlements; tribute from towns farther east, including elephants and other forest products, passed through Phimai toward the royal court.
simp_chinese:
披迈是呵叻高原上的古老城镇，城墙环绕，因宏伟的高棉神庙而闻名。与许多吴哥式神庙不同，这座砂岩建筑群供奉大乘佛教，雕刻中也可见印度教神祇。南面入口朝向通往吴哥的道路，将城镇与高棉都城及沿途宗教设施联系起来。

神庙在十一至十三世纪逐步发展，其塔殿、回廊与门楼使披迈成为高原上的高棉艺术重镇。吴哥势力衰退后，城镇仍是地区中心。暹罗统治时期，披迈管辖邻近聚落；更东面各城进贡的大象和其他林产品经此送往王廷。

english:
Phnom Penh stands at the meeting of the Mekong, Tonle Sap and Bassac waterways, a junction traditionally known as Chaktomuk, the Four Faces. The city takes its name from the hill of Wat Phnom, where a shrine became a focus of local devotion. Its rivers connect the great lake, the Cambodian interior and the delta, making the site a natural meeting place for boats and merchants.

In the fifteenth century King Ponhea Yat moved the Cambodian court south from Angkor, eventually establishing his capital at Phnom Penh. Royal residences later shifted among several centres, including Srei Santhor, Longvek and Oudong. The river junction remained important even when the court lived elsewhere, and merchants continued to use its waterways to reach the kingdom's markets. Phnom Penh's history reflects the changing balance between the old Angkorian heartland and the commercial routes of the lower Mekong.

The later city of Chbar Mon also lies here.
simp_chinese:
金边位于湄公河、洞里萨河与巴萨河水道的交汇处，传统上称为「四臂湾」。城市得名于金边寺所在的山丘，这里的神龛成为当地信仰中心。河流连接大湖、柬埔寨内陆与三角洲，使此地成为船只和商人的天然会合处。

十五世纪，蓬黑亚耶王将柬埔寨王廷从吴哥南迁，最终在金边建立都城。此后王室驻地多次转移，包括斯雷桑托、隆维和乌栋。即使王廷住在别处，河流交汇处依然重要，商人继续利用水道抵达王国各地的市场。金边的历史体现了吴哥旧核心地区与湄公河下游商路之间地位的变化。

后来的磅士卑也位于此地。

english: Phnom Santuk rises above the plain of central Cambodia, its wooded slopes crowned by Buddhist shrines. Figures of the Buddha have been carved into the mountain's great rocks, including reclining images representing his final passing into nirvana. A stupa on the hill is traditionally dated to the fifteenth century, and local accounts associate works at the site with the reign of King Ponhea Dharma Reacha. The sacred mountain became a place of pilgrimage in the centuries after Angkor.
simp_chinese: 圣图山耸立在柬埔寨中部平原之上，林木覆盖的山坡顶部建有佛教圣所。山间巨岩上刻有佛像，其中卧佛表现佛陀最终入涅槃的情景。山上一座佛塔传统上被认为建于十五世纪，地方记载将此地部分营建与蓬黑亚达摩列谢王的统治联系起来。吴哥时代之后，这座圣山成为朝圣之地。

english: Phnom Srok lies northwest of Angkor, at an ancient settlement surrounded by a moat. The country was crossed by a Khmer road leading toward Sdok Kok Thom, and its surviving brick sanctuaries bear witness to the communities that once occupied the route. Pram temple, with its group of towers, stands among these remains. The surrounding plain links the great lake country with the foothills of the Dangrek Mountains.
simp_chinese: 农索罗位于吴哥西北方，古代聚落周围曾有护城壕。一条高棉道路穿过当地，通往斯多哥高棉；留存的砖造神庙见证了昔日沿路的社群。由多座塔殿组成的普兰寺，便是这些古代遗迹中的一处。周围平原连接大湖地区与扁担山脉山麓。

english: Phon Hong lies north of Vientiane, where the lowlands of the Nam Ngum basin meet the wooded hills. The Nam Lik and other rivers descend from the northern highlands and join the Nam Ngum on its way to the Mekong. Valleys among the hills provide land for settlements and cultivation, while the river system carries the rains of the uplands south toward the great river.
simp_chinese: 蓬洪位于万象以北，南俄河盆地的低地与林木覆盖的丘陵在此相接。南力河等河流从北方高地流下，汇入南俄河，继而流向湄公河。山间的河谷为居民建立聚落和开垦农田提供土地，水系则将高地汇集的雨水向南带往大河。

english: Phong Nha lies amid the limestone mountains of central Vietnam, where the Son River emerges from a great cave. Underground streams have carved passages and chambers through the karst, while forest covers the rugged slopes above. The cave was known to the people of Champa: inscriptions and clay votive objects found within it point to religious activity associated with Avalokitesvara in the ninth century. Its dark chambers preserve a remarkable trace of a sacred landscape extending beyond Champa's brick temples.
simp_chinese: 蓬雅位于越南中部的石灰岩山地，山河从一座巨大的洞穴中流出。地下水在喀斯特岩层中开凿出通道与洞厅，崎岖山坡上则覆盖着森林。占婆人早已知道这座洞穴：洞内发现的铭文和陶制供奉物，显示九世纪曾有与观自在菩萨相关的宗教活动。这些幽暗的洞厅保留了占婆圣地超出砖塔寺庙范围的珍贵痕迹。

english: Phong Tho lies in the northern mountain country of the Tai, near the routes to Yunnan. The valley of Muong So was one of the principalities associated with the Twelve Tai Cantons, an alliance of local rulers in the highlands. Each lord retained authority over his own communities, while relations among the principalities were maintained through marriage and warfare. The Tai settled in river valleys where wet rice could be grown, amid a wider landscape also inhabited by other peoples of the hills.
simp_chinese: 封土位于台人聚居的北部山地，靠近通往云南的道路。勐梭河谷是泰族十二州联盟中的一个土邦，当地领主各自统治所属社群，并通过联姻和战争维持彼此关系。台人多定居于能够种植水稻的河谷，周围山地则还有其他族群生活。

english: Phongsali lies high in the mountains of northern Laos, on the slopes of Phou Fa. Its country of forested ridges and deeply cut valleys was inhabited by diverse communities, including Tai Lue, Khmu and Phounoy peoples. Small muang governed villages in the valleys, while communities in more remote hills retained considerable local autonomy. The northern country was linked to Sipsongpanna, while areas farther south belonged to the Lao realm of Lan Xang.
simp_chinese: 丰沙里位于老挝北部的高山之中，坐落在普法山坡上。这片地区林岭连绵、河谷深切，傣仂、克木和普诺伊人等不同社群居住于此。河谷中的小型“勐”统辖周围村落，偏远山地的社群则保有较大的地方自主权。北方地区与西双版纳相联系，更南方的地方则属于老挝的澜沧王国。

english: Phonsavan lies on the Xieng Khouang plateau, close to the remarkable Plain of Jars. Hundreds of great stone vessels stand scattered in groups across its hills and open ground, some accompanied by stone discs. Their makers quarried, hollowed and transported the massive jars, leaving evidence of ancient funerary practices. The plateau later formed the heartland of Muang Phuan, a principality among the mountains of northern Laos.
simp_chinese: 丰沙湾位于川圹高原，靠近奇特的石缸平原。数以百计的巨大石制容器成群散布在山丘与空地上，有些旁边还有石盘。古人开采、掏空并搬运这些巨缸，留下了古代丧葬习俗的痕迹。此后，高原成为老挝北部山地小邦孟潘的核心地区。

english: The Phou Den Din mountains rise in the far northern Lao highlands, around the upper Nam Ou and its tributaries. Forested slopes and deep river gorges dominate this rugged country. The Nam Ou flows south through the mountains towards the Mekong, and its waters support a rich variety of wildlife. Great trees grow in the forests, while the hills form a divide between neighbouring upland valleys.
simp_chinese: 登丁山脉耸立在老挝最北部的高地，环绕南乌河上游及其支流。森林覆盖的山坡和深切的河谷构成这片崎岖土地的主要景观。南乌河穿过群山向南流向湄公河，河水与森林养育着丰富的野生动物。高大的树木生长在山林中，山岭分隔着邻近的高地谷地。

english: Wooded mountains surround the Muang Sing plain in the upper Mekong country. The ridges separate its fertile basin from other valleys of northern Laos and the lands farther north, while streams descend from the heights towards the river system. The plain's Tai Lue communities lived alongside peoples of the surrounding hills, whose forest products formed part of the tribute received by the rulers of Chiang Khaeng.
simp_chinese: 湄公河上游的孟醒平原四周群山环绕，山岭覆盖着森林。连绵高地将这片肥沃盆地与老挝北部其他谷地及更北方的地区分隔开来，溪流从山上流向河网。平原上的傣仂社群与周围山地居民相邻而居；山地出产的林产品也是景康统治者所收贡物的一部分。

english:
Phrae stands on the eastern bank of the Yom River, in a valley enclosed by the mountains of northern Thailand. Its old walled town was the centre of a principality whose temples and religious monuments reflect the traditions of the northern Tai lands. The revered shrine of Wat Phra That Cho Hae lies southeast of the city, and its foundation is associated with the fourteenth-century Sukhothai period.

The Yom valley connected Phrae with the northern and central regions, while mountain ridges separated it from the neighbouring basins. In the fifteenth century the expanding kingdom of Lan Na brought Phrae within its sphere. Like other northern towns, it subsequently experienced Burmese domination and the warfare that accompanied struggles for control of the region. Its local rulers continued to hold authority over the town and surrounding country as the political balance changed.
simp_chinese:
帕府坐落在永河东岸的谷地中，周围是泰北群山。古老的有城墙城镇曾是地方政体的中心，寺院和宗教建筑体现了北方泰族地区的传统。受人尊崇的帕塔乔海寺位于城东南，其建立与十四世纪的素可泰时期相联系。

永河谷地连接帕府与北方、中部地区，山岭则将其与邻近盆地分隔开来。十五世纪，扩张中的兰纳王国将帕府纳入势力范围。此后，帕府和其他北方城镇一样，经历了缅甸统治及争夺地区控制权的战争；随着政治力量消长，当地统治者继续管理城镇与周边土地。

english: Phraek, also known as Muang San, was an old fortified town in the Chao Phraya plain. Its royal monastery, Wat Mahathat, contains brick towers and Buddha images in styles associated with Lopburi and early Ayutthaya. Tradition dates the temple's foundation to 1354. The town served as a strategic centre in the struggles of the Sukhothai and Ayutthaya kingdoms, and its ancient shrines preserve the memory of the religious and artistic traditions that met in this river country.
simp_chinese: 帕艾又称孟讪，是湄南河平原上一座古老的设防城邑。王室寺院玛哈泰寺内有砖塔和佛像，风格体现了华富里与阿瑜陀耶早期的传统；据传统说法，寺院建于1354年。城邑曾是素可泰和阿瑜陀耶王国争战中的战略中心，古寺则保留了多种宗教与艺术传统在河流地区交汇的痕迹。

english:
Phsar Dek lies in the watery country of the Mekong delta, near the river town later known as Sa Đéc. Channels branch across the low plain, carrying floodwater and sediment toward the sea. The Khmer name was associated with a local watercourse, and the delta's waterways linked its settlements with the larger branches of the Mekong. Rice fields and wet ground spread across the surrounding landscape.

The later city of Cần Thơ lies nearby.
simp_chinese:
普萨德位于湄公河三角洲水网地带，靠近后来称为沙沥的河畔城镇。支流与水道纵横低平的平原，将洪水和泥沙带向大海。这个高棉语名称与当地一条水道有关，三角洲水网将聚落与湄公河的主要支流连接起来。周围遍布稻田与湿地。

后来的芹苴位于此地附近。

english: Phú Quý is a volcanic island in the South China Sea, some distance southeast of Phan Thiết. Its shores and surrounding waters have long supported fishing communities. During the wars between the Trịnh and Nguyễn in the seventeenth century, fishermen from the central coast came to the island, some seeking fishing grounds and others driven there by the winds. The island lies apart from the mainland but remains closely connected to its maritime life.
simp_chinese: 富贵岛是南海中的火山岛，位于潘切东南方、距离大陆较远的海面。岛岸及周围海域长期为渔民提供生计，海上的风向也影响着船只往来。十七世纪郑阮战争期间，越南中部海岸的渔民来到此岛，有人寻找渔场，也有人被风吹至此地。岛屿虽远离大陆，却与大陆沿岸的海上生活保持紧密联系。

english: Phu Wiang is a distinctive ring of sandstone hills enclosing a flat valley on the Khorat Plateau. Its steep slopes give the basin the appearance of an ancient crater, though the landforms arose from folded layers of rock. Within Phu Wiang's red sandstone lie the bones of creatures far older than any village in the valley, among them the long-necked sauropod Phuwiangosaurus, which lived in the Early Cretaceous.
simp_chinese: 普威昂是一圈独特的砂岩丘陵，环抱着呵叻高原上的平坦谷地。陡峭山坡使盆地看似古老的火山口，实际上其地貌由岩层褶皱形成。普威昂的红色砂岩中埋藏着远比谷中村落古老的生物遗骸，其中包括生活在早白垩世的长颈蜥脚类恐龙普威昂龙。

english: Phetchabun lies in the valley of the Pa Sak River, enclosed by the mountains of central Thailand. The river flows south through the long basin towards the Chao Phraya plain. Old city walls reflect Phetchabun's place on routes through the valley, where armies travelling from the north could approach the Siamese heartland. Farther south stood Si Thep, an ancient town whose monuments preserve the religious art of the Dvaravati and Khmer periods.
simp_chinese: 碧差汶位于巴萨河谷，四周是泰国中部的山脉。河水沿狭长盆地向南流向湄南河平原。古城墙反映了碧差汶在河谷道路上的地位：从北方行进的军队可以经此接近暹罗腹地。更南方是西贴古城，其遗迹保存了堕罗钵底和高棉时期的宗教艺术。

english: Phuket lies off the western coast of the Malay Peninsula, with bays facing the Andaman Sea and sheltered waters between the island and mainland. Its tin deposits made the island an important destination for merchants. In the seventeenth century traders from across the Bay of Bengal exchanged Indian textiles for tin, while Siam and European companies sought influence over the trade. Different anchorages offered shelter as the monsoon winds changed direction.
simp_chinese: 普吉岛位于马来半岛西岸外，海湾面向安达曼海，岛屿与大陆之间则有避风水域。岛上的锡矿吸引各地商人。十七世纪，来自孟加拉湾彼岸的商人用印度纺织品交换锡，暹罗和欧洲商贸公司也争取对贸易的影响。季风转向时，船只可在不同锚地寻求庇护。

english: Phuktal Monastery clings to a cliff above the Tsarap River in southeastern Zanskar. Its buildings rise in tiers around the mouth of a great natural cave, where a spring emerges from the rock. The cave was a place of retreat before the monastery was built; the scholar Pakpa Sherab established a hermitage here in the eleventh century. In the early fifteenth century Jangsem Sherap Zangpo, a disciple of Tsongkhapa, founded a Gelug monastery at the site. His disciple Palden Zangpo later continued and enlarged the establishment. The monastery's remote setting gave it a character of seclusion, while its community linked the valleys of Zanskar to the wider religious traditions of Tibet.
simp_chinese: 普克塔尔寺依附在赞斯卡东南部察拉普河上方的崖壁上，建筑围绕巨大的天然洞口层层展开，洞中有泉水从岩石间流出。建寺之前，此处已是闭关修行之地；十一世纪，学者帕巴喜饶曾在这里建立修行所。十五世纪初，宗喀巴的弟子绛森·喜饶桑波在此创建格鲁派寺院，其弟子班丹桑波后来继续扩建。偏远的地势赋予寺院幽静的修行环境，僧团则把赞斯卡诸谷与更广阔的藏地宗教传统联系起来。

english:
Phulbani belongs to the upland interior of Odisha, where wooded hills and valleys separate the coastal plains from the deeper country of the Eastern Ghats. In this regional setting, Kondh and other Indigenous communities developed livelihoods combining cultivation, forest resources and exchange. Different elevations and soils encouraged different uses of land, while seasonal rain governed the agricultural calendar. Villages relied on local knowledge of paths, streams and useful plants, maintaining connections across terrain that could be difficult for outsiders to cross.

The wider Garjat country contained numerous chiefly and princely authorities whose relationships with surrounding rulers varied over time. Its wooded hills kept the upland communities largely apart from the coastal plain.
simp_chinese:
普尔巴尼属于奥里萨内陆高地，林木覆盖的山丘与谷地把沿海平原和东高止山脉深处相互分隔。在这一区域，孔德等原住民社群发展出结合耕作、林地资源利用与交换的生计。不同海拔和土壤促成不同土地用途，季节降雨则决定农事安排。村庄依赖对道路、溪流和可用植物的地方知识，在外来者不易穿行的地形中维持彼此联系。

更广阔的迦贾德地区存在许多首领与土邦政权，它们同周围统治者的关系随时期变化。林木茂密的山地使高地社群与沿海平原相对隔开。

english: Phulia lies in the eastern part of the Mewar country, among the plains and low hills north of Chittor. The region was governed through a network of local estates owing allegiance to the maharanas of Mewar. Fortified towns and temples marked the routes between the Aravalli hills and the plains towards Ajmer. Cultivated fields and seasonal streams form the setting of this part of eastern Rajasthan.
simp_chinese: 普利亚位于梅瓦尔东部，在奇托尔以北的平原和低丘之间。这里通过向梅瓦尔马哈拉纳效忠的地方领地网络治理。设防城镇和神庙标示着阿拉瓦利山与通往阿杰梅尔平原之间的道路。耕地及季节性溪流构成拉贾斯坦东部这一地区的景观。

english: Phutthaisong stands on the southern Khorat Plateau at the site of an old town surrounded by earthen ramparts and two moats. Tradition places its establishment under King Narai of Ayutthaya, as a dependency of Nakhon Ratchasima. After some of its people moved to Buriram, the older town was abandoned. In 1799 a new Phutthaisong was established beside the old site, again under Nakhon Ratchasima, with a newly appointed governor.
simp_chinese: 普泰颂位于呵叻高原南部，古城遗址周围有土垒与两重护城壕。地方传统认为此城建立于大城王国那莱王时期，隶属于呵叻。部分居民迁往武里南后，旧城逐渐荒废。1799年，新普泰颂在旧址旁重建，再次归属呵叻，并由新任城主管辖。

english:
Phyu belongs to the lower Burmese country associated with Pegu, where rivers, cultivated lowlands, and routes toward the central valley support settlement and exchange. Rice farming supplied communities, while waterways carried people and goods through landscapes affected by seasonal rain. Local markets connected agricultural producers with towns and travelers. Forests and nearby uplands provided complementary resources, making the relationship between river plains and surrounding country important to everyday life.

During the late medieval and early modern centuries, the wider Pegu region was a major center of Mon and Burmese political history. Ports and fertile land supplied rulers with revenue and commercial connections reaching toward the Bay of Bengal. Wars among regional kingdoms repeatedly changed authority and could displace populations or disrupt cultivation. Buddhist institutions supported worship, education, and social relationships through these changes. Later dynastic expansion connected lower Burma more firmly with political centers farther north.
simp_chinese:
漂城属于同勃固相联系的缅甸下部地区，河流、耕作低地与通向中央河谷的道路支撑着定居和交换。稻田为居民提供粮食，水道在季节性降雨影响的环境中运送人员和货物。市场连接农民、城镇与旅人，森林及附近高地则提供补充资源。

中世纪后期至近代早期，勃固一带是孟族和缅甸政治历史的重要中心。港口与肥沃土地为统治者提供财政收入，以及通向孟加拉湾的商业联系。地区王国之间的战争多次改变统治，也可能迫使人口迁移、中断耕作。佛教机构在变化中继续支持礼拜、教育及社会关系。后来的王朝扩张使下缅甸与北方政治中心的联系更加紧密。

english:
Piacenza stands on the south bank of the Po, on the Via Francigena, the pilgrims' road to Rome. It was a free commune from 1126 and one of the founding cities of the Lombard League; the preliminaries of the Peace of Constance were signed at the basilica of Sant'Antonino in 1183. Two centuries of feuding between Guelph and Ghibelline noble houses ended in 1335, when the Visconti took the city, and apart from short breaks it stayed under Milan until the Papal States took it in 1521.

The basilica of San Francesco, built in Lombard Gothic between 1278 and 1373, and the Romanesque cathedral of the twelfth and thirteenth centuries show how much the city built. In 1545 Pope Paul III made Piacenza and Parma into a duchy for his son Pier Luigi Farnese. After Pier Luigi was murdered in a plot of Piacenza nobles, the city briefly returned to Milan before passing to his son Ottavio Farnese in 1556. When the Farnese line died out, the Bourbons ruled from 1731.
simp_chinese:
皮亚琴察位于波河南岸，在通往罗马的朝圣之路弗朗奇杰纳古道上。它自1126年起是自由城邦，也是伦巴第同盟的创始城市之一；1183年《康斯坦茨和约》的初步条款就在圣安东尼诺大教堂签订。贵族家族分属归尔甫和吉伯林两派，争斗了两个世纪，到1335年维斯孔蒂家族取得这座城市才告终，此后除了短暂中断，它一直受米兰统治，直到1521年教宗国接管。

建于1278至1373年的伦巴第哥特式圣方济各大教堂，以及12至13世纪建成的罗曼式主教座堂，显示了这座城市的建设规模。1545年，教宗保罗三世把皮亚琴察和帕尔马合并为公国，授予其子皮埃尔·路易吉·法尔内塞。皮埃尔·路易吉死于皮亚琴察贵族的阴谋，城市短暂回到米兰手中，1556年交给他的儿子奥塔维奥·法尔内塞。法尔内塞家族绝嗣后，波旁家族自1731年起统治此地。

english: Piachi was a town on a river in the country of the chief Tuskaloosa. Hernando de Soto's expedition arrived there in October 1540, after leaving the chief's town of Atahachi. The Spaniards demanded canoes for the crossing, but the people of Piachi said they had none, and the expedition made its own boats. Continuing with Tuskaloosa, the party reached Mabila several days later, where a battle destroyed the fortified town and took many lives.
simp_chinese: 皮亚奇是首领塔斯卡卢萨领地内的一座河边城镇。1540年10月，埃尔南多·德·索托的远征队离开首领所在的阿塔哈奇后抵达这里。西班牙人要求独木舟渡河，但皮亚奇人说没有船，远征队便自己造船。此行继续与塔斯卡卢萨同行，几日后抵达马比拉；那里爆发的战斗摧毁了设防城镇，也夺走了许多生命。

english: Piagailoe is a low atoll northeast of Lamotrek in the central Carolines. Its reef and islets lie within a maritime world linked by sailing canoes. Traditional accounts describe Piagailoe among places connected to Lamotrek, whose chief participated in the exchange and tribute network extending westwards to Yap.
simp_chinese: 皮亚盖洛是加罗林群岛中部、拉莫特雷克东北方的低矮环礁。礁盘与小岛处于帆船独木舟联系起来的海洋世界中。传统记述将皮亚盖洛列为与拉莫特雷克有关的地方之一；拉莫特雷克首领参与了向西延伸至雅浦的交换和贡纳网络。

english:
Piantou Pass guards the rugged northwestern approaches to Shanxi, where mountain ridges lead west towards the Yellow River. Its name is traditionally linked to the uneven ground of the pass, high in the east and low in the west. The Ming made it a major northern frontier stronghold: in 1429 the regional commander moved his headquarters here, and the pass was enlarged in the decades that followed.

The defences grew into several overlapping lines of walls and beacon towers. In 1515 an additional wall was built south of the pass along the hills, and in 1575 the Ming authorised further towers and repairs along the frontier. These works guarded an exposed border while controlled markets provided places for exchange with communities beyond it.
simp_chinese:
偏头关扼守山西西北的险要通道，群山向西延伸至黄河。关名相传得于地势东高西低，形如偏首。明朝将此地经营为边防重镇，1429年山西镇总兵移驻偏头关，此后数十年关城也陆续扩建。

防线逐渐发展为多道相叠的边墙和烽火台。1515年，官府沿关南山势增筑边墙；1575年又批准增建敌楼并修缮边墙。重重防御守护着边境，沿边互市则为关内外居民提供了交易之所。

english:
Piatra lui Crăciun was a market town in the Bistrița valley at the foot of the Eastern Carpathians. Known also simply as Piatra, it grew among the early towns of the Moldavian principality. The surrounding valley preserves traces of much older settlement, including the Dacian fortified site at Bâtca Doamnei.

Stephen the Great established a princely court here between 1468 and 1475; a document of 1491 mentions it. The church of the court was built in 1497–1498, followed by its bell tower in 1499. These buildings gave the ruler a residence in the mountain country and left a lasting mark on the market town, whose name would later be joined to that of Neamț. Its Jewish community had a burial ground by the early seventeenth century.
simp_chinese:
皮亚特拉卢伊克勒丘恩是比斯特里察河谷中的一座集镇，坐落在东喀尔巴阡山麓。它也简称皮亚特拉，是摩尔达维亚公国早期兴起的城镇之一。周围河谷保留着远早于城镇的聚落痕迹，包括伯特卡多姆奈的达契亚设防遗址。

斯特凡大公于1468至1475年间在此建立亲王行宫，1491年的文书提到了这座行宫。宫廷教堂建于1497—1498年，钟楼于1499年竣工。这些建筑为统治者在山区提供了住所，也在集镇留下持久的印记；后来城镇的名称又加上了尼亚姆茨。到17世纪初，当地犹太社群已有自己的墓地。

english: The Piauí River runs through the dry interior of northeastern Brazil into the Canindé, a tributary of the Parnaíba. In the 1670s Domingos Afonso Mafrense established cattle estates along the Canindé and Piauí, placing many under the care of herders. In the following century cattle from these valleys supplied markets as far away as Maranhão, Bahia and Minas Gerais.
simp_chinese: 皮奥伊河流经巴西东北部干燥内陆，注入帕纳伊巴河的支流卡宁德河。十七世纪七十年代，多明戈斯·阿丰索·马夫伦塞沿卡宁德河和皮奥伊河建立牧牛庄园，许多庄园交由牧人管理。此后一个世纪，河谷的牛群供应远至马拉尼昂、巴伊亚和米纳斯吉拉斯的市场。

english: The interior of Piauí spans a transition between the dry caatinga and the savannas of central Brazil. Thorny shrubs, seasonal woodland and open ground cover hills and plains, while rivers flow toward the Parnaíba basin. Rock shelters in the wider region preserve paintings made by ancient inhabitants, evidence of a long human history in this varied and often dry landscape.
simp_chinese: 皮奥伊内陆横跨干旱的卡廷加与巴西中部稀树草原之间的过渡地带。多刺灌木、季节性林地和开阔土地覆盖山丘与平原，河流流向帕纳伊巴流域。广大地区的岩棚保留着古代居民留下的绘画，见证了这片多样而常年干燥土地上悠久的人类历史。

english: The Piaxtla River descends from the Sierra Madre Occidental through deep valleys to the Pacific coast of Sinaloa. Its course connects the mountain mining country with the coastal plain. At San Ignacio de Piaxtla, the river became the scene of fighting during the Mexican War of Independence: on 8 January 1811 royalist forces defeated the insurgent army of José María González Hermosillo as it sought to advance through the region.
simp_chinese: 皮亚斯特拉河从西马德雷山脉流下，穿过深谷，抵达锡那罗亚的太平洋海岸。河流将山地矿区与沿海平原联系起来。墨西哥独立战争期间，河畔的圣伊格纳西奥·德·皮亚斯特拉成为战场：1811年1月8日，保王派军队在此击败何塞·玛丽亚·冈萨雷斯·埃尔莫西略率领的起义军。

english:
Piazza stands on a hill in the interior of Sicily, amid the heights of the Erei Mountains. Its cathedral crowns the town, while the celebrated Roman villa in the surrounding countryside preserves richly decorated mosaic floors. The medieval settlement grew under Norman rule and was repopulated by settlers from northern Italy after it was destroyed during a rebellion in 1161.

The town's churches continued to change in later centuries. The cathedral was rebuilt in the seventeenth century, although the Gothic-Catalan bell tower of its predecessor survived. The rebuilt church gave the hilltop a new focus, visible above the houses and surrounding countryside. Rising above the older streets, it joined the legacy of Norman settlement to the religious building of a later age.
simp_chinese:
皮亚扎坐落在西西里内陆埃雷伊山地的一座山丘上，大教堂冠于镇顶，附近乡野的罗马别墅则保存着精美的马赛克地面。中世纪聚落在诺曼统治下发展，1161年因叛乱被毁后，又由来自北意大利的移民重新定居。

此后数百年，镇上的教堂继续改变。大教堂于十七世纪重建，前一座教堂的哥特—加泰罗尼亚式钟楼却得以保留。重建的教堂成为山顶的新中心，俯瞰房屋与周围乡野。它耸立于旧街之上，将诺曼移民留下的遗产与后世的宗教建筑连接起来。

english: Pibor lies in the river country east of the White Nile, between the low Lotilla plains and the hills of the Boma plateau. The Pibor River flows north to meet the Baro, together forming the Sobat. Seasonal waters spread across the flat country, while higher ground rises to the southeast. Murle communities inhabit this region, where cattle are an important part of social life and subsistence.
simp_chinese: 皮博尔位于白尼罗河以东的河流地区，处在低洼的洛蒂拉平原与博马高原丘陵之间。皮博尔河向北流，与巴罗河汇合形成索巴特河。季节洪水漫过平坦土地，东南方则升起较高地势。穆尔莱人社群居住在这里，牛群是社会生活与生计的重要组成部分。

english: The Picanoc River loops through the wooded hills west of the Gatineau before joining that river on its way to the Ottawa. Its name has been traced to an Indigenous word for the walnut tree, whose wood was valued for making bows. This country lay within the lands of Algonquin people, who hunted and trapped in the Gatineau watershed. The Gatineau itself was a route south to summer gatherings on the Ottawa River and at Lake of Two Mountains.
simp_chinese: 皮卡诺克河在加蒂诺河以西的林木丘陵间曲折流淌，最后汇入加蒂诺河，流向渥太华河。河名被认为源于原住民语言中“胡桃树”一词，这种树木的木材是制作弓的重要材料。这里位于阿尔冈昆人的土地上，他们在加蒂诺流域狩猎和捕兽，也沿加蒂诺河向南前往渥太华河及双山湖参加夏季聚会。

english: La Picasa is a shallow lake in the pampas, within a basin whose waters have no natural outlet to the sea. Rainfall and evaporation strongly influence its extent, so its shoreline changes with wet and dry periods. The surrounding plains are crossed by small streams that drain towards the lagoon. Its open waters form part of a broader landscape of grasslands, wetlands and shallow lakes in southern Santa Fe and neighbouring country.
simp_chinese: 拉皮卡萨是潘帕斯的一座浅湖，所在盆地的水没有天然出海口。降雨与蒸发显著影响湖面范围，岸线随湿润和干旱时期变化。周围平原上有小溪汇入潟湖。开阔水面是圣菲南部及邻近地区的景观之一，这里草原、湿地与众多浅湖相互交织，湖面大小常随季节与多年降水变化。

english:
Machu Picchu rises on a narrow mountain saddle above a great bend of the Urubamba River. The Inca builders fitted terraces, temples, residences and fountains into a steep landscape of granite and forest. A network of paths linked the settlement to other sites in the surrounding mountains, where high Andean peaks give way to the humid eastern slopes.

Built in the fifteenth century, Machu Picchu is commonly understood as an estate associated with the Inca ruler Pachacuti. Its finely worked stone buildings and sacred places served a community of elite occupants and attendants, while terraces supported cultivation on the mountainside. The settlement’s occupation was relatively short, and it was largely abandoned around the time of the Spanish conquest. Its buildings remained among the forests and steep ridges above the river.
simp_chinese:
马丘比丘坐落在狭窄的山脊鞍部，俯瞰乌鲁班巴河的大弯。印加建造者在陡峭的花岗岩与森林地形中修筑梯田、神庙、住宅和泉池。道路网络将聚落与周围山中的其他地点相连；在这里，安第斯高峰逐渐过渡到潮湿的东坡。

马丘比丘建于十五世纪，通常被视为与印加统治者帕查库特克有关的庄园。精工石砌建筑和圣所服务于贵族及随从组成的社区，梯田则支持山坡上的耕作。聚落的使用时间相对短暂，在西班牙征服前后大体被废弃。建筑留在河流上方的森林与陡峭山岭之间。

english: Pichan is an oasis at the eastern end of the Turpan Basin. Its Uyghur name was rendered in Chinese as Bizhan, while the fertile ground around it was known under several earlier names. The Tang administered part of the district as Puchang, and it later belonged to the Uyghur kingdom of Qocho. In the fifteenth century the area came under Turpan; in 1759 the Qing appointed an official at Pichan and made it one of the region's six towns.
simp_chinese: 辟展是吐鲁番盆地东端的绿洲。唐朝曾在这一带设置蒲昌县，此后当地属于高昌回鹘王国。十五世纪，辟展并入吐鲁番；1759年清廷在此设办事大臣，将其列为吐鲁番六城之一。

english: Pichinamei Lake lies south of Attawapiskat Lake in the northern Ontario interior. Its name comes from Northwestern Ojibwe, reflecting the long Indigenous presence in this country of lakes and rivers. The Attawapiskat watershed stretches east towards James Bay, while waterways and portages connect neighbouring lake systems. Families travelled through the forests to fish and hunt, moving between camps as the seasons and available resources changed.
simp_chinese: 皮奇纳米湖位于安大略北部内陆阿塔瓦皮斯卡特湖以南。湖名源自西北奥吉布瓦语，反映出原住民在这片湖泊与河流之地的悠久历史。阿塔瓦皮斯卡特流域向东延伸至詹姆斯湾，水道与搬运路线连接相邻湖系。各家庭穿行森林捕鱼狩猎，随着季节和资源变化在营地之间迁徙。

sources.title: Thirteenth Report of the Geographic Board of Canada for the ear ending 30th June, 1914. (IA 1915v50i21p25d 1128).pdf

english:
Pickawillany was a Miami town on the Great Miami River in western Ohio. Founded by the chief Memeskia, known to English traders as Old Briton, it became a centre of trade with Pennsylvania merchants. An English trading post and stockade stood beside the village, drawing commerce that challenged French influence in the Ohio country.

In 1752 Charles Michel de Langlade led a force of French-allied warriors against Pickawillany. Many inhabitants were away from the stockade or working in the cornfields when the attack came. Short of water, the defenders negotiated surrender, and several English traders were captured. Memeskia was killed, and the town was destroyed. The raid struck a serious blow to British trade and the Miami community that had cultivated it.
simp_chinese:
皮卡维拉尼是俄亥俄西部大迈阿密河畔的迈阿密人城镇，由首领梅梅斯基亚建立；英国商人称他为老英国人。此地成为与宾夕法尼亚商人交易的中心。村旁建有英国贸易站和木栅堡垒，吸引的商业活动挑战了法国在俄亥俄地区的影响力。

1752年，夏尔·米歇尔·德朗格拉德率法国盟友的战士进攻皮卡维拉尼。袭击发生时，许多居民不在木栅内，或正在玉米田劳作。守方缺水，被迫谈判投降，数名英国商人被俘。梅梅斯基亚遇害，城镇也被毁。这场袭击重创了英国贸易，也重创了发展这一贸易的迈阿密社群。

english: The Picos de Europa rise above the northern coast of Iberia in three great limestone massifs. Rivers have cut deep gorges between them, most strikingly the Cares, whose narrow course separates the western and central massifs. Ice also shaped these mountains: glaciers excavated hollows and left deposits in the valleys, while the lakes of Enol and Ercina remain among the traces of that colder past. The steep peaks and ravines make a formidable barrier between the Cantabrian coast and the lands to the south.
simp_chinese: 欧洲之巅山脉耸立在伊比利亚北部海岸腹地，由三大石灰岩山体组成。河流在山体之间切出深峡，其中卡雷斯河的狭窄河谷将西部与中部山体分开。冰川也塑造了这些山岭：它们挖掘洼地，在谷中留下堆积物，埃诺尔湖和埃尔西纳湖则是寒冷往昔留下的痕迹。陡峭的峰峦与峡谷构成了坎塔布连海岸与南方地区之间的险峻屏障。

english:
Piktuk lies on the northern coast of Nova Scotia, where sheltered waters open toward the Northumberland Strait. It belongs to Mi'kma'ki, the homeland of the Mi'kmaq, whose seasonal movements connected coastal resources with rivers and inland hunting grounds. Fishing, shellfish gathering and the use of canoes made the harbour and its approaches part of a much wider inhabited maritime landscape. Social and political relationships extended across the region through kinship, exchange and gatherings.

Before European settlement, the harbour was the site of a Mi'kmaq summer coastal community. European colonial claims and settlement later increased pressure on the region. In 1773 the ship Hector arrived with Scottish immigrants, adding to families who had already settled nearby. Piktuk's history encompasses both the continuing Indigenous homeland and the growth of a colonial harbour.
simp_chinese:
皮克图克位于新斯科舍北岸，避风水面通向诺森伯兰海峡。这里属于米克马克人的故土米克马克基，居民的季节移动把沿海资源与河流、内陆猎场连接起来。捕鱼、采集贝类和使用独木舟，使港湾及其入口成为广阔海洋生活空间的一部分。亲属关系、交换和集会维持了遍及地区的社会政治联系。

欧洲人定居之前，港湾是米克马克人夏季沿海聚居地。后来欧洲殖民领有与定居增加了地区所受压力。1773年，“赫克托”号载着苏格兰移民抵达，当地此前已有其他定居家庭。皮克图克的历史既包括延续至今的原住民故土，也包括殖民港口的成长。

english: The Pictou Banks extend westward from Pictou Island into Northumberland Strait, reaching much of the way towards the Nova Scotia mainland. Tidal streams sweep through the nearby channels, and winter ice can disturb the shallow seabed. Scallops live on the banks, while the island and surrounding shoals divide the waters between the mainland coast and Epekwitk. The shallows demand care from vessels passing through a strait whose currents and ice change with the seasons.
simp_chinese: 皮克图浅滩从皮克图岛西端伸入诺森伯兰海峡，向新斯科舍大陆延伸了大半距离。潮流掠过附近水道，冬季海冰也会扰动浅海床。扇贝栖息在浅滩上，岛屿与周围浅水区则分隔大陆海岸和埃佩奎特克之间的水域。船只通过时须留意浅滩，而海峡中的潮流与冰情又随季节变化。

english:
Piedimonte, identified here with Piedimonte Matese, lies at the foot of the Matese mountains above the Alife plain. Streams supplied water for mills and workshops, while roads connected the town with the wider Neapolitan countryside.

The Gaetani family governed the town for centuries, and their relations with the community were regulated by statutes and later agreements. Woollen cloth production grew under their lordship, reaching a high point between the sixteenth and eighteenth centuries. The neighbouring quarter of Vallata sought greater representation in town government, producing repeated disputes before an agreement in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese:
这里的皮耶迪蒙特暂对应皮耶迪蒙特马泰塞，位于马泰塞山麓、阿利费平原之上。溪流为磨坊和作坊供水，道路则连接城镇与那不勒斯周围乡村。

加埃塔尼家族统治此城数世纪，与地方社群的关系由章程及后续协议规定。他们统治期间毛呢生产得到发展，在十六至十八世纪达到兴盛。邻近的瓦拉塔城区要求在市政中获得更充分的代表权，多次争执后双方于十八世纪达成协议。

english: Piedrahíta lies in the Corneja valley of western Ávila. From 1366 it belonged to the house that became the dukes of Alba and served as one of the principal towns of the lordship of Valdecorneja. Its walls and castle reflected the authority of those lords. Fernando Álvarez de Toledo, later known as the Great Duke of Alba, was born in Piedrahíta in 1507. In the eighteenth century the old castle gave way to a palace built for the dukes in 1755–56. María Teresa Cayetana de Silva later made the palace a gathering place for artists and intellectuals; Francisco de Goya visited the town. Piedrahíta's history combines its place in a rural valley with the long influence of a prominent Castilian noble house.
simp_chinese: 彼德拉伊塔位于今阿维拉省西部的科尔内哈河谷。1366年起，它属于后来获得阿尔瓦公爵爵位的家族，并成为巴尔德科尔内哈领地的主要城镇之一。城墙与城堡反映了领主的权威。后来被称为“伟大的阿尔瓦公爵”的费尔南多·阿尔瓦雷斯·德·托莱多于1507年生于此地。十八世纪旧城堡被拆除，公爵宫于1755至1756年建成。玛丽亚·特蕾莎·卡耶塔娜·德·席尔瓦后来使宫殿成为艺术家和知识人士的聚会场所，画家戈雅也曾到访。小镇的历史由此结合了乡村河谷生活与卡斯蒂利亚显赫贵族家族的长期影响。

english: Pielinen is a great lake in North Karelia, its waters gathering from a broad basin that reaches eastwards across the forests. Dark water reflects the many bogs that drain into it. Settlements such as Nurmes grew around its shores; in 1651 Nurmes became a chapel community of the Pielisjärvi parish. The lake's outlet leads south into the waterways of eastern Finland, while the wooded hills of Koli rise along its western shore.
simp_chinese: 皮耶利宁是北卡累利阿的大湖，集水区向东延伸至广阔森林。湖水颜色较深，反映出流入其中的众多沼泽水。努尔梅斯等聚落在湖岸发展，1651年努尔梅斯成为皮耶利斯耶尔维堂区的附属教会。湖水向南流入芬兰东部水系，西岸则耸立着林木覆盖的科利山丘。

english: Pieninkä is the Karelian name of the Peninga, a river of western Karelia that flows from Lake Peninga through Lake Nizhneye to Leksozero. Its waters form part of an old network of routes across the forested watershed. Travellers from the Segozero country could carry boats across short stretches of land to the upper Peninga, then descend to Leksozero and seek passages towards the Kem basin or the rivers of Finland.
simp_chinese: 皮耶宁卡是卡累利阿语中佩宁加河的名称。这条西卡累利阿河流从佩宁加湖出发，穿过下湖后注入列克索泽罗湖，属于穿越森林分水岭的古老水路网络。来自谢戈泽罗地区的旅人可将船只搬运过短距离陆地，抵达佩宁加河上游，再顺流进入列克索泽罗湖，寻找通往凯姆河流域或芬兰河流的路线。

english: The Pierruiat were Goshute people associated with Deep Creek, on the western side of the Deep Creek Mountains. Fifteen-Mile Creek and Spring Creek meet near Ibapah to form Deep Creek, which flows north toward the Great Salt Lake Desert. High peaks rise above the valley, where the Goshute found water and seasonal resources. Jedediah Smith crossed the broader Deep Creek country in 1827 during his search for a route across the Great Basin.
simp_chinese: 皮埃鲁亚特是与迪普溪有关的戈舒特人群体，生活在迪普溪山脉西侧。十五英里溪和斯普林溪在伊巴帕附近汇合，形成迪普溪，向北流向大盐湖沙漠。高峰耸立在河谷之上，戈舒特人在此获取水源和时令物产。1827年，杰戴代亚·史密斯寻找横穿大盆地的道路时经过更广阔的迪普溪地区。

english: Pietālava lies in the border country between Latgale and Pskov, east of the lands of Tālava. In the Middle Ages the area stood between the authority of the archbishops of Riga and the Russian lands to the east. The fortified place known as Vyshgorod was established in the fifteenth century and suffered destruction during Stephen Báthory's campaign in 1581. The frontier shifted amid the wars that divided Livonia between its neighbours. By the late eighteenth century Pytalovo was recorded as a village in the Pskov country.
simp_chinese: 皮耶塔拉瓦位于拉特加莱与普斯科夫之间的边地，在塔拉瓦以东。中世纪，这一带处于里加总主教的权力与东面罗斯土地之间。十五世纪，当地建立了名为维什哥罗德的设防据点，1581年斯特凡·巴托里出征期间它遭到破坏。随着周边势力通过战争瓜分利沃尼亚，边界也不断变动。到十八世纪末，皮塔洛沃作为普斯科夫地区的村庄见于记载。

english:
Pietrykaw lies in the Pripet country of southern Belarus, within the wider historical landscape around Mazyr. Rivers, marshes and woodland shaped a pattern of settlement concentrated on usable ground and dependable crossings. Boats offered connections that could be easier than journeys across wet lowlands. Fishing, livestock, cultivation and forest products supported households, while seasonal flooding changed the practical boundaries between fields, pasture and water.

The first known written mention of Pietrykaw dates to 1523, when it belonged to the Principality of Slutsk within the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. The Chodkiewicz family later held the town and surrounding lands. In 1793 the second partition of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth brought the district under Russian rule. Its position on the Pripet linked the town to the waterways of Polesia.
simp_chinese:
佩特里考位于白俄罗斯南部的普里皮亚季河地区，属于莫济里周围较广阔的历史地理空间。河流、沼泽和林地影响聚落分布，居民通常集中在可利用土地与可靠渡口附近。乘船往来有时比穿越潮湿低地更方便。捕鱼、畜牧、耕作和林产共同维持家庭生活，季节性洪水又不断改变田地、牧地与水面的实际界限。

佩特里考最早已知的文字记载见于1523年，当时它属于立陶宛大公国内的斯卢茨克公国。霍德凯维奇家族后来拥有城镇及周围土地。1793年，波兰立陶宛联邦第二次遭瓜分后，这一地区归入俄罗斯统治。普里皮亚季河畔的位置使城镇与波列西耶的水道相连。

english: Pieve di Cadore lies among the forested mountains north of Belluno. Its palace of the Magnificent Community was built in 1447, with a tower completed in 1491, as the seat of the council governing the district. Cadore's timber was valuable to Venice for buildings and ships, and the painter Titian was born in a family involved in the timber trade. The town's fortifications guarded an important route through the Alpine valleys.
simp_chinese: 皮耶韦迪卡多雷位于贝卢诺以北林木茂密的群山之间。尊荣共同体宫建于1447年，塔楼于1491年完工，是治理当地的议会驻地。卡多雷的木材对威尼斯的建筑和造船十分重要；画家提香便出生在一个从事木材贸易的家庭。城镇的防御工事守卫着穿越阿尔卑斯河谷的重要道路。

english: The Pigou River reaches the north shore of the Gulf of St. Lawrence from the forested interior. Its name has been linked to an Indigenous word for resinous gum or pitch, gathered from fir or pine. The coast forms part of Innu country, where families travelled between inland hunting grounds and the sea. European trading posts later appeared at the mouths of several rivers along this shore, drawing Innu hunters into the exchange of furs.
simp_chinese: 皮古河从森林内陆流至圣劳伦斯湾北岸。河名与原住民语言中树胶或沥青一词有关，指从冷杉或松树取得的黏性树脂。这片海岸属于因努人的土地，家庭往来于内陆猎场与海滨。后来欧洲人在沿岸多条河流的河口设立贸易站，因努猎人在这些地点交换毛皮。

english: The Piguique lived along the Texas coast between the San Antonio and Nueces rivers, visiting offshore islands such as St. Joseph and Mustang in season. Their country lay between the territories of Karankawan and Coahuiltecan speakers. The Piguique were associated with the Pamaque and Pasnacane peoples, and later with Karankawa groups. During the eighteenth century, measles and smallpox greatly reduced their numbers. Some entered Spanish missions near the coast, at San Antonio, and south of the Rio Grande.
simp_chinese: 皮吉克人生活在得克萨斯海岸的圣安东尼奥河与努埃塞斯河之间，并随季节前往圣约瑟夫岛、马斯坦岛等近海岛屿。他们的地域处于卡兰卡瓦语和科阿韦尔特科语使用者的地界之间，与帕马克、帕斯纳卡内人关系密切，后来又与卡兰卡瓦群体来往。十八世纪，麻疹与天花使他们的人数大减，一些人进入海岸附近、圣安东尼奥和格兰德河南岸的西班牙传教站。

english: Pihlajavesi is a labyrinth of islands and waterways in the Saimaa lake system. Rather than a single open expanse, its waters wind among wooded shores and rocky islands. At its northern edge the Kyrönsalmi channel connects it to Haukivesi. Here the fortress of Olofsborg was founded in 1475, guarding an important junction of routes through the lakes of Savolax.
simp_chinese: 皮赫拉亚韦西是塞马湖水系中一片由岛屿和水道组成的迷宫。湖面并非一片开阔水域，而是在林岸和岩岛之间蜿蜒。北缘的屈伦萨尔米水道将其与豪基韦西相连；乌洛夫斯堡于1475年在此建立，守卫穿越萨沃拉克斯湖区的重要交通枢纽。

english:
The Piipaash, also known as the Maricopa, are a Yuman-speaking people of the river valleys of the desert Southwest. Along the Colorado and Gila rivers, communities farmed floodplain land and maintained relationships with neighbouring peoples. The rivers linked a country of settlements and fields through an otherwise dry landscape.

During the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries, warfare with other river peoples contributed to Piipaash movement east from the lower Colorado towards the Gila and Salt rivers. They formed an enduring alliance with the Akimel O’odham, whose villages lay farther up the Gila. By the 1820s Piipaash settlements had shifted eastwards to lands west of the O’odham villages. Their shared river country became the setting for close cooperation between the two peoples.
simp_chinese:
皮帕什又称马里科帕，是北美西南荒漠河谷中说尤曼语的族群。科罗拉多河和希拉河沿岸的社群耕种泛滥平原，也与邻人保持联系。河流穿过干燥地区，将村庄和田地连接起来。

十八世纪末至十九世纪初，与其他河谷族群的战争促使皮帕什人从科罗拉多河下游向东迁往希拉河与盐河一带。他们与居住在希拉河上游的阿基梅尔奥德汉人结成长久联盟。到十九世纪二十年代，皮帕什聚落进一步东移，来到奥德汉村庄以西；共同的河流家园成为两族密切合作的地方。

english: The country around Pikalyovo lies among the forests and small lakes of the Lida basin, east of Tikhvin. Here stood the Resurrection pogost of Luchany, a church centre serving a district of scattered villages. The church was dedicated to the Resurrection of Christ, and the surrounding households formed part of Novgorod’s Obonezhskaya pyatina. In this lakeland many villages were very small, sometimes consisting of only one or two households, with their church district providing a common point of reference.
simp_chinese: 皮卡廖沃一带位于季赫温以东的利达河流域，森林与小湖遍布。这里曾有卢恰内复活教堂村，是服务周围分散村落的教会中心。教堂供奉基督复活，周边人家属于诺夫哥罗德的奥博涅日区。在这片湖泊地带，许多村庄规模很小，有时只有一两户；教堂辖区为它们提供了共同的中心。

english: Pikillaqta was a major Wari center in the Cusco region, built centuries before the rise of the Inca Empire. Its high walls enclose a carefully planned arrangement of compounds, narrow streets and open spaces. The extensive complex formed a provincial outpost of a power centered farther north in the Andes. Though its builders had departed long before Spanish arrival, the ruins remained a conspicuous reminder of an earlier order in the valley.
simp_chinese: 皮基拉克塔是库斯科地区的一处大型瓦里中心，建于印加帝国崛起前数个世纪。高墙围起布局严整的院落、狭窄街道与开阔空间。这片广阔建筑群曾是一个以安第斯更北方为中心的政权在地方上的据点。尽管建造者在西班牙人到来之前很久便已离去，遗址仍醒目地见证着山谷中更早的秩序。

english: Linares lies in the central valley of Chile, south of the Maule River and west of the Andes. Indigenous Picunche communities inhabited the wider region before Spanish settlement. In 1794 Governor Ambrosio O’Higgins ordered the foundation of a villa at Pilocoyán, following petitions by local residents. Its plots were laid out later that year and the new town was named Linares. The settlement served the dispersed rural population of the surrounding valleys.
simp_chinese: 利纳雷斯位于智利中央谷地，坐落在马乌莱河以南、安第斯山脉以西。西班牙人定居之前，皮昆切原住民社群生活在这一广大地区。1794年，应当地居民请求，总督安布罗西奥·奥伊金斯下令在皮洛科扬建镇。同年晚些时候，新镇地块划定，城镇被命名为利纳雷斯，服务于周围河谷分散的乡村居民。

english:
Pikunwijimapu is the northern part of Huilliche country in southern Chile, around the rivers and forests of Valdivia. The Huilliche, or people of the south, occupied a broad territory extending from the Toltén River towards Chiloé. Their lands contained lakes and wooded valleys between the Andes and the Pacific. Spanish forts and settlements at Valdivia brought the communities of this region into a long history of conflict, negotiation and exchange.

The later city of Valdivia lies here.
simp_chinese:
皮昆维希马普是智利南部维利切土地的北部，位于瓦尔迪维亚的河流与森林一带。维利切意为“南方之人”，他们的广大领地从托尔滕河延伸至奇洛埃，安第斯山脉与太平洋之间遍布湖泊和林木河谷。瓦尔迪维亚的西班牙堡垒与聚落使这一地区的社群经历了长期的冲突、谈判与交流。

后来的瓦尔迪维亚即位于此地。

english: Pikwàkanagàn, a name meaning “hilly place,” lies beside Golden Lake and the Bonnechere River in Algonquin country. Hills surround the lake, whose waters flow into the Bonnechere and onward to the Ottawa River. The Kinouchebiriniouek, or “Pike River people,” were an Algonquin group associated with the Bonnechere watershed. Their neighbours included other Anishinaabe-speaking peoples along the Madawaska and the great river known as Kitchissippi.
simp_chinese: 皮克瓦卡纳甘意为“多丘陵的地方”，位于阿尔冈昆土地上的戈尔登湖及博讷谢尔河畔。湖泊四周山丘环绕，湖水经博讷谢尔河流入渥太华河。基努什比里尼乌埃克人，即“狗鱼河之民”，是与博讷谢尔流域有关的阿尔冈昆群体。他们的邻人包括马达瓦斯卡河和称作基奇西比的“大河”沿岸其他讲阿尼希纳贝语的社群。

english: Pikwedina is associated with the Ojibwe name for Lake of the Woods, a great lake of islands and bays north of the plains. The name has been translated as “inland lake of the sand hills.” Its waters connect the Rainy River with the Winnipeg River and form part of a route across the northern interior. Indigenous people have lived around the lake for thousands of years, travelling among its wooded shores and numerous islands.
simp_chinese: 皮克维迪纳与伍兹湖的奥吉布瓦语名称有关，后者被译为“沙丘间的内陆湖”。这座大湖位于平原以北，岛屿和海湾众多。湖水连接雷尼河与温尼伯河，是横穿北方内陆水道的一部分。原住民数千年来生活在湖泊周围，往来于林木湖岸和众多岛屿之间。

english: Pikwedina Sagainan is an Ojibwe name for Lake of the Woods, a vast lake of bays and islands on the route between the Rainy and Winnipeg rivers. The name has been translated as “inland lake of the sand hills.” Its rocky shores and wooded islands have been inhabited for thousands of years. Indigenous travellers used its waters as part of a network of canoe routes, later followed by fur traders moving between the Great Lakes and the western interior.
simp_chinese: 皮克维迪纳萨加伊南是伍兹湖的奥吉布瓦语名称，被译为“沙丘间的内陆湖”。这座大湖位于雷尼河与温尼伯河之间，海湾和岛屿众多。数千年来，岩石湖岸和林木岛屿周围有人居住。原住民旅人利用湖水穿行于独木舟水道网络中，后来毛皮商人也沿此路线往来于五大湖和西部内陆。

english: Pikwitonei is the name of a river and lake in the forested country of northern Manitoba. The Cree name has been translated as broken mouth. The river flows north towards Natawahunan Lake and forms part of the Grass River system, which eventually joins the Nelson. Lakes, rocky ground and bogs mark the region, whose waterways provide routes through the boreal forest towards the larger rivers of the north.
simp_chinese: 皮克维托内是曼尼托巴北部森林地区一条河流和一座湖泊的名称。这个克里语地名被译为“破裂的口”。河水向北流往纳塔瓦胡南湖，属于最终汇入纳尔逊河的格拉斯河水系。这一地区遍布湖泊、岩地和泥沼，水道穿过寒带森林，通向北方更大的河流。

english:
Pilak is an ancient settlement in southern Tripura, where Hindu and Buddhist images were made among the hills and fields. Its remains include brick structures, terracotta plaques and large stone sculptures. Their subjects range from the Buddhist bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara to Hindu deities such as Narasimha, Ganesha and Surya.

The site flourished between roughly the eighth and twelfth centuries. Its moulded terracotta has affinities with work at Paharpur and Mainamati in Bengal, while the sculptures show several religious traditions sharing an artistic landscape. A large image of Avalokiteshvara belongs to the ninth century and a Narasimha image to the twelfth. These works reveal the links between Tripura and the cultural centres of eastern Bengal long before the later kingdom of the Manikya rulers.
simp_chinese:
皮拉克是特里普拉南部的古聚落，人们曾在山地和田野间制作印度教与佛教造像。遗存包括砖造建筑、陶饰板和大型石雕，题材从佛教菩萨观世音到印度教的那罗辛诃、象头神和太阳神都有。

这一遗址约在八至十二世纪繁盛。模制陶饰与孟加拉帕哈尔布尔及迈纳马蒂的作品相似，雕像则显示多种宗教传统共享同一艺术环境。大型观世音像属于九世纪，那罗辛诃像则属于十二世纪。这些作品揭示了玛尼基亚王朝后来的王国建立之前，特里普拉与东孟加拉文化中心之间的联系。

english: The Pilaya cuts through the eastern Andean foothills of southern Bolivia on its way toward the Pilcomayo. Forested slopes and deep valleys mark the transition from the highlands to the Chaco lowlands. Rivers descending through this country carry seasonal rains eastward, while the mountains divide one valley from the next. Guaraní communities inhabited parts of the eastern foothills, where Spanish colonial expansion encountered sustained resistance.
simp_chinese: 皮拉亚河穿过玻利维亚南部安第斯山东麓，流向皮尔科马约河。森林覆盖的坡地和深谷标志着高地向查科低地的过渡。河流将季节性雨水向东输送，群山则将谷地彼此分隔。瓜拉尼社群居住在东部山麓的一些地区，西班牙殖民扩张在此遭遇持续抵抗。

english: The Pilda is formed by two headstreams in the mountains north of the lower Amur and flows east to Lake Udyl. Its upper valley passes between hills covered with larch and spruce; downstream the river enters the lake's lowland. People of the Pilda called themselves Pulza, a name derived from the river, and their traditions linked their origins to the Udihe. The lake connects their river country to the Amur through the Ukhta channel.
simp_chinese: 皮尔达河由黑龙江下游以北山地中的两条源流汇合而成，向东流入乌第尔湖。上游谷地穿过长有落叶松和云杉的丘陵，下游进入湖畔低地。皮尔达河的居民以河名自称“普尔扎”，他们的传统将自身起源与乌德盖人联系起来。乌第尔湖通过乌赫塔水道通往黑龙江。

english: Piletisipuk lies near the wooded valleys of the Manicouagan and Toulnustouc rivers. The Toulnustouc flows into the Manicouagan, which descends south to the St. Lawrence estuary. The rivers cross the rocky Canadian Shield, where lakes and rapids break the long route between the interior and the coast.
simp_chinese: 皮莱蒂西普克位于马尼夸根河与图尔努斯图克河附近的林木河谷。图尔努斯图克河汇入马尼夸根河，后者向南流入圣劳伦斯河口。河流穿过岩石构成的加拿大地盾，湖泊与急流分布在内陆通往海岸的漫长水路上。

english:
Pilibhit lies on the plain of Rohilkhand near the forested foothills of the Himalayas. Streams cross the low ground, while the country to the north leads towards Nepal. The town was also known as Hafizabad after the Rohilla leader Hafiz Rahmat Khan, before taking its name from a nearby village.

In 1734 Ali Mohammed Khan built four gates around the local administrative buildings, named for Bareilly, Hussain, Jahanabad and the southern approach. He also built a congregational mosque. Pilibhit later offered refuge to a king of Doti driven from Nepal by Gorkhali forces in 1789; Faizullah Khan of Rampur arranged his safe shelter. The town thus stood close to both the Rohilla centres of the plain and the hill kingdoms beyond it.
simp_chinese:
皮利比希特位于罗希尔坎德平原，靠近林木茂密的喜马拉雅山麓。溪流穿过低地，向北则通往尼泊尔。城镇曾以罗希拉领袖哈菲兹·拉赫马特汗之名称为哈菲扎巴德，后来采用附近村庄的名字。

1734年，阿里·穆罕默德汗在行政建筑周围修建四座城门，分别以巴雷利、侯赛因、贾汉纳巴德和南方入口命名，并建造聚礼清真寺。1789年，一位多蒂国王被廓尔喀军队赶出尼泊尔，兰普尔的法伊祖拉汗安排他在皮利比希特避难。城镇既接近平原上的罗希拉中心，也靠近山地诸国。

english: Pillahuinco is the name of a stream and surrounding country in the southern pampas, near the low hills of the same name. The stream winds across the grasslands towards the Quequén Salado basin. Indigenous communities occupied the region and gathered for meetings beside its waters; the plains also lay within a frontier contested by the authorities of Buenos Aires. The name refers to plants growing in wet ground beside the stream.
simp_chinese: 皮拉温科是潘帕斯南部一条溪流及周围地区的名称，附近有同名低丘。溪流蜿蜒穿过草原，流向克肯萨拉多河流域。原住民社群居住于此，并曾在水边集会；平原也处在布宜诺斯艾利斯当局争夺的边境。地名指的是溪边湿地生长的植物。

english:
The Pilón valley lies east of the Sierra Madre Oriental, where the Pilón River crosses the foothills of northeastern Mexico. Its land and water attracted Spanish settlement in the seventeenth century, although Indigenous peoples already lived in the surrounding country. The valley linked mountain routes with the lowlands of the Nuevo Reino de León.

In 1637 the governor granted land in the valley to Alonso de León. A house and chapel were built at Pilón Viejo, and in 1665 his son established the hacienda of Nuestra Señora de Regla beside the river. The settlement that grew around it later became Montemorelos. A church dedicated to San Mateo preserves the older name of the valley. The hacienda became a focus for further settlement along the river.
simp_chinese:
皮隆谷地位于东马德雷山脉以东，皮隆河穿过墨西哥东北部山麓。十七世纪，土地和水源吸引西班牙定居者，但周围地区早已有人居住。山谷将山地路线与新莱昂王国低地联系起来。

1637年，总督将谷地土地授予阿隆索·德·莱昂。他在旧皮隆建立住宅和小礼拜堂；1665年，其子又在河畔建立雷格拉圣母庄园。周围发展出的聚落后来成为蒙特马雷洛斯。供奉圣马太的教堂保留了山谷的旧名。 庄园成为沿河进一步定居的中心。

english: Pilot Rock rises from the Pacific near Guadalupe Island, far west of the Baja California Peninsula. The island itself is volcanic, with steep slopes exposed to the ocean winds. Sebastián Vizcaíno's expedition sighted it in 1602, but it remained remote from permanent settlement. In the early nineteenth century seal hunters and whalers began to visit, seeking animals for their skins and oil. Their ships found an isolated landmark in a wide expanse of sea.
simp_chinese: 派洛特岩耸立于瓜达卢佩岛附近的太平洋水面，远在下加利福尼亚半岛以西。瓜达卢佩是一座火山岛，陡峭山坡面对海风。塞瓦斯蒂安·比斯开诺的远征队于1602年望见此岛，但这里远离长期聚落。十九世纪初，海豹猎人与捕鲸船开始到访，寻求兽皮和油脂。这座岛屿是辽阔海面上的孤立地标。

english:
Piltene stands on the Venta in Courland, where its castle became a seat of the bishops of Courland. Their scattered lands formed an ecclesiastical territory distinct from the neighbouring possessions of the Livonian Order. The bishopric's fate changed during the wars that broke apart the old Livonian Confederation.

In 1560 its lands were sold to the Danish king, who assigned them to his brother Magnus. After Magnus died, Denmark sold the territory to Poland–Lithuania in 1585, giving the Commonwealth a foothold in the former bishopric. The district of Piltene retained a distinct history even as it became closely associated with the dukes of Courland. Swedish and Russian armies occupied it during the Great Northern War; in 1795 its assembly accepted incorporation into the Russian Empire.
simp_chinese:
皮尔泰内位于库尔兰的文塔河畔，当地城堡曾是库尔兰主教的驻地。主教零散的领地构成一个教会辖区，与邻近利沃尼亚骑士团的领地各自分立。打碎利沃尼亚旧联邦的战争改变了主教区的命运。

1560年，主教区土地被售予丹麦国王，国王将其交给弟弟马格努斯。马格努斯去世后，丹麦于1585年将领地出售给波兰立陶宛，联邦由此在旧主教区取得立足点。皮尔泰内地区虽日益与库尔兰公爵密切相连，仍保有独特的历史。大北方战争期间，瑞典和俄国军队曾占领此地；1795年，当地议会接受并入俄罗斯帝国。

english: Pilzno lies in Lesser Poland, in the valley of the Wisłoka. On 3 October 1354 King Casimir the Great authorised the knight Dobiesław to establish a town here under German law. A market square and streets were laid out around the earlier market settlement, and earthen defences enclosed its centre. Pilzno became a royal town and a district centre in Sandomierz Voivodeship. Its position on a trade route helped its development; a royal privilege of 1577 required merchants travelling towards Lviv not to bypass the town. The defences gradually lost their military importance during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, as residents put parts of them to other uses.
simp_chinese: 皮尔兹诺位于小波兰的维斯沃卡河谷。1354年10月3日，卡齐米日大帝授权骑士多别斯瓦夫在此按德意志法设立城镇。早先的集市聚落中心划出广场及街道，周围修筑土防御工事。皮尔兹诺成为王室城镇和桑多梅日省的县治，贸易道路上的位置有助于其发展。1577年的王室特权规定，前往利沃夫的商人不得绕过此地。十七至十八世纪，防御工事逐渐失去军事作用，居民将其中部分地段改作其他用途。

english: The Andean mountains of southern Colombia rise between the Patía valley and the Pacific lowlands. Steep slopes carry forests that receive moisture from the ocean, while rivers cut deep valleys through the ranges toward the coast. Higher ground gives way to cooler mountain vegetation. The mountains form a rugged divide between the inhabited valleys of the interior and the humid river country of the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 哥伦比亚南部安第斯山地耸立在帕蒂亚河谷与太平洋低地之间。陡坡上的森林受到海洋湿气滋养，河流切穿群山形成深谷，流向海岸。高处逐渐过渡为较凉爽的山地植被。群山在内陆有人居住的谷地与太平洋湿润河流地区之间形成崎岖分界。

english: Pimicaskewyashik lies north of the North Saskatchewan River, near the country once served by Fort Pitt. In the winter of 1829–30 John Rowand established the Hudson's Bay Company post on the river to supply travellers. Cree, Assiniboine and Blackfoot people came there to trade, bringing bison products and other provisions. The post stood between the company's establishments farther east and west along the river.
simp_chinese: 皮米卡斯凯维亚希克位于北萨斯喀彻温河以北，靠近匹特堡曾服务的地区。1829至1830年冬，约翰·罗万在河畔建立哈得孙湾公司据点，为旅行者提供补给。克里人、阿西尼博因人和黑脚人带来野牛制品及其他物资，在此交易。这个据点位于公司沿河更东与更西的各站之间。

english:
Pimpu lies near Kamina in the country of the upper Lomami. The Lomami rises near Kamina, close to the Congo–Zambezi watershed, and runs north past Lubao and Tshofa. Unlike the south-flowing Zambezi, its waters eventually reach the Congo at Isangi.

The later city of Kamina lies here.
simp_chinese:
平普位于卡米纳附近的洛马米河上游地区。洛马米河发源于卡米纳附近，靠近刚果河与赞比西河的分水岭，向北流经卢鲍和乔法。与向南流去的赞比西河不同，它的水最终在伊桑吉注入刚果河。

后来的卡米纳即位于此地。

english: The Santa Ynez River flows through the mountain country of the Chumash. On Tequepis Creek near its junction with the river stood the Chumash village of Teqepsh. Spanish missionaries founded Santa Inés in the valley in 1804, drawing Chumash people into the mission system. In 1824 a revolt began at Santa Inés after the whipping of a Chumash worker and spread to neighboring missions, a determined act of resistance to colonial rule.
simp_chinese: 圣伊内斯河流经丘马什人的山地。在特克皮斯溪与河流汇合处附近，曾有丘马什村落特克普什。1804年，西班牙传教士在河谷建立圣伊内斯传教所，将丘马什人纳入传教所制度。1824年，一名丘马什工人遭鞭打后，圣伊内斯爆发起义，并蔓延至邻近传教所，成为反抗殖民统治的一次坚决行动。

sources.title: MEA Guidelines for Tribal Cultural Resources & Appendices.pdf

english: Pina de Ebro stands on the Ebro downstream from Zaragoza. Its lands belonged to the monastery of Veruela in the fifteenth century, and the town later formed the centre of a lordship that included several neighbouring villages. In 1530 Blasco de Alagón, Count of Sástago, founded a Franciscan convent here; its buildings incorporated an earlier Mudéjar church and were completed in 1539.
simp_chinese: 埃布罗河畔皮纳位于萨拉戈萨下游。15世纪，当地土地属于韦鲁埃拉修道院；后来城镇成为领地中心，管辖周边数个村庄。1530年，萨斯塔戈伯爵布拉斯科·德·阿拉贡在此创建方济各会修院，其建筑利用了一座更早的穆德哈尔式教堂，并于1539年完工。

english: The Pinanaca lived in the dry country of Coahuila and ranged north across the Rio Grande toward the southern edge of the Edwards Plateau. Spanish sources recorded their name in several forms, including Pinanca and Piranaca. In 1674 a gathering brought Pinanaca and Tiltiqmaya people together on the southern Texas plains. By 1687 the Pinanaca were associated with Cabezas and other communities of southern Coahuila, while a 1693 list placed them among peoples of western Coahuila and eastern Chihuahua.
simp_chinese: 皮纳纳卡人生活在科阿韦拉的干旱地区，活动范围向北越过格兰德河，抵达爱德华兹高原南缘。西班牙文献以多种形式记录他们的名称，包括皮南卡和皮拉纳卡。1674年，皮纳纳卡人与蒂尔蒂克马亚人在得克萨斯南部平原举行聚会。到1687年，皮纳纳卡人与科阿韦拉南部的卡贝萨斯等社群有所联系；1693年的一份名单则将他们列在科阿韦拉西部和奇瓦瓦东部的民族之中。

english: Píñar lies north of Granada beneath the remains of a castle that formed part of the Nasrid kingdom’s frontier defences. Its walls occupied a commanding height above the settlement. In 1485 the fall of nearby fortresses broke the defensive line, and Píñar came under Christian control during the war against Granada. The castle was subsequently abandoned as settlement in the region was reorganised.
simp_chinese: 皮尼亚尔位于格拉纳达以北，纳斯里德王国边境防御体系中的城堡遗迹俯瞰着聚落。城墙占据高地，居高临下。1485年，附近要塞失陷，防线被突破；在征服格拉纳达的战争中，皮尼亚尔归于基督徒控制。此后随着地区聚落重新组织，城堡逐渐被废弃。

english: Piñas Bay lies on the Pacific coast of Darién, south of the Gulf of San Miguel. Rivers descend from the forested interior to the shore, including the Piñas River, which reaches the sea near the bay. The coast faces the open Pacific, while the mountainous country inland is crossed by river valleys and covered by tropical forest. Its waters provide fishing grounds along this remote shore.
simp_chinese: 皮尼亚斯湾位于达连太平洋海岸、圣米格尔湾以南。河流从森林覆盖的内陆流向海岸，其中皮尼亚斯河在海湾附近入海。海岸面向开阔的太平洋，内陆山区则被河谷切割，覆盖着热带森林。这片偏远海岸附近的水域是渔场。

english: Pindale lies in the dry country of central Burma, north of Meiktila and west of the irrigated Kyaukse plain. The surrounding land is part of the interior basin between the Irrawaddy and the Shan hills. Villages and fields occupy the open plain, where seasonal rains contrast with long dry months. To the south, Meiktila Lake has long supplied water to the surrounding country; farther northeast the old settlements of Pinle and Myinsaing belonged to another of Upper Burma's cultivated districts.
simp_chinese: 彬达莱位于缅甸中部干燥地带，在密铁拉以北、皎施灌溉平原以西。周围土地属于伊洛瓦底江与掸邦山地之间的内陆盆地。村落和田野分布在开阔平原上，季节性降雨与漫长的旱季形成鲜明对比。南面的密铁拉湖长期为周边地区供水；更东北方的彬莱与敏象古城则位于上缅甸另一片耕作地区。

english: Pindi Bhattian lies in the Rachna Doab, between the Ravi and Chenab rivers. The doab's name was formed under Akbar from the names of the two rivers. The town is remembered as the birthplace of Dulla Bhatti, a hero of Punjabi folk songs, who is said to have led a rebellion against Mughal rule in Akbar's reign.
