simp_chinese: 宾迪珀蒂扬位于拉维河与杰纳布河之间的雷杰纳河间地。河间地的名字在阿克巴统治时期取两河名称组成。此城被认为是旁遮普民歌英雄杜拉·珀蒂的出生地；相传他在阿克巴在位时领导了一场反抗莫卧儿统治的起事。

english: Pindi Gheb lies in the western Pothohar country of Punjab. It was founded by the Jodhra Maliks in the thirteenth century and became their ancestral home. The town was once called Pindi Malika-i-Shahryar or Malika-i-Auliya, the “queen of the saints”; its later name comes from the Gheba tribe of Jats.
simp_chinese: 宾迪凯布位于旁遮普波托哈尔西部，由乔德拉马利克家族于十三世纪建立，成为他们的祖居之地。城镇曾称作宾迪马利卡沙赫里亚尔或马利卡奥利亚，后者意为“圣徒的女王”；后来的名字则来自贾特人的盖巴部族。

english: Pindiga is associated with Jukun settlement in the savanna country to the north of the Benue. In 1815 Buba Yero, the ruler of Gombe, began a campaign against the Jukun of the area. Fighting continued beyond his lifetime, and traditions recall survivors taking refuge on rocky heights before moving to another rock near Pindiga.
simp_chinese: 平迪加与贝努埃河以北草原地区的朱昆人定居史相联系。1815年，贡贝统治者布巴·耶罗开始征讨当地朱昆人，战事在他去世后仍在继续。当地传说记载，幸存者躲到岩石高地避难，后来又迁至平迪加附近的另一座岩丘。

english: In the western Macedonian highlands, the Šar Mountains stretch above the Polog valley in a long sweep of ridges and high pastures. Their forests include beech and oak on the lower slopes, with conifers and open grassland higher up. To the west the mountains approach the Korab massif, while rivers descend into the valleys below. These ranges form part of the rugged mountain country that separates the interior of the Balkans from the Adriatic lowlands.
simp_chinese: 在马其顿西部高地，沙尔山脉横亘在波洛格河谷上方，山脊与高处牧场绵延起伏。低坡的森林中有山毛榉和橡树，较高处则有针叶林与开阔草地。西面群山接近科拉布山地，河流从坡间流向下方谷地。这些山脉构成巴尔干崎岖山地的一部分，将内陆与亚得里亚海低地分隔开来。

english: East of the Eordaia basin, the Vermio range rises between the inland lakes and the plains of Naousa and Veroia. Its northern foothills reach Lake Vegoritida, while the Aliakmonas separates it from the Pieria mountains to the south. A broad wooded valley divides the range, and beech forests grow towards the upper forest line. Limestone and schist form much of the mountain, whose ridges stand above the cultivated country on either side.
simp_chinese: 在埃奥尔代亚盆地以东，韦尔米奥山脉耸立于内陆湖泊与瑙萨、韦里亚平原之间。北麓延伸到韦戈里蒂达湖，南面则以阿利亚克蒙河与皮埃里亚山相隔。宽阔的林谷将山脉分开，靠近森林上界的地方生长着山毛榉。石灰岩和片岩构成山体的大部分，山脊高出两侧的耕地。

english: The mountains of Agrafa form the southern end of the Pindus, a country of steep peaks, deep ravines and thick forests. Fir, oak and chestnut grow on the slopes, while high pastures and bare ridges rise above the trees. Rivers cut through the mountains towards the Acheloos, and stone bridges cross some of their narrow valleys. The summits of Voutsikaki and Avgo rise above two thousand metres in this rugged highland.
simp_chinese: 阿格拉法群山构成品都斯山脉的南端，这里山峰陡峭、峡谷深切，森林茂密。冷杉、橡树和栗树生长在山坡上，高处牧场与裸露山脊则高出林木。河流切穿群山，流向阿谢洛奥斯河，石桥横跨其中一些狭窄河谷。沃齐卡基和阿夫戈等山峰耸立在崎岖的高地上，海拔超过两千米。

english: North of Nafpaktos, mountains and gorges rise towards Vardousia and the interior of central Greece. Oak, fir, beech, plane and chestnut trees cover the slopes of mountainous Nafpaktia, broken by high pastures and paths used by herders. To the east the Vardousia massif rises above the Mornos valley, its great fir forests giving way to steep peaks. The rivers and ravines make this a landscape of many separate valleys.
simp_chinese: 纳夫帕克托斯以北，群山与峡谷向瓦尔杜西亚山和希腊中部内陆延伸。纳夫帕克蒂亚山区的坡地上生长着橡树、冷杉、山毛榉、悬铃木和栗树，其间分布着高山牧场和牧人小径。东面的瓦尔杜西亚山块高出莫尔诺斯河谷，大片冷杉林之上是陡峭山峰。河流与深谷将这片山地切分成许多独立的谷地。

english:
The Pindus mountain world forms part of the rugged backbone of the western Balkans, where ridges and valleys connect regions with very different climates and resources. Upland pasture supports seasonal herding, while lower slopes and valleys offer cultivation, woodland products, and market settlements. Paths through passes allow movement where broad roads are difficult to maintain. Local knowledge of snow, weather, and safe routes is essential to journeys across this terrain.

Across the wider Pindus, seasonal herding linked mountain communities with lower pastures. At Metsovo, a Vlach-speaking community guarded an important mountain passage; in 1659 Sultan Mehmed IV granted its residents fiscal and political privileges for that service. Metsovo also maintained trading connections across the Ottoman world.
simp_chinese:
品都斯山地属于巴尔干西部崎岖主干，山脊河谷联系气候资源差异明显的地区。高地牧场支持季节放牧，低坡谷地提供耕作、林产和市场。山口小径在宽路难以维护处保障移动，雪、天气和安全路线知识是旅程基础。

在更广阔的品都斯山区，季节放牧将山地社群与低地牧场联系起来。梅措沃的弗拉赫语社群守护一处重要山口；1659年，苏丹穆罕默德四世因这项服务授予居民赋税和政治特权。梅措沃还与奥斯曼世界各地保持商业联系。

english: North of the Pelagonian plain, the mountains of Dautica and Babuna rise between Prilep and the valley of the Vardar. Their ridges and intervening valleys form the northern edge of a broad basin that also contains the fields around Bitola. Streams from the surrounding highlands feed the Crna River and its tributaries, while the hills give way to the more open land of the plain. The mountain routes connect Pelagonia with the country farther north.
simp_chinese: 佩拉戈尼亚平原以北，道蒂察山与巴布纳山耸立在普里莱普和瓦尔达尔河谷之间。山脊与其间的谷地构成宽阔盆地的北缘，盆地南部还包括比托拉周围的田野。周边高地的溪流汇入茨尔纳河及其支流，丘陵则逐渐过渡为更开阔的平原。山间道路将佩拉戈尼亚与更北方的地区连接起来。

english: Between the plain of Pelagonia and the Prespa basin rises Baba Mountain, crowned by the peak of Pelister. Its steep slopes carry forests of beech and Macedonian pine, while the high ground preserves traces of ancient glaciers. Long streams of broken rock descend the mountainside, and water collects in high glacial lakes. From the slopes, the land falls east toward Bitola and west toward the waters and villages of Prespa.
simp_chinese: 巴巴山耸立在佩拉戈尼亚平原与普雷斯帕盆地之间，山顶是佩利斯特峰。陡坡上生长着山毛榉与马其顿松，高处则保存着古代冰川的痕迹。长长的碎石流沿山坡下降，积水汇成高山冰川湖。从山坡向东，地势降向比托拉；向西则通往普雷斯帕的湖水与村庄。

english: Between the basins of Prespa and Kastoria lies a country of wooded mountains and small upland settlements. Eastward, the Verno range rises to the summit of Vitsi, separating the country around Kastoria from the plain of Florina. Beech and oak grow on the mountain slopes near Prespa, where bears and wolves find shelter. From the heights, the two Prespa lakes and the neighbouring Varnous range can be seen across the rugged landscape.
simp_chinese: 在普雷斯帕与卡斯托里亚盆地之间，林木覆盖的群山环绕着高地小聚落。东面的韦尔诺山脉高耸至维齐峰，将卡斯托里亚附近的地区与弗洛里纳平原分隔开来。普雷斯帕附近的山坡上生长着山毛榉与橡树，熊和狼在林中栖息。站在高处，可以越过崎岖的山地望见两座普雷斯帕湖与附近的瓦尔努斯山脉。

english: The northern Pindus rises in a succession of steep peaks, deep gorges and wooded slopes. Mount Smolikas reaches 2,637 metres above the valleys of the Aoos and its tributaries, while nearby Tymfi is cut by the Vikos and Aoos gorges. Much of Smolikas and the neighbouring ridges consists of ancient oceanic rock, raised into mountains. Black and Bosnian pines grow on these soils, giving way to high ground above the forests.
simp_chinese: 品都斯山脉北段峰峦陡峭，深谷与森林覆盖的山坡交错。斯莫利卡斯山高达2637米，耸立在阿奥斯河及其支流的河谷之上；附近的廷菲山则被维科斯峡谷与阿奥斯峡谷切开。斯莫利卡斯和邻近山脊的许多岩石原本属于古老的海洋地壳，后来隆起为群山。黑松与波斯尼亚松生长在山坡上，林带之上则是高山地带。

english: The Athamanika mountains, also called Tzoumerka, rise between Epirus and Thessaly in the Pindus range. Streams descend from their steep folds to the Arachthos in the west and the Acheloos in the east. Dense fir forests cover the slopes, giving way to bare high ridges and peaks such as Kakarditsa. Brown bears and wild goats shelter in this rugged country, where gorges cut deep between the mountains and the river valleys.
simp_chinese: 阿萨马尼卡山又称祖梅尔卡山，属于品都斯山脉，耸立在伊庇鲁斯与色萨利之间。溪流沿陡峭山坳而下，汇入西面的阿拉赫索斯河和东面的阿谢洛奥斯河。茂密的冷杉林覆盖山坡，林线上方是裸露山脊和卡卡尔迪察等高峰。棕熊与野山羊栖息在崎岖山地中，深峡谷切开群山与河谷之间的土地。

english: East of the Pelagonian plain, the mountains of Selečka and Nidže rise beyond the fields of Prilep and Bitola. Their slopes help enclose a broad basin drained by the Crna River and its tributaries. Farther south, the high ridge of Nidže reaches Kajmakčalan, more than two thousand meters above sea level. The contrast between the open plain and the surrounding mountains gives Pelagonia its distinctive outline in the landscape of Macedonia.
simp_chinese: 佩拉戈尼亚平原以东，塞莱奇卡山和尼杰山耸立在普里莱普与比托拉的田野之外。山坡围绕着宽阔的盆地，茨尔纳河及其支流为盆地排水。更南面，尼杰山高脊抵达海拔两千多米的凯马克恰兰峰。开阔平原与四周群山形成鲜明对比，使佩拉戈尼亚在马其顿地貌中拥有独特轮廓。

english: North of Lake Vegoritida rise the high ridges of Voras, also known as Nidže. The lake and the Arnissa pass separate this massif from the Vermio range to the southeast. Dense woodland covers parts of the slopes, including the Black Forest above Orma, while the higher ground reaches towards the snowy summit of Kaimaktsalan. Black pine grows among the mountain forests, which shelter animals including the brown bear.
simp_chinese: 韦戈里蒂达湖以北，沃拉斯山的高峻山脊拔地而起；这片山地也称尼杰。湖泊与阿尔尼萨山口将它与东南面的韦尔米奥山脉分开。山坡上部分地区覆盖着茂密林木，奥尔马上方便有黑森林；更高处的山岭通向积雪的凯马克察兰峰。山林中生长着黑松，也是棕熊等动物的栖息地。

english:
Pinega lies in the forested river country of northern Russia. Near the settlement, a portage linked the Pinega waterway with the Sotka and Kuloy rivers, connecting routes toward the White Sea with the Northern Dvina basin.

The route appears in historical records and maps of the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries. By the early seventeenth century the settlement was known as Pinezhsky Volok, after the portage. In 1780 it became the district town of Pinega.
simp_chinese:
皮涅加位于俄罗斯北部森林河流地带。聚落附近的陆上搬运道将皮涅加河与索特卡河、库洛伊河水系相连，沟通北德维纳河流域和通往白海的道路。

这一搬运道见于16至18世纪的记载和地图。到17世纪初，当地聚落以搬运道为名，称为皮涅日斯基沃洛克。1780年，它成为皮涅加县城。

english:
Pinerolo lies on the Chisone southwest of Turin, where routes from the Alpine valleys reach the Piedmontese plain. Recorded in a grant of 981, it became a commune in the thirteenth century and a principal fortress of the House of Savoy. Its position also made it a target for French armies crossing the mountains.

The counts of Savoy had exercised a protectorate over Pinerolo from the thirteenth century. France captured Pinerolo in 1536 and held it until 1574. The Treaty of Cherasco returned the town to France in 1631, giving the French a stronghold on the Italian side of the Alps. Under the Treaty of Turin in 1696, France agreed to return it to Savoy, on condition that the fortifications be demolished and Savoy leave the League of Augsburg.
simp_chinese:
皮内罗洛位于都灵西南的基索内河畔，阿尔卑斯河谷的道路在此抵达皮埃蒙特平原。981年的赠地文书已有关于此地的记载；十三世纪，它成为公社和萨伏依家族的主要要塞。这里的位置也使它成为翻山而来的法国军队的目标。

自十三世纪起，萨伏依伯爵便对皮内罗洛行使保护权。法国于1536年夺取此城，直到1574年才放弃控制。1631年的凯拉斯科条约又将城镇交给法国，使法国在阿尔卑斯山意大利一侧获得据点。根据1696年的都灵条约，法国同意将它归还萨伏依，条件是拆毁防御工事，并要求萨伏依退出奥格斯堡同盟。

english: Píngbà lies on the Guizhou plateau west of Guiyang, where a broad basin breaks the surrounding hills. The Ming established Píngbà Guard here in 1390 as part of the military network securing the route into the southwest. Soldiers and their families cultivated land around fortified settlements, combining garrison duties with farming. Their descendants preserved distinctive Tunpu communities, whose fortified villages and traditions recall the long association between military settlement and the cultivation of the plateau.
simp_chinese: 平坝位于贵阳以西的贵州高原，周围丘陵之间展开一片宽阔坝子。明洪武二十三年（1390年）设平坝卫，成为保障西南通路的军事建置之一。军士及其家属在堡寨周围屯田，将戍守与耕作结合。后代形成了富有特色的屯堡社群，寨堡和风俗保存着军事移民在高原垦殖的记忆。

english: Pingchuan lies among the mountains of Yanyuan, west of the Anning River valley. In the Yuan period this wider country came under Baixing prefecture, centred on the salt-producing district of Runyan. Under the Ming and Qing, hereditary local chiefs governed much of the mountainous land beyond the main garrisons and market towns. The territory of the Gubaishu chief included much of the country around Pingchuan.
simp_chinese: 平川位于安宁河谷以西的盐源山区。元代这一带属于柏兴府，府治设在产盐的闰盐。明清时期，主要卫城和市镇之外的大部分山区由世袭土司管理；古柏树土司的领地包括平川周围的大部分地区。

english: Pingdi lies on the grassland north of Daihai, in the wider country of Jining. The Yuan circuit of Jining had its seat in this region, where a walled settlement stood near Huangqi Lake. An inscription set up in 1312 records its Confucian temple, evidence of the institutions established in a town that linked the northern plateau with the settled lands to the south.
simp_chinese: 平地位于岱海以北的草原，属于济宁一带。元代集宁路的治所就在这一地区，城址靠近黄旗海。1312年所立的庙学碑记载了当地孔庙，见证了这座连接北方高原与南方聚落的城镇所设立的文教机构。

english: Pingdian lay in the upland country of central Yunnan, among the settlements later governed from Xi'e. The Yuan established Pingdian as a county under Xi'e Prefecture, alongside neighbouring Qiongchuan. In 1289 Xi'e itself was reduced to county status and both smaller counties were absorbed into it as townships. Their names nevertheless preserved an older pattern of local administration, formed when the newly established Yuan government organised this mountainous country into separate jurisdictions.
simp_chinese: 平甸位于云南中部高地，属于后来由嶍峨治理的乡土。元代在此设平甸县，与邻近的邛川同属嶍峨州。1289年，嶍峨降为县，平甸和邛川都并入其中，改为乡。地名仍保留着较早行政格局的痕迹，那是元朝在山地中设置多个辖区的时期。

english: Pingding stands on the western side of the Taihang Mountains, with Guanshan rising southwest of the old town. In 979 the Song renamed the county Pingding and moved its seat to Yuguan, where walls were extended around the settlement. An academy on Guanshan was repaired in 1498 by the Ming official Wu Xian. Far to the northeast, the passes of Panshi and Weize guarded a mountain route also known as Niangzi Pass.
simp_chinese: 平定位于太行山西侧，古城西南方耸立着冠山。979年，宋朝将广阳县改名平定，并将县治迁至榆关，又扩筑城墙。1498年，明朝知州吴贤重修了冠山上的书院。远在东北方的盘石、苇泽两关守卫着穿越山脉的道路，这一关隘也被称为娘子关。

english: The name Pingdi Songlin means a pine forest on level ground, a striking feature of the grassland country north of the Great Wall. Historical accounts describe such forests in the upper reaches of the Xar Moron and near the Yuan summer capital of Shangdu. The Khitan emperors visited a region called Pingdi Songlin, and stretches of pine woodland remained in the area into the Qing period. Trees on the open plain gave this landscape a distinctive character.
simp_chinese: 平地松林之名描绘了长城以北草原上颇为醒目的景象：松树生长在开阔平地。史籍记载，西拉木伦河上游及元代夏都上都附近都曾有这样的松林。辽代皇帝曾巡幸称为平地松林的地方，这一地区的松林到清代仍有留存。

english: Pinggu lies east of Beijing, where the North China Plain meets the hills of the Yan Mountains. The county was briefly absorbed into neighbouring Yuyang under the early Yuan, then restored and placed under Jizhou, an arrangement continued by the Ming. In 1679 a powerful earthquake struck the wider region around Pinggu, damaging settlements across the plain and foothills.
simp_chinese: 平谷位于北京以东，华北平原在此接近燕山丘陵。元初平谷曾短暂并入渔阳县，随后复置，隶属蓟州，明代沿袭。清康熙十八年（1679年），平谷一带发生强烈地震，平原与山麓的聚落遭受破坏。

english: Pínghé lies among the wooded mountains of southern Fújiàn, where the old boundaries of Nánjìng, Zhāngpǔ, and Lóngxī met. In 1518 the Míng official and philosopher Wáng Yángmíng petitioned to establish a county here after military campaigns in the region. Its name expressed the hope that conflict would be pacified and the people live in harmony.
simp_chinese: 平和位于福建南部林木繁茂的山地，旧时南靖、漳浦和龙溪在此交界。明正德十三年（1518年），官员兼思想家王阳明在当地用兵后奏请设县，取名“平和”，寄望战事平息、百姓和睦。

english: Pingji was an old county seat on the Hebei plain, later known as Zhaozhou. Its Bailin Monastery honours the Chan master Congshen, remembered as Zhaozhou Chan Master. A brick pagoda raised in his honour in 1330 preserved his memory under the Yuan. The monastery continued to receive attention in later centuries, and its Heavenly Kings and Vajra halls were rebuilt in 1503 during the Ming dynasty.
simp_chinese: 平棘是河北平原上的古县治，后来称为赵州。当地柏林寺纪念禅师从谂，世称赵州禅师。元代的1330年，寺中为他建起一座砖塔；此后寺院仍受重视，明代1503年重建了天王殿和金刚殿。

english:
Pingjiang lies in northeastern Hunan, within the river country connected to Yuezhou and the Dongting Lake region. Hills, cultivated valleys, and waterways gave local communities a setting in which agriculture depended on careful use of uneven land. Rice growing in suitable low ground could be combined with upland crops, woodland products, and household crafts, while market routes linked villages with the larger commercial world of the middle Yangtze.

The county was called Changjiang under the Tang and received the name Pingjiang during the Later Tang. It was raised to a prefecture under the Yuan, then returned to county status under the Ming, when it belonged to Yuezhou prefecture. The Miluo River flows west across the district toward Dongting Lake, linking its hill country with the wider lake basin.
simp_chinese:
平江位于湖南东北部，属于联系岳州和洞庭湖地区的河流乡土。丘陵、耕作谷地与水道，为地方社群提供依赖细致土地利用的农业环境。适宜低地种植水稻，山地作物、林产和家庭手工业则补充生计；市场路线把村落同长江中游更大的商业世界连接起来。山水格局同时影响生产和交通。

唐代此地称昌江县，后唐时改名平江。元代升为州，明代恢复县制，属岳州府。汨罗江横贯县境向西流去，通往洞庭湖，将山地与更广阔的湖区联系起来。

english:
Tàiyuán, home to the holy site of Jìn Temple, has been one of the most important cities in Shānxī and northern China since the 5th century BC. In 979, Emperor Tàizōng of Sòng ordered the ancient city of Jìnyáng to be flooded and destroyed upon the conquest of Northern Hàn, and then renamed it the County of Píngjìn (lit. 'Pacification of Shānxī'), a disaster from which the city took a long time to recover.

The city rebuilt by the Sòng was battered again when the Jīn overthrew the Northern Sòng and again when the Mongols overthrew the Jīn, and it was the Míng who restored it on a grand scale. Zhū Yuánzhāng made his third son, Zhū Gāng, Prince of Jìn and seated him here, and in 1376 the prince's father-in-law Xiè Chéng pushed the walls out to the east, south and north, the Fén River blocking the west, until the princely palace lay inside a city three times the size of the Sòng town. Between 1381 and 1391 the prince enlarged the Chóngshàn Temple in memory of his mother, Empress Mǎ, making it the greatest monastery in Shānxī, with nearly a thousand halls.

The princely city did not survive the fall of the Míng. In 1644 the defenders burned the southern suburb to hold off Lǐ Zìchéng's army, the Qīng took Tàiyuán that September, and in 1646 a fire in the old Jìn palace left the north and east of the city in ashes. Under the Qīng, trade and people gathered in the south, and Tàiyuán never regained its Míng size.
simp_chinese:
太原，古称晋阳，因晋祠圣地而闻名遐迩。自公元前5世纪起，一直是山西乃至中国北方的战略重镇。公元979年，宋太宗征服北汉后，采取水淹和焚毁的手段摧毁了古城，随后改设“平晋县”（寓意“平定山西”）。此后，经过漫长的岁月，城池才得以重建，重现往日的繁华。

宋代重建的太原城，在金灭北宋、元灭金的两次战乱中又遭重创，把它大规模重建起来的是明朝。朱元璋封第三子朱棡为晋王，坐镇太原；1376年，晋王的岳父谢成把城墙向东、南、北三面拓展，西面因有汾河阻隔未能扩建，最终把晋王府包进城中，城区比宋代太原城扩大了三倍。1381至1391年，晋王为纪念母亲马皇后扩建崇善寺，殿宇近千间，规模居山西之首。

这座王府之城没能熬过明朝的覆亡。1644年守军焚烧南关城以抵御李自成的大军，同年9月清军攻陷太原，1646年晋王府又起大火，城北和城东化为焦土。清代商业和居民都聚集到城南，太原再也没有恢复明代的规模。

english: Pingle stands where the Li, Li tributary and Gongcheng rivers meet to form the Gui River. From here the waterway continues south toward Wuzhou and the Pearl River, while the Li leads north toward Guilin and the Ling Canal. Pingle was raised to a prefecture under the Yuan, a status retained by the Ming. Its officials governed a district of river valleys and mountains in which imperial administration, local communities and military campaigns all shaped the history of the region.
simp_chinese: 平乐位于漓江、荔江与恭城河交汇之处，三水合为桂江。水路向南通往梧州与珠江，向北沿漓江可至桂林和灵渠。元代平乐升为府，明代沿袭。府境内山谷纵横，官府、地方社群与军事征讨共同影响了这一地区的历史。

english: Pingli lies among the mountains south of the Han River, close to the approaches to Sichuan and Huguang. Local tradition tells that the goddess Nüwa gathered stones from these mountains to repair the sky. A temple on Mount Nüwa honoured her, and a Ming inscription describing the county seat praised its surrounding streams and wooded hills. The magistrate Gu Feng restored the temple in 1736; its halls and many rooms made it one of the district's largest religious buildings.
simp_chinese: 平利位于汉江以南的群山中，邻近通往四川与湖广的道路。当地传说女娲采南山五色石炼石补天，山上建有女娲庙。明代重修县治的碑记赞美这里环绕城池的溪流与林木。1736年，知县古沣主持重修女娲庙，殿宇房舍众多，是县内规模最大的寺院之一。

english:
Pingliang lies in the Jing River valley, on the road between the Guanzhong plain and the northwestern highlands. West of the city rises Mount Kongtong, a sacred mountain associated with the Daoist tradition that the Yellow Emperor sought instruction there from the sage Guangchengzi. Temples, halls and towers were built among its peaks over many centuries, making it a place of pilgrimage as well as a landmark on the western road.

In the Ming, members of the princely house of Han supported building on Kongtong. A prince enlarged its religious buildings in the fifteenth century, and later patrons helped restore halls dedicated to the Thunder Ancestor and the Three Officials. An inscription of 1615 records pilgrimage to the mountain. Under the Qing, the prefect invited the Daoist master Miao Qingyang to preside over religious life there in 1676, strengthening the Longmen tradition at Kongtong. The mountain's shrines joined the city to networks of worship reaching across the region.
simp_chinese:
平凉位于泾河谷地，是关中平原通往西北高地的道路要地。城西崆峒山是道教名山，相传黄帝曾在此向广成子问道。历代在群峰间营建宫观、殿阁与塔，使它既是西行道路上的地标，也是朝山进香的圣地。

明代韩藩王室扶持崆峒山建筑，十五世纪有宗室扩建宫观，后来的供养者又协助重修雷祖殿和三官殿。1615年的碑刻记载了人们赴山进香。清代平凉知府于1676年邀请道士苗清阳主持山中道教事务，龙门派在此得到发展。山中宫观通过信仰网络，将城镇与更远的地方联系起来。

english: Pinglu lies on the northern bank of the Yellow River in southern Shanxi. The river cuts a deep course through the high ground here, and traces of an old cliff road bear witness to the effort of travelling along its banks over many centuries. Among the district's places of worship are a temple to Fu Yue and a temple to Guan Yu at Zhongzhang, with buildings dating from the Ming and Qing periods.
simp_chinese: 平陆位于山西南部黄河北岸，河水在高地间切出深谷。沿岸古栈道遗迹见证了历代开辟河边道路的艰辛。当地庙宇中有傅说庙，以及中张村供奉关羽的关帝庙，建筑可追溯至明清时期。

sources.title: 平陆县各级文物保护单位列表

english: Pingnan stands on the northern bank of the Xun River, looking across the water toward fields and hills. Founded in the Tang, it was once the seat of Gongzhou before becoming a county under Xunzhou. The early Ming built an earthen wall around the county town, which had previously lacked defenses. From its gate towers a traveler could look over the river, the cultivated plain and the mountain ridges beyond, a landscape celebrated in local verse.
simp_chinese: 平南坐落在浔江北岸，隔江可望田野与群山。县置于唐代，曾为龚州州治，后来属浔州。明初，官府为原本无城的县城修筑土墙。登上城楼，可以眺望江流、平畴和远处连绵的山岭；这样的景色也曾入地方诗篇。

english: Pingquan lies among the hills north of the Great Wall, in a region once associated with the Kharachin Mongols. Its settlement was known as Bagou, or Eight Gullies, and became a place of exchange between Mongol traders and merchants from the agricultural provinces. Livestock products could be traded for goods needed on the grasslands. The Qing established a subprefecture at Bagou in 1729. In 1778 it became Pingquan, named for a spring in the town; that spring had been cleared and marked with a stone inscription a few years earlier. The administrative changes accompanied growing settlement and trade in the border country.
simp_chinese: 平泉位于长城以北的丘陵地带，这一地区曾属于喀喇沁蒙古人。聚落原称八沟，后来成为蒙古商人与内地商人交易的场所，草原畜产品在此换取所需货物。 清朝于1729年设八沟厅，1778年改为平泉州，以城中一眼泉水命名。此前数年，地方已疏通泉水并立石题名。建置的变化伴随着边地聚落和贸易的发展。

english: Píngshān lies in the hills of Guīshàn county, east of Huìzhōu, where Hakka villages farmed the valleys running down to the sea. On the peninsula to the south, the Hóngwǔ emperor had the walled garrison of Pínghǎi built against pirates. Its soldier families kept a speech of their own, northern Chinese at its base and mixed with Cantonese, Hakka and Hoklo.
simp_chinese: 平山位于惠州以东归善县的丘陵间，客家村落沿着通往海边的河谷耕作。南面的半岛上，明太祖下令修筑平海所城，以御海盗。城中军户的后人保留了一种自己的方言，以北方话为底子，夹杂广州话、客家话和福佬话。

english: Pingshan lies where the Taihang Mountains open toward the Hebei plain. In the Warring States period the kingdom of Zhongshan established its capital at Lingshou in this district. Its walls enclosed a city near the mountains, and the rulers were buried in great tombs with companion graves and pits for chariots and horses. Zhao destroyed Zhongshan in 295 BCE, but the earthworks and burial mounds remained as traces of the old kingdom.
simp_chinese: 平山位于太行山向河北平原展开的地带。战国时期，中山国在这一带的灵寿建都，城墙临近山麓，国王大墓周围设有陪葬墓和车马坑。公元前295年赵国灭中山，但古城土垣与陵墓仍留下了这个旧日王国的痕迹。

english: Pingwu lies among the mountains of northern Sichuan, where river valleys connect the Sichuan basin with communities farther into the highlands. Under the Ming, the Longzhou native office was held by local hereditary rulers of the Wang family. Wang Xi and his son Wang Jian supervised the building of Bao'en Temple at Pingwu in the fifteenth century. According to the Sichuan Provincial Institute of Cultural Relics and Archaeology, work began in 1439, the principal buildings stood by 1446, and the whole complex was completed in 1460. The temple shows how a local ruling family could sponsor an ambitious Buddhist institution while operating within Ming imperial authority. Its halls and surviving objects preserve a record of religious art and building in this mountain region.
simp_chinese: 平武位于四川北部山地，河谷连接四川盆地与更远处的高地社群。明代龙州土官之职由王氏地方世袭统治者掌握。十五世纪，王玺与其子王鉴主持修建平武报恩寺。据四川省文物考古研究院介绍，工程于1439年动工，1446年主体建筑已初具规模，1460年全寺建成。这座寺院显示地方统治家族如何在明朝统治框架内兴建规模宏大的佛教寺院；殿宇和保存下来的文物也记录了山地地区的宗教艺术与建筑传统。

english: Pingxiang lies in the hills of western Jiangxi, on the route towards Hunan. An old county of Yuanzhou, it was raised to a prefecture under the Yuan in 1295 and made a county again in the early Ming. Postal stations served travellers on the roads through its district. In 1338, the Buddhist monk Peng Yingyu and his followers rose against the Yuan at temples in Pingxiang and neighbouring Yichun. The revolt was suppressed, but Peng escaped and later became associated with further uprisings against Mongol rule.
simp_chinese: 萍乡位于江西西部的丘陵地带，处在通往湖南的道路上。这里是袁州的古县，元代1295年升为州，明初又恢复县制。县境道路上的驿站为往来旅人提供服务。1338年，僧人彭莹玉与追随者在萍乡和邻近宜春的寺院起兵反元。起事遭到镇压，彭莹玉逃脱，后来又参与反抗蒙古统治的斗争。

english: Pingxiang lies in the hills beside the route from Guangxi into Vietnam. Its position made it a frontier settlement under local hereditary authority. In 1404 the Ming raised Pingxiang from a town to a native county under Siming, and it later became a native prefecture. The rulers of this border district continued to hold hereditary office through the Ming and Qing periods.
simp_chinese: 凭祥位于广西通往越南的道路旁，群山环绕，是由世袭土官治理的边地聚落。明永乐二年（1404年），凭祥由镇升为土县，隶属思明府，后来又成为土州。明清时期，当地土官继续世袭治理这片边境地区。

english: Pingyang lies on the southern Zhejiang coast, between the plains around Wenzhou and the routes leading into Fujian. Its position made it a passage between the two provinces and a place exposed to maritime attacks. In the late Yuan, its walls were rebuilt to resist Fang Guozhen's forces. The Ming raised them further in 1374 and later established coastal garrisons as raids continued to threaten the district.
simp_chinese: 平阳位于浙南沿海，地处温州平原与通往福建的道路之间，既是两省交通要地，也面临海上袭击。元末为抵御方国珍部众，地方重筑城墙；明代1374年又加高城墙，后来随着沿海寇患持续，朝廷在县境增设卫所防守。

english: Píngyáng was the historic seat of Guìyáng in southeastern Húnán, set at the upper reaches of the Chūnlíng River on the northwestern flank of Qítián Ridge. A county of that name was founded in 317, and the county lies in a polymetallic ore district. The Táng placed a mining office here, the Sòng a military prefecture, the Yuán a route, the Míng a zhōu and the Qīng a directly governed department, so that the town kept the same name while its rank changed with each dynasty.
simp_chinese: 平阳是湖南东南部桂阳的历史治所，位于春陵水上游、骑田岭西北侧。东晋建武元年（317年）始置平阳县，桂阳一带后来成为多金属矿区。唐设桂阳监，宋设桂阳军，元为桂阳路，明为桂阳州，清为桂阳直隶州，名称不变，行政等级则随朝代而变。

english:
Pingyao is a walled town on the Shanxi plain, its streets lined with courtyards, temples and merchants' shops. Six gates pierce the brick-faced walls, and the town's traditional layout preserves the form of a Chinese county seat. Its prosperous merchants carried Shanxi trade far beyond their home province, leaving substantial houses and commercial buildings within the city.

In 1370 the early Ming enlarged the old town and rebuilt its defences with brick and stone. Commerce expanded from the middle Ming onward, and under the Qing Pingyao became a centre of finance as well as trade. In 1823 the Rishengchang exchange house opened here, helping merchants transfer funds between distant cities without carrying large quantities of silver. Its rise brought a new kind of business to the town's crowded streets.
simp_chinese:
平遥是山西平原上的一座城镇，砖包城墙辟有六门，街巷间排列着院落、寺庙与商铺，保留着传统县城的格局。当地商人远赴各地经商，城内留下了宅院与店铺，见证其兴盛。

1370年，明初在旧城基础上扩建城池，以砖石重修城墙。商业从明代中期起发展，到清代平遥逐渐成为商贸和金融中心。1823年，日昇昌票号在此创立，使商人能够在远隔的城市之间汇兑银钱，减少携带大量现银的麻烦，也为古城带来新的行业。

english:
Pingyin lies in western Shandong where the last spurs of the Taishan range reach the southern bank of the Yellow River. The name means the north side of the Eastern Plain, and the place appears in the Zuo Zhuan: it was a Qi frontier fortress against Lu and Jin, and the long Qi wall still runs through its hills. In 555 BC a coalition led by Jin broke the Qi army here. The Sui first set up a county in the district in 596 under the name Yushan, and renamed it Pingyin in 606.

Under the Yuan, Pingyin belonged to Dongping Circuit. The early Ming placed it under Dongping Prefecture, which was soon reduced to a department of Yanzhou Prefecture, and the county followed it. In 1735 the Qing transferred Pingyin to Tai'an Prefecture. Beside the Daqing River to the west and north and the lake of Dongping to the south, its farmers lived with the river's shifting floods.
simp_chinese:
平阴在鲁西，泰山余脉在这里伸向黄河南岸。县名意为“东原之北”，最早见于《左传》：这里是齐国对抗鲁、晋的边境要塞，齐长城的遗迹穿行于县境山岭之间，是山地防线的见证。公元前555年，以晋国为首的诸侯联军在此击溃齐军。隋代开皇十六年（596年）在这一带最初设榆山县，大业二年（606年）改名平阴，沿用至后世。

元代平阴隶属东平路。明初归东平府，东平府不久降为兖州府下的东平州，平阴随之改隶。1735年，清朝将平阴改属泰安府。县境西、北两面有大清河流过，南面是东平湖，当地农人一直生活在河水泛滥与改道的威胁之中，耕田、渡口与道路的位置都要看水势而定。

english: Pingyu lies on the plains east of Runing. An old city at Sheqiao preserves the site of the ancient state of Shen and of a county established in the Qin period. The county was absorbed into Ruyang under the Yuan, leaving Pingyu as a historic place name within the wider Runing region. South of the old city, a Buddhist monk's memorial tower at Puzhao Temple dates from the Jin dynasty, another reminder of the area's long history.
simp_chinese: 平舆位于汝宁以东的平原。射桥一带的古城，是先秦沈国及秦代平舆县的旧址。元代平舆县并入汝阳，此后这一地名仍留在汝宁地区的历史记忆之中。古城南面的普照寺有金代僧人墓塔，也见证了当地悠久的历史。

english: Pingyuan lies on the broad, level land south of Dezhou in northwestern Shandong. Its name, meaning “level plain,” suits the open fields and settlements of the region. The county belonged to Dezhou under the Ming and the early Qing. Local religious monuments included a mosque at Tiannan, dating from the Ming, and a Buddhist tower at Cuijiamiao built under the Qing. Together they reflect the different communities that made their homes in the county's villages.
simp_chinese: 平原位于山东西北部、德州以南，地势开阔平坦，县名恰与周围田野相称。明代及清初，平原属德州管辖。境内宗教建筑包括明代甜南清真寺，以及清代所建的崔家庙千佛塔，反映了县中村庄里不同社群的信仰与生活。

sources.title: 平原县各级文物保护单位列表

english: Pingyuan lies among the hills where Guangdong meets Jiangxi and Fujian. The Ming established the county in 1562 from territories taken from several neighbouring counties across the provincial boundaries. Two years later its borders were altered and it was placed under Chaozhou Prefecture. A shrine to the general Yu Dayou was built at Wushigang in 1564, while he was still alive, reflecting his place in the district's history.
simp_chinese: 平远位于广东、江西与福建交界的丘陵地带。明朝于1562年从三省邻县划地设县，两年后调整县界，改属潮州府。1564年，县内乌石岗为尚在人世的将领俞大猷建祠，反映他在这一地区历史中的地位。

english:
Pingyue is a walled town on the eastern approaches to the Guizhou plateau, where the road from Huguang passes among hills and gorges. The Ming placed a garrison here in 1381 and made it a guard the following year. Its soldiers and their families cultivated fields in settlements around the town, amid the lands of neighbouring Miao, Yi and Bouyei communities.

The city walls rose above a deep river gorge, making use of the terrain for defence. Travellers passed through on the old relay road; the philosopher Wang Yangming stopped at Pingyue on his journey into exile and wrote of the precipitous Seven Bends road. Under the Qing the military guard became a county in 1672, while the town retained its position on the route between Guizhou and the east.
simp_chinese:
平越是贵州高原东部入口处的卫城，湖广道路穿行于丘陵和峡谷之间。明朝于1381年在此驻军，次年设卫。军户及其家人在城外屯田，与周围苗、彝、布依等社群相邻。

卫城城墙临深峡而筑，利用地势设防。驿路上的旅人经过此地，哲学家王阳明贬谪途中曾在平越停留，并写诗描绘险峻的七盘驿道。清朝于1672年将卫改为县，城镇仍是贵州与东方之间道路上的要地。

english: Pingzhu lay in the mountain country of southern Guizhou, around the settlements later known as Pingtang. Its communities were drawn into the Yuan administration at the end of the thirteenth century. After local leaders submitted in 1297, the court established two native offices for Pingzhu and the Six Dong in 1298 and appointed numerous local officials. A contemporary account also records an attack on Pingzhu's chief by forces from neighbouring Pinglang, revealing the rivalries that accompanied the creation of these new offices.
simp_chinese: 平珠位于贵州南部山地，在后来称为平塘的聚落一带。十三世纪末，当地社群被纳入元朝行政体系。1297年地方首领归附，次年朝廷设平珠六洞两个长官司，任命众多土官。同一时期的记载还提到邻近平浪的部众袭击平珠土官，显示这些新官署建立时地方势力之间的争斗。

english: The forested mountains of the Serra do Mar rise between the bay of Paranaguá and the Paraná plateau. Heavy rain sustains Atlantic forest on the steep coastal slopes, while araucaria trees grow in the cooler uplands beyond. Rivers descend through the valleys to the sea. Crossing these ridges connects the sheltered coast with the grasslands and forests of the interior.
simp_chinese: 滨海山脉的森林山地耸立在巴拉那瓜湾与巴拉那高原之间。充沛降雨滋养着陡峭沿海山坡上的大西洋森林，较凉爽的高地则生长着南洋杉。河流穿过谷地流向海洋；翻越山岭，便可从受保护的海岸抵达内陆的草地与森林。

english: In the northwestern interior of Minas Gerais, the settlement later called João Pinheiro began as Santana dos Alegres. It grew in country where natural pasture and diamond workings attracted ranchers and prospectors. A settlement had formed by 1818, and colonial tracks through the region linked it with the wider Paracatu country. Its earlier name honoured Saint Anne and preserved the name Alegres.
simp_chinese: 在米纳斯吉拉斯西北部内陆，后来称为若昂皮涅鲁的聚落最初名叫圣安娜·杜斯阿莱格里斯。当地丰盛的天然牧场和钻石矿吸引了牧场主与采矿者。到1818年，聚落已经形成；穿过这一地区的道路将它与更广阔的帕拉卡图地区联系起来。旧名既纪念圣安娜，也保留了阿莱格里斯这一地名。

english: Pinhel lies in Portugal's Beira Alta, near the Spanish frontier. Its castle formed part of a chain of fortified settlements that defended the Portuguese border. The castle dates to the reign of King Denis, while its keep is associated with the later reign of Manuel I. Houses in the historic centre include buildings from the sixteenth century, and the town once had a Jewish community. Estates built in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries reflect growth in the surrounding district. In 1770 Pinhel received city status and became the seat of a new diocese. The Church of the Saviour served as its cathedral until the convent church of São Luís took that role in 1797.
simp_chinese: 皮涅尔位于葡萄牙上贝拉，靠近西班牙边界。当地城堡是保卫葡萄牙边境的一系列设防聚落之一，建于迪尼斯国王时期，主塔则与后来的曼努埃尔一世时期有关。旧城区保有十六世纪房屋，当地也曾有犹太社群。十七、十八世纪修建的庄园反映了周边地区的发展。1770年，皮涅尔获得城市地位并成为新设教区的主教驻地；救世主教堂曾用作主教座堂，1797年由圣路易修道院教堂接替。

english: Pinjarup, also called Bindjareb, country lies around the Murray River and Peel Inlet in southwestern Australia. The wetlands and river formed part of a Noongar homeland long before the Swan River colony. In 1834 colonial forces attacked a Pinjarup camp at Pinjarra, killing an uncertain number of people in an event remembered as the Pinjarra massacre.
simp_chinese: 平贾鲁普人亦称宾贾雷布人，其土地位于澳大利亚西南部的默里河与皮尔湾一带。早在天鹅河殖民地建立之前，湿地和河流就是努恩加家园的一部分。1834年，殖民武装在平贾拉袭击一处平贾鲁普营地，杀害人数不详；这一事件被后世称为平贾拉大屠杀。

english: Pinle lies in the irrigated Kyaukse plain near the walled remains of the ancient Pyu city of Maingmaw. After the decline of Pagan, it was the seat of Thihathu, one of three brothers who governed the region and founded the Myinsaing kingdom. Thihathu ruled from Pinle until he established a new capital at Pinya in 1313. The old site reflects the long history of settlement in a region whose canals and rice fields supported successive centres of power.
simp_chinese: 彬莱位于皎施灌溉平原，靠近古骠人城市勐茂的城墙遗址。蒲甘衰落后，这里是梯哈都的治所；他与两位兄长共同统治这一地区，建立敏象王国。梯哈都从彬莱治理，直到1313年在彬牙建立新都。古城所在地区具有悠久的定居历史，渠道和稻田曾支撑一个又一个政治中心。

sources.title: ASEAN – India Shared Cultural Heritage SECURE-web 0.pdf

english:
Pinneberg grew around a castle north-west of Hamburg. The site had served for centuries as a Germanic assembly place before a fortress was built around 1200. Count Adolf of Schauenburg captured it in 1370, and by 1397 Pinneberg was recorded as a place where local courts were regularly held. Servants and craftsmen settled near the castle, though the settlement grew slowly.

The old fortress was replaced by a residence in 1472. Badly damaged in 1627 and again in 1657 during the wars of the seventeenth century, that building was demolished in 1720. Pinneberg had become the seat of a Danish royal official in 1640, and a substantial new brick residence for the local administrator Hans von Ahlefeldt was built between 1765 and 1767, reflecting the continued importance of the seat.
simp_chinese:
平讷贝格兴起于汉堡西北的一座城堡周围。约1200年修筑堡垒之前，这里已作为日耳曼人集会之地使用了数百年。1370年，绍恩堡伯爵阿道夫攻占城堡；1397年的记载已将平讷贝格列为审判所在地。仆役与工匠在城堡附近定居，但聚落的发展相当缓慢。

1472年，一座宫邸取代了旧堡垒。建筑在十七世纪的战争中于1627年和1657年两度严重受损，最终于1720年拆除。平讷贝格自1640年起已是丹麦王室官员的驻地；1765至1767年间，当地行政长官汉斯·冯·阿勒费尔特又建起了一座新的砖砌官邸，显示此地作为驻地的持续重要性。

english: The Pinoh River flows through the forested interior of western Borneo to join the Melawi. Its meeting with the larger river marks a natural gathering place in a country where waterways connect scattered settlements. The Melawi continues north to the Kapuas at Sintang, carrying water from the hills and tributaries of the interior toward the western coast.
simp_chinese: 皮诺河流经婆罗洲西部森林覆盖的内陆，汇入默拉维河。在水道连接分散聚落的地区，两河交汇处自然成为人们相聚的地方。默拉维河继续向北，在新当汇入卡普阿斯河，将内陆丘陵与支流的水送向西岸。

english:
Pinsk stands where the Pina joins the Pripyat, amid the rivers and marshes of Polesia. First mentioned in 1097, it was a princely centre of Rus' before passing into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Its waterways made it a natural focus for the surrounding country.

When the local princely line died out in 1521, Pinsk became a royal possession; Queen Bona Sforza subsequently held it and promoted its development. King Stephen Báthory granted Magdeburg rights in 1581. In 1631 Albrycht Stanisław Radziwiłł brought the Jesuits to Pinsk and founded a college, whose community maintained a pharmacy and printing house. An Orthodox monastery with a school and hospital was also authorised in 1633. Pinsk suffered terribly during the wars of the mid-seventeenth century. Cossacks entered the city in 1648, and its recapture by Lithuanian forces brought fire and destruction. Russian and Cossack troops attacked again in 1655. In the eighteenth century new canals connected the region's waterways, while the college continued after the suppression of the Jesuits.
simp_chinese:
平斯克坐落在皮纳河汇入普里皮亚季河之处，四周是波列西亚的河流与沼泽。它首见于1097年的记载，曾是罗斯诸侯的中心，后来归入立陶宛大公国。纵横的水路使它自然成为周边地区的枢纽。

1521年，当地诸侯家族绝嗣，平斯克成为王室领地；此后博娜·斯福尔扎王后掌有此地并促进其发展。1581年，国王斯特凡·巴托里授予它马格德堡法权。1631年，阿尔布雷赫特·斯坦尼斯瓦夫·拉齐维乌将耶稣会士引入平斯克并创办学院，会士还经营药房和印刷所。1633年，国王又批准建立一座设有学校和医院的东正教修道院。十七世纪中叶的战争使平斯克深受其害。1648年哥萨克进入城市，立陶宛军重新夺城时发生大火和破坏；1655年，俄军与哥萨克再次进攻。十八世纪，新运河连接了这一地区的水道；耶稣会遭取缔后，学院仍继续办学。

english: Pintahae was a Nahyssan leader's residence on the Staunton River, not far from the town of Sapon. The traveller John Lederer learned of it during his journey through the Virginia interior in 1670. He described Sapon as a high, dry settlement beside the river, with rich soil around it; Pintahae, he was told, enjoyed similar advantages. The Nahyssan were related to the Saponi and Tutelo, peoples whose towns and territories lay along the inland rivers west of the coastal plain.
simp_chinese: 平塔海是斯汤顿河畔一处纳希桑首领的居所，距萨蓬镇不远。旅行者约翰·莱德勒于1670年穿越弗吉尼亚内陆时听闻此地。他描述萨蓬是一座坐落在河边干燥高地上的聚落，周围土壤肥沃；据当地人告诉他，平塔海也有类似的条件。纳希桑人与萨波尼人、图特洛人关系密切，他们的城镇和土地位于海岸平原以西的内陆河流沿岸。

sources.title: HA-081 High Plains Sappony NCVA Christie Indian Settlement 2017 WM report.pdf

english: Lake Pinto lies among the mountains and fjords of Última Esperanza in southern Patagonia. Glaciers once occupied these valleys, leaving lake basins and ridges of deposited material as the ice retreated. The surrounding country lies between the wetter Pacific channels and the drier steppe east of the Andes. Forests and windswept open ground meet around the lake beneath the mountains.
simp_chinese: 平托湖位于巴塔哥尼亚南部最后希望湾地区的山地与峡湾之间。冰川曾占据这些谷地，退缩时留下湖盆和沉积形成的山脊。周围土地介于较湿润的太平洋水道与安第斯山东侧较干燥草原之间。森林和受风吹拂的开阔地在山下的湖畔相接。

english:
King Thihathu founded Pinya in the Kyaukse valley, close to the Irrawaddy and the Mu valley granary, and was crowned on 7 February 1313 as the rightful heir of the Pagan kings. For the first time since the 1280s one ruler held the Irrawaddy valley from Prome to Tagaung. The kingdom inherited Pagan's old burden, for between a third and two-thirds of Upper Burma's farmland had been given to religion.

When Thihathu died in 1325 his realm split between Saw Yun of Sagaing in the north and Uzana I, who held the south. The half-brothers kept their own armies, and the rivalry left Pinya unable to answer Arakanese or Mon raids. In 1359 King Kyawswa II died in a raid by the Maw Shan that ransacked the country, and Toungoo drifted away. In 1364 the Maw ruler Tho Kho Bwa sacked Sagaing in April and then turned on Pinya in May. The young prince Thado Minbya of Sagaing took Pinya that September and founded a new capital, Ava, at the meeting of the Irrawaddy and the Myitnge, on 26 February 1365. Ava saw itself as Pagan's heir and fought the Forty Years' War with Hanthawaddy from 1385 to 1424.
simp_chinese:
彬牙由梯哈都王建立在皎施河谷，靠近伊洛瓦底江和木河谷粮仓，他于1313年2月7日加冕，被奉为蒲甘诸王的合法继承人。自13世纪80年代以来，伊洛瓦底江流域从卑谬到杰沟第一次由一位君主统一。王国继承了蒲甘遗留的负担：上缅甸三分之一到三分之二的农田已捐给宗教。

梯哈都于1325年去世，王国分裂，北方由实皆的邵云统治，南方由乌萨那一世掌握。异母兄弟各有军队，彼此的争斗使彬牙无力应对若开和孟人的袭击。1359年，觉苏瓦二世死于孟卯掸人的劫掠，全国遭洗劫，东吁也趋于独立。1364年，孟卯统治者托科布瓦4月攻陷实皆，5月又转而攻陷彬牙。实皆的年轻王子多明帕当年9月夺取彬牙，1365年2月26日在伊洛瓦底江与米吉河汇合处建立新都阿瓦。阿瓦自认为蒲甘的继承者，1385至1424年与汉达瓦底打了四十年战争。

english: The Ogden River descends through Ogden Canyon to meet the Weber River near the eastern shore of the Great Salt Lake. Shoshone people used the land around the lake and Ogden Valley for centuries. In 1825 Peter Skene Ogden led a Hudson's Bay Company trapping party into the valley. Farther up the Weber, his men encountered American trappers in a dispute over access to the beaver country.
simp_chinese: 奥格登河穿过奥格登峡谷，在大盐湖东岸附近汇入韦伯河。数个世纪以来，肖肖尼人利用湖泊周围与奥格登河谷的土地。1825年，彼得·斯基恩·奥格登率领哈得孙湾公司的捕兽队进入河谷。在韦伯河更上游，他的队伍与美国捕兽者相遇，双方因进入河狸猎场的权利发生争执。

english:
Piombino stands on the Tuscan coast facing Elba. In 1399 Gherardo Appiani ceded Pisa to the Visconti of Milan but retained Piombino and other lands and islands, creating a small lordship centred on the coastal town. Its territories included part of Elba, linking Piombino to the island across the strait.

The lordship was contested during the Italian wars: Cesare Borgia occupied Piombino between 1501 and 1503. In 1594 Emperor Rudolf II raised it to a principality. Later it passed through the Ludovisi and Boncompagni families. During the Napoleonic era it was joined to Lucca, and in 1815 it was absorbed into the Grand Duchy of Tuscany.
simp_chinese:
皮翁比诺位于托斯卡纳海岸，与厄尔巴岛隔海相望。1399年，盖拉尔多·阿皮亚尼将比萨让予米兰的维斯孔蒂家族，却保留皮翁比诺及其他土地和岛屿，建立以这个沿海城镇为中心的小领地。领地包括厄尔巴岛的一部分，海峡将城镇与岛屿联系起来。

意大利战争期间，这片领地成为争夺对象：1501至1503年切萨雷·博尔贾占领皮翁比诺。1594年，皇帝鲁道夫二世将领地升为公国，后来由卢多维西和邦孔帕尼家族统治。拿破仑时代，它与卢卡合并；1815年归入托斯卡纳大公国。

english: Piotrków, in central Poland, became an important meeting place for the kingdom's nobility and clergy. General assemblies and parliamentary sessions gathered here, and the town is associated with the development of Poland's two-chamber parliament in the late fifteenth century. In 1578 it became one of the two seats of the Crown Tribunal, the highest court for the nobility; the other was Lublin. The tribunal heard cases from Greater Poland at Piotrków, drawing litigants, deputies and their attendants to the town. Its long presence gave rise to the later name Piotrków Trybunalski. Swedish troops occupied the town during the wars of 1655 and 1657, and again in 1702. After the second partition of Poland in 1793, Piotrków passed to Prussia. It entered the Duchy of Warsaw in 1807 and the Kingdom of Poland in 1815.
simp_chinese: 波兰中部的彼得库夫曾是王国贵族与神职人员的重要集会地点。贵族大会和议会在此召开，这座城镇与十五世纪末波兰两院制议会的形成有密切联系。1578年，它成为贵族最高法院王冠法庭的两个驻地之一，另一个驻地为卢布林。法庭在彼得库夫审理大波兰地区的案件，诉讼当事人、代表和随从纷纷来到城中。法庭长期设于此地，后来也使城市获得了“特里布纳尔斯基”的名称。瑞典军队在1655年、1657年和1702年占领过彼得库夫。1793年第二次瓜分波兰后，城市归入普鲁士；1807年进入华沙公国，1815年又划入波兰王国。

english: The Pipanaco basin is a broad depression enclosed by mountain ranges in northwestern Argentina. The Belén, Quimivil and Andalgalá rivers descend towards the great salt flat at its centre, joined by smaller streams from the Ambato range. Water gathers in the low ground, where evaporation leaves salt on the basin floor and sand forms dunes along its margins.
simp_chinese: 皮帕纳科盆地是阿根廷西北部一片被山脉环绕的广阔洼地。贝伦河、基米维尔河和安达尔加拉河流向盆地中央的大盐沼，安巴托山脉的小溪也汇入其间。水汇集在低地，蒸发后在盆地底部留下盐分，沙粒则在边缘形成沙丘。

english: The Salar de Pipanaco occupies the lowest part of an enclosed basin among the ranges of Catamarca. Seasonal streams bring water and sediment down from the mountains, while evaporation leaves salts concentrated on the floor of the depression. The salt flat stretches lengthwise between ranges running roughly north and south. At its southern end the Colorado River approaches the basin before turning away, adding complexity to the drainage of this arid country.
simp_chinese: 皮帕纳科盐沼占据了卡塔马卡群山间封闭盆地的最低处。季节性溪流从山上带来水和泥沙，蒸发则使盐分聚集在洼地底部。盐沼沿大致南北走向的山脉之间延伸。科罗拉多河在盆地南端接近盐沼后又转向别处，使这片干旱土地的排水情况更为复杂。

english: The Pipipã are an Indigenous people associated with the Serra Negra in the dry interior of Pernambuco. The mountain’s wooded heights and springs contrast with the surrounding sertão. Traditions of neighbouring communities remember the Pipipã among the former inhabitants of the range, whose families maintained ties to this upland refuge despite displacement and the spread of ranches.
simp_chinese: 皮皮帕人是与伯南布哥干旱内陆塞拉内格拉山地相联系的原住民族。山上的林地和泉水与周围塞尔唐形成对照。邻近社区的传统记得皮皮帕人曾居住在山中；尽管遭遇迁移和牧场扩张，他们的家族仍维系着与这片高地的联系。

english: Pipli lies in the western Bengal delta, near the rivers of Meherpur and Chuadanga. The Mathabhanga branches from the Padma and flows through this country, while the Bhairab passes Meherpur on its way south. By the late eighteenth century, indigo factories had appeared in riverside villages; planters sent their produce onward by the waterways toward Calcutta.
simp_chinese: 皮普利位于孟加拉三角洲西部，靠近梅赫尔布尔与楚阿当加一带的河流。马塔班加河从帕德玛河分出，流经这里；拜拉布河则经过梅赫尔布尔向南流去。十八世纪末，河岸村庄出现了靛蓝工场，种植园主利用水路将产品运往加尔各答。

english: Pipmuacan is a lake and river country in the forested interior north of the St. Lawrence. The Innu name has been linked to the arrow and to a tradition of fighting on a mountain above the lake. Nearby waters were reached by Innu from several directions: Pessamit families came by the Betsiamites basin, while those from Essipit and the Lake Saint-Jean country followed other rivers. Indigenous names in the area were recorded on the missionary Laure's maps in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 皮普穆阿坎是圣劳伦斯河以北森林内陆的湖河地区。因努语名称与箭有关，也与一则发生在湖边山上的战斗传说相联系。因努人从不同方向抵达附近水域：佩萨米特的家庭沿贝特夏米特河流域前来，埃西皮和圣让湖地区的人则走其他河道。十八世纪，传教士洛尔的地图记录了这一带的原住民地名。

english: The Piquiri carries water from the southern Mato Grosso uplands toward the Pantanal. Formed by the meeting of the Itiquira and Peixe de Couro, it receives the Correntes before joining the São Lourenço. As these rivers enter the broad plain, their courses pass into a landscape of seasonal floods, wetlands and channels connected with the upper Paraguay basin.
simp_chinese: 皮基里河将马托格罗索南部高地的水带向潘塔纳尔。它由伊蒂基拉河与佩谢德库罗河汇合而成，接纳科伦蒂斯河后注入圣洛伦索河。这些河流进入广阔平原时，穿过由季节性洪水、湿地和水道构成的景观，并与巴拉圭河上游流域相连。

english:
The Pir Panjal rises along the southwestern edge of the Vale of Kashmir, separating the Jhelum basin from the Chenab and the hills of Jammu. The westernmost range of the Lesser Himalayas, it stretches from the country of the Beas towards the Kishanganga. Its high passes have long provided routes through the mountains that enclose the Vale of Kashmir.

One such route crossed the Pir Panjal Pass between the valley and Poonch. Under the sultans of Kashmir it was extended as far as Bhimber, and after Akbar conquered Kashmir, the Mughal emperor strengthened it as an imperial road from Lahore to the valley. The passage over the mountains thus became part of the road by which the Mughal court reached Kashmir.
simp_chinese:
比尔本贾尔岭耸立在克什米尔谷地西南缘，将杰赫勒姆河流域与杰纳布河流域及查谟丘陵隔开。它是小喜马拉雅山系最西端的山脉，从比亚斯河一带向基尚根加河延伸。山中高峻的隘口，长久以来为人们穿越环抱克什米尔的群山提供了通道。

其中一条道路经比尔本贾尔山口连接谷地与旁遮。克什米尔苏丹统治时期，这条路延伸到了宾巴尔；阿克巴征服克什米尔后，又将它修整为从拉合尔通往谷地的帝国大道。翻越山岭的道路，也因此成为莫卧儿宫廷前往克什米尔的通途。

english:
The Pir Panjal Range separates the Kashmir valley from lower lands to the south and southwest, creating a formidable barrier crossed by important passes. Forests, summer pasture, and mountain settlements support resources that differ with elevation. Seasonal movement allows herders to use uplands during favorable weather, while snow can close routes for long periods. Guides and knowledge of safe stages are essential to journeys between the valley and neighboring regions.

Mountain passages connected Kashmir with Punjab and other parts of the subcontinent. After Akbar's conquest of Kashmir in 1586, the route across the Pir Panjal became a favored road for the Mughal court traveling between Lahore and the valley. Halting stations served royal journeys, while the crossing remained dependent on the seasons and the labor needed to provision travelers. Later Afghan and Sikh rule changed the political framework without removing the constraints imposed by the mountains.
simp_chinese:
比尔本贾尔岭把克什米尔谷地与南方、西南低地分开，形成少数重要山口跨越的巨大屏障。森林、夏牧场和山地聚落提供随海拔变化资源。牧民趁适宜天气利用高处，积雪则可能长期封路。谷地邻区之间旅行，需要向导和安全停留点知识。

山间通道连接克什米尔、旁遮普及次大陆其他地区。1586年阿克巴征服克什米尔后，穿越比尔本贾尔岭的道路成为莫卧儿宫廷往来拉合尔与谷地偏用的路线。沿途驿站服务王室旅程，而翻山仍受季节和旅人补给所需劳力的制约。后来的阿富汗与锡克统治改变了政治格局，却没有消除山地带来的限制。

english: The Pir Panjal is the westernmost range of the Lesser Himalayas. Along the southwestern side of the Vale of Kashmir, its ridges separate the Jhelum basin from the Chenab and the hills of Jammu. A route through the Pir Panjal Pass linked Poonch with the valley; extended to Bhimber under the Kashmiri sultans, it was strengthened by Akbar after his conquest of Kashmir as an imperial road from Lahore.
simp_chinese: 比尔本贾尔岭是小喜马拉雅山系最西端的山脉。它沿克什米尔谷地的西南侧绵延，将杰赫勒姆河流域与杰纳布河流域及查谟丘陵隔开。一条道路穿过比尔本贾尔山口，连接旁遮与克什米尔谷地；克什米尔苏丹将其延伸至宾巴尔，阿克巴征服克什米尔后，又将它修整为从拉合尔通往谷地的帝国大道。

english:
Piracicaba stands beside the river of the same name in the interior of São Paulo. A waterfall marks the river near the settlement, while its waters continue toward the Tietê and Paraná. The surrounding country of rolling hills and wooded valleys was connected by river and road to the routes leading into the western interior.

The Portuguese founded a settlement here in 1767, intending it to support navigation and the defence of their inland frontier. A landing below the falls provided a stopping place and supplies for travellers going along these routes. Sugar production grew in the district: by 1799 nine mills were recorded. The estates and mills drew on enslaved labour as Piracicaba developed into a centre of agriculture and exchange.
simp_chinese:
皮拉西卡巴位于圣保罗内陆同名河流畔。聚落附近有一处瀑布，河水继续流向提埃特河和巴拉那河。周围起伏丘陵与森林河谷通过水路和道路连接通往西部内陆的路线。

葡萄牙人于1767年在此建立聚落，意在支援航运和内陆边疆的防御。瀑布下方的码头为沿途旅人提供歇脚和补给之处。当地制糖业逐渐发展，到1799年已有九座制糖厂。随着皮拉西卡巴成长为农业与交换中心，庄园和制糖厂依靠被奴役者的劳动运转。

english: Piran-i-Kaliyar is a place of pilgrimage near Haridwar and the Himalayan foothills. Its dargah honours Alauddin Sabir Kaliyari, a thirteenth-century Sufi of the Chishti order. A nephew and successor of Baba Farid, Sabir founded the Sabiriya branch of the order. The shrine is said to have been built under Ibrahim Lodi, the Afghan sultan of Delhi, and draws worshippers of several faiths to the saint's resting place.
simp_chinese: 皮兰·卡利亚尔是哈里德瓦尔附近的一处朝圣地，靠近喜马拉雅山麓。这里的圣陵供奉十三世纪的奇什提教团苏菲圣者阿拉丁·萨比尔·卡利亚里。他是巴巴·法里德的侄子和继承者，创立了教团的萨比里耶支派。相传陵墓建于德里的阿富汗苏丹易卜拉欣·洛迪统治时期，吸引不同信仰的朝拜者前来敬奉圣者。

english: Piranga lies in the wooded hills of Minas Gerais, near the river that bears its name. The settlement grew from the Guarapiranga goldfields, which João Siqueira Afonso is credited with discovering in 1704. Prospectors moved outward from these workings into neighbouring valleys, while a community formed around the mining camp. The Indigenous name Guarapiranga survived in the name of the place and river.
simp_chinese: 皮兰加位于米纳斯吉拉斯林木覆盖的丘陵中，靠近同名河流。聚落源自瓜拉皮兰加金矿，据记载若昂·西凯拉·阿丰苏于1704年发现了这处矿藏。寻矿者从矿场向邻近河谷推进，社区则围绕采矿营地形成。原住民语名称瓜拉皮兰加在地名和河名中流传下来。

english: Piranshahr lies in the mountain country south of Lake Urmia, near the plains and passes of the Lajan region. Earlier accounts describe the district as Lahijan, home to Kurdish tribal groups including the Balbas and Mukri. The nearby settlement of Pasveh was known to medieval geographers for its orchards. During the Safavid period the mountain frontier saw repeated contests among local tribes and larger powers, while the valleys and passes linked the lands around Urmia with the Kurdish country to the west.
simp_chinese: 皮兰沙赫尔位于乌尔米耶湖南方的山地，靠近拉詹地区的平原与山口。较早的记载称这一地区为拉希詹，是包括巴尔巴斯和穆克里在内的库尔德部族居地。中世纪地理学家知道附近的帕斯韦聚落及其果园。萨法维时期，地方部族和较大势力反复争夺山地边疆；山谷与山口则连接乌尔米耶周围土地和西方库尔德地区。

english: Pirapora lies beside the São Francisco River at a stretch of rapids that marks a change in the character of its course. Its name comes from a Tupi expression referring to leaping fish, a reminder of the fish that ascend the river. The São Francisco served the interior during the mining era, and the waterfall became a landmark for those travelling along its waters.
simp_chinese: 皮拉波拉位于圣弗朗西斯科河畔的一段急流旁，河流的面貌在此发生变化。地名源自图皮语中指鱼跃的词语，让人想起溯河而上的鱼群。采矿时代，圣弗朗西斯科河为内陆地区提供交通，皮拉波拉瀑布成为沿河旅行者辨认道路的一处地标。

english:
Piratini lies in the hills of southern Rio Grande do Sul, between the grasslands of the interior and the coastal lagoon country. Azorean families arrived in 1789 and formed a settlement in this contested Portuguese frontier. The town became a centre for the surrounding ranching district. In 1830 the parish became a vila, with jurisdiction over a large area of the southern interior.

During the Ragamuffin War, rebels proclaimed the Rio-Grandense Republic in 1836. Piratini’s council supported the new regime, and the town was chosen as its capital. The political upheaval brought the struggle between provincial rebels and the Brazilian Empire into this small inland settlement, whose position lay away from the coast and its imperial strongholds. Its council formally declared support for the republic in November, after the rebellion had begun the previous year.
simp_chinese:
皮拉蒂尼位于南里奥格兰德南部丘陵，介于内陆草原与沿海潟湖地区之间。1789年，亚速尔群岛家庭抵达，在这片受争夺的葡萄牙边境建立聚落。城镇成为周围牧业地区的中心。1830年堂区升为镇，管辖南部内陆的广大地区。

拉加马芬战争期间，起义者于1836年宣布成立里奥格兰德共和国。皮拉蒂尼市议会支持新政权，城镇被选为首府。这场政治动荡把省级起义者与巴西帝国的斗争带入这座远离海岸帝国据点的小型内陆聚落。起义始于前一年，市议会在十一月正式宣布支持共和国。

english:
Piratinin lies in the river country of southern Rio Grande do Sul, near the Piratini basin and the Serra dos Tapes. Streams descend through wooded hills towards the lowlands and the Patos Lagoon. The wider district was a frontier between Portuguese and Spanish claims in the eighteenth century. The town of Piratini, founded by Azorean settlers in 1789, later became the capital of the Rio-Grandense Republic during the rebellion of 1836.

The later city of Pelotas lies here.
simp_chinese:
皮拉蒂宁位于南里奥格兰德南部河流地区，靠近皮拉蒂尼流域和塔皮斯山地。溪流穿过林木丘陵，流向低地及帕图斯潟湖。十八世纪，更广地区是葡萄牙与西班牙争夺的边境。亚速尔定居者于1789年建立的皮拉蒂尼城镇，后来在1836年起义期间成为里奥格兰德共和国首府。

后来的佩洛塔斯即位于此地。

english:
Piratininga lies on the plateau beyond the Serra do Mar, where rivers and wooded hills open toward the Brazilian interior. Indigenous communities inhabited this country before the foundation of São Paulo. In 1554 Jesuits including Manuel da Nóbrega and José de Anchieta established a college here, seeking to teach and convert the Indigenous people of the plateau. A settlement of earth-walled houses grew around it.

São Paulo became a centre from which armed expeditions, known as bandeiras, travelled into the interior. They sought Indigenous captives for forced labour as well as gold and precious stones. In the seventeenth century expeditions attacked Jesuit missions in the Paraná basin and carried away many thousands of Indigenous people. Such journeys extended Portuguese colonial power while bringing violence and displacement to the peoples they encountered. The expeditions often followed the Tietê and its tributaries, using river routes and knowledge of the interior to reach communities far from the Atlantic coast.

Elevated to a city in 1711, São Paulo retained its place among the routes linking the coast to the inland settlements and mines. After Brazilian independence, a law of 1827 established courses in law and social sciences in São Paulo and Olinda. The college and the new legal school reflected different stages in the town’s development, from a missionary outpost to an administrative and intellectual centre.
simp_chinese:
皮拉蒂宁加位于海岸山脉另一侧的高原上，河流与森林丘陵向巴西内陆延伸。圣保罗建立之前，原住民社区已在这里生活。1554年，曼努埃尔·达诺布雷加、若泽·迪安谢塔等耶稣会士在此建立学院，意在教育并传教于高原的原住民。土墙房屋组成的聚落随之在学院周围形成。

圣保罗成为武装远征队出发前往内陆的中心。这些被称为班德拉的远征队寻找金银宝石，也抓捕原住民强迫劳动。十七世纪，远征队袭击了巴拉那河流域的耶稣会传教聚落，掳走数以万计的原住民。这些旅程扩大了葡萄牙殖民权力，也给沿途人民带来了暴力和流离失所。远征队常沿蒂耶特河及其支流前进，借助水路和对内陆的了解，抵达远离大西洋海岸的社区。

圣保罗于1711年升格为城市，继续位于连接海岸与内陆聚落、矿区的道路网络中。巴西独立后，1827年的法律在圣保罗和奥林达设立法律与社会科学课程。耶稣会学院与新的法律学校体现了城镇发展的不同阶段：从传教据点逐渐成为行政与学术中心。

sources.title: 975-Obras do Barao do Rio Branco VI Efemerides Brasileiras.pdf

english: The Piratuba country lies along the northern coast of the Amazon estuary, where lakes and flooded grasslands meet forest and mangroves. The Araguari River runs through the southern part of this wet landscape towards the Atlantic. Tidal waters and seasonal floods shape the lagoons, marshes and narrow bands of forest, providing habitat for fish, crustaceans and waterbirds.
simp_chinese: 皮拉图巴地区位于亚马孙河口北部海岸，湖泊和淹水草地与森林、红树林相接。阿拉瓜里河穿过这片湿地南部流向大西洋。潮水和季节性洪水塑造湖沼、沼泽与狭长林带，为鱼类、甲壳类和水鸟提供栖息地。

sources.title: plano de manejo rebio lago piratuba   diagnostico.pdf

english: Piraí lies beside the river of the same name in the hills of the Paraíba do Sul basin. A chapel dedicated to Saint Anne was established around 1770 and became a focus of the growing settlement. The wooded valley lay between the coast and the interior, where farms and roads spread through the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries. The river’s Indigenous name remained attached to the community.
simp_chinese: 皮拉伊位于南帕拉伊巴河流域的丘陵中，坐落在同名河流畔。约1770年建立的一座圣安娜小教堂成为聚落发展的中心。这片森林河谷位于海岸与内陆之间，农场和道路在十八世纪至十九世纪初不断扩展。河流的原住民语名称也成为社区的名字。

english: Pirca Pirca crowns a hill near Uchumarca, between the high puna and the forested eastern slopes of the northern Andes. Its stone settlement contains hundreds of circular structures, some with underground chambers, alongside a large rectangular building rising several storeys. Water channels and burial areas also form part of the complex. The site was used for burials during the period of Inca influence in the region.
simp_chinese: 皮尔卡皮尔卡位于乌丘马尔卡附近的山顶，介于高寒普纳和北安第斯森林覆盖的东坡之间。石砌聚落有数百座圆形建筑，有些带地下室，另有一座高达数层的大型长方形建筑。水渠和墓葬区也是建筑群的一部分。印加影响当地期间，这里曾被用作墓地。

english: The Pircas mountains belong to the dry ranges east of the high Andes in the San Juan country. The Sierra del Tontal runs through this pre-Andean landscape, with Cerro Pircas among its highest summits. Bare ridges rise above the valleys on either side, and the steep country separates the Calingasta valley from lands farther east. These mountains form part of a succession of ranges between the Andean crest and the plains of Cuyo.
simp_chinese: 皮尔卡斯山地属于安第斯高山以东圣胡安地区的干旱山岭。通塔尔山脉穿过这片前安第斯地带，皮尔卡斯峰是其中最高的山峰之一。裸露的山脊高出两侧河谷，陡峭的山地将卡林加斯塔河谷与更东面的土地分开。这些山岭构成安第斯主脊与库约平原之间一系列山脉的一部分。

english: Hornopirén lies on the sheltered waters of the southern Chilean coast, beneath the volcano from which it takes its name. Here the Andes descend into a labyrinth of fjords and channels, and heavy rain nourishes dense evergreen forest. Alerce trees grow on the mountain slopes alongside coihue, lenga and other native species. Glaciers and snowfields crown the higher ground, overlooking the narrow waterways that connect this coast with Chiloé.
simp_chinese: 奥尔诺皮伦位于智利南部避风的海湾之畔，坐落在赋予它名字的火山脚下。安第斯山脉在此下降，进入峡湾和水道组成的迷宫；充沛雨水滋养着茂密的常绿森林。山坡上生长着智利柏、科伊韦和伦加等本地树种。高处的冰川和雪原俯瞰狭窄水道，后者将这片海岸与奇洛埃相连。

english: The forests east of Hornopirén cover steep valleys where the southern Andes meet the fjords of Chile. Rain sustains evergreen trees, including alerce, coihue and tepa, while glaciers and snowfields occupy higher ground. Rivers descend from the mountains towards inlets of the Pacific. The contrast between dense forest, exposed summits and narrow arms of the sea gives this part of the cordillera its rugged character.
simp_chinese: 奥尔诺皮伦以东的森林覆盖着陡峭河谷，南安第斯山脉在此与智利峡湾相遇。雨水滋养智利柏、科伊韦和特帕等常绿树木，高处则有冰川与雪原。河流从山中下降，流向太平洋的海湾。茂密森林、裸露山峰和狭窄海湾的对照，赋予这一段山脉崎岖的面貌。

english: Piri was a province of the kingdom of Loango, on the forested Atlantic coast north of the Congo estuary. The royal capital Buali stood in this country, giving the rulers of Loango a seat near the coast and the routes into the interior. Traditions of the kingdom recall Piri as one of the territories brought under the authority of its founder before Buali became the centre of royal power.
simp_chinese: 皮里是卢安果王国的一个地区，位于刚果河口以北森林覆盖的大西洋沿岸。王都布阿利坐落于此，卢安果统治者在这里拥有一处靠近海岸和内陆道路的王座。王国的传统记忆将皮里列为建国者征服的地区之一，此后布阿利成为王权中心。

english: The Piripucu flows through the southwestern Brazilian uplands to join the Apa, itself a tributary of the Paraguay River. The Apa basin gathers streams descending from the Bodoquena range before the waters continue west toward the Paraguay. Woodland and open country surround the river valleys, which form part of the broad transition between the plateau and the lowlands to the west.
simp_chinese: 皮里普库河流经巴西西南部高地，注入巴拉圭河的支流阿帕河。阿帕流域汇集从博多凯纳山地流下的溪流，河水随后继续向西流往巴拉圭河。林地和开阔地带环绕河谷，这里属于高原与西部低地之间广阔的过渡区域。

english: Pirlerkondu lies in the Taurus Mountains between Larende and the Mediterranean coast. Also recorded as Pirloganda, it occupied a defensible position on a caravan route linking Karaman with Alanya. The steep surrounding country separates it from neighbouring valleys, while springs supply the settlement. Its position on a route through the mountains tied this small community to the movement of people and goods between the plateau and the coast.
simp_chinese: 皮尔莱孔杜位于拉伦德与地中海海岸之间的托罗斯山地，也见于皮尔洛甘达之名。它扼守卡拉曼与阿拉尼亚之间的商队道路，地势易于防守。周围陡峭的山岭将这里与邻近山谷分开，泉水则供给居民。穿山道路使这个小社区与高原和海岸之间的人员、货物往来相连。

english:
Pirmasens began as a small settlement on the western edge of the Palatinate Forest, first recorded around 850 and named for Saint Pirmin, founder of nearby Hornbach Abbey. For centuries it remained a village, until Landgrave Ludwig IX of Hesse-Darmstadt chose it as the home of his soldiers. Under his patronage its few dozen houses gave way to barracks, churches and a large drill hall.

Pirmasens became a residence town in 1763, and its population grew to around nine thousand by Ludwig's death in 1790. Soldiers and their families made up much of the community. The landgrave's death brought the end of the garrison and deprived many inhabitants of their livelihood. Shoemaking offered a new occupation; local tradition recalls simple shoes fashioned from remnants of leather and military uniforms, the beginning of a trade that grew beyond the town.
simp_chinese:
皮尔马森斯起初是普法尔茨森林西缘的一处小聚落，约850年首次见诸文献，得名于附近霍恩巴赫修道院的创建者圣皮尔明。几个世纪里，它一直是村庄，直到黑森—达姆施塔特的路德维希九世伯爵选择这里安置军队。在他的资助下，数十座村舍之间兴建起兵营、教堂和大型操练厅。

1763年皮尔马森斯成为驻跸城镇，到1790年路德维希去世时人口增至约九千，军人及其家属占了很大一部分。伯爵去世后驻军解散，许多居民失去生计。制鞋成为新的谋生方式；地方传说记述人们用皮革和旧军服的边角料制成简易鞋，这门手艺逐渐发展为超出城镇范围的贸易。

english:
Pirna lies on the Elbe below the rocky heights of Saxon Switzerland. Its medieval town was laid out on a regular street plan beneath a castle, and was first recorded in 1233. King Wenceslaus II of Bohemia acquired the town and castle in 1293; Pirna remained Bohemian until 1405. In 1544 Duke Maurice of Saxony strengthened the castle as the fortress of Sonnenstein.

Swedish troops under Johan Banér entered Pirna in 1639 during the Thirty Years' War. Their long siege of the fortress failed, but the town was devastated and hundreds died in what became known as the Misery of Pirna. At the start of the Seven Years' War the Saxon army took refuge nearby and surrendered to Prussia in 1756. During the Napoleonic Wars, French troops occupied Sonnenstein and held it until 1813.
simp_chinese:
皮尔纳位于易北河畔，背倚萨克森瑞士地区的岩石高地。中世纪城市在城堡下方按整齐街道布局建立，1233年首次见诸文献。1293年，波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世取得城镇和城堡，皮尔纳直到1405年仍属波希米亚。1544年，萨克森公爵莫里茨将城堡加强为松嫩施泰因要塞。

1639年三十年战争期间，约翰·巴内尔率瑞典军进入皮尔纳。瑞典人长期围攻要塞未果，城镇却遭到重创，数百人死于后来被称为「皮尔纳苦难」的灾难。七年战争初，萨克森军退至附近，于1756年向普鲁士投降。拿破仑战争期间，法军占领松嫩施泰因，直到1813年才撤出。

english:
Pirot stands in the Nisava valley, where routes between the central Balkans and the approaches to Sofia give a market town strategic value. Agricultural villages supply grain, livestock, wool, and other products, while crafts and trade connect rural production to wider demand. The valley offers a practical passage through mountainous country, making roads and fortified places important to both commerce and military movement. Local life is therefore closely tied to journeys beyond the immediate district.

Pirot came under Ottoman rule in the late fourteenth century and formed part of the Sanjak of Niš. Its location on the road between central Europe and Constantinople supported trade and travel. Woven carpets became closely associated with the town; an early written mention of Pirot kilims dates to 1565. During the Austro-Ottoman War, Austrian forces took the town in 1737, and it suffered destruction when Ottoman rule returned in 1739.
simp_chinese:
皮罗特位于尼沙瓦河谷，中央巴尔干与索菲亚方向路线赋予市场城镇战略价值。农业村庄供应粮食、牲畜、羊毛等产品，工艺贸易把乡村生产接入更大需求。河谷提供穿越山地的实用途径，使道路据点同时服务商业军事。地方生活紧密联系地区外旅程。

十四世纪末，皮罗特进入奥斯曼统治，属于尼什桑贾克。城镇位于中欧通往君士坦丁堡的道路上，支持贸易与旅行。织毯成为当地特色；1565年的文献已提到皮罗特基里姆毯。奥地利与奥斯曼战争期间，奥军于1737年占领城镇，1739年奥斯曼重新控制时城镇遭到破坏。

english:
At the mouth of the Arno, Pisa built one of the great maritime empires of the medieval Mediterranean, its fleets raiding Palermo in 1063, defeating Saracen corsairs across the Tyrrhenian Sea, and establishing trading colonies from Sardinia to Antioch. Enriched by this commerce, the Pisans raised the extraordinary ensemble of cathedral, baptistery, and campanile on the #italic Campo dei Miracoli#!, monuments to a city whose wealth and confidence at its 12th-century height seemed without limit. Though the catastrophic defeat by Genoa at the Battle of Meloria in 1284 broke Pisan naval power, the city and its remarkable monuments endured.

Its independence did not. In 1406 Florence took Pisa after a long siege, and although the council that tried to end the Great Schism of the papacy met here three years later, the city was losing the sea that had made it: its harbor silted up steadily through the 15th century. When Charles VIII of France invaded Italy in 1494, the Pisans rose and proclaimed a republic again, and for fifteen years they held off the Florentine armies until Florence retook the city in 1509. Livorno replaced Pisa as the chief port of Tuscany, and the city turned to learning instead. Its university, founded in 1343, had its most famous son in Galileo Galilei, born in Pisa in 1564, who studied and later taught there.
simp_chinese:
比萨位于阿尔诺河河口，建立了中世纪地中海最伟大的海上帝国之一。其舰队于1063年突袭巴勒莫，在第勒尼安海各处击败撒拉森海盗，并建立了从撒丁到安条克的贸易殖民地。得益于这些商业带来的财富，比萨人在#italic 奇迹广场#!上建造了由主教座堂、洗礼堂和钟楼组成的非凡建筑群——这些纪念碑见证了一座在12世纪鼎盛时期财富与自信似乎永无止境的城市。尽管1284年在梅洛里亚海战中被热那亚彻底击败，比萨的海上霸权就此终结，但这座城市及其非凡的纪念建筑依然屹立。

独立却没能保住。1406年，佛罗伦萨经过长期围攻夺取了比萨；三年后，试图终结教会大分裂的宗教会议虽在这里召开，城市却正在失去成就它的大海，整个15世纪港口都在不断淤塞。1494年法王查理八世入侵意大利，比萨人趁势起事，重建共和国，此后十五年里一次次击退佛罗伦萨的军队，直到1509年城市再度被佛罗伦萨夺回。里窝那取代比萨成为托斯卡纳的主要港口，比萨转而以学术立身。1343年创办的比萨大学，最有名的本地人是1564年生于比萨的伽利略·伽利莱，他在这里求学，后来也在这里任教。

english: Pisagua lies on the Pacific coast of Tarapacá, where the desert mountains descend steeply to the sea. Fishing communities occupied this coast long before the arrival of Europeans, making use of its rich marine resources and maintaining connections with inland valleys. In 1831 Pisagua was authorized as an export port. Its sheltered anchorage gave the otherwise harsh desert shoreline a place from which goods could be carried by sea.
simp_chinese: 皮萨瓜位于塔拉帕卡的太平洋海岸，沙漠山岭陡然下降至海边。早在欧洲人到来之前，渔民社区便已居住在这一海岸，利用丰富的海洋资源，并与内陆谷地保持联系。1831年，皮萨瓜获准作为出口港。其较为避风的泊地使这片严酷的沙漠海岸拥有了一个可由海路运出货物的地方。

sources.title: 328704063 Asentamientos costeros tardios en los valles occidentales norte de Chile Pisagua en el contexto Pica-Tarapaca 900-1540 dC

english: Pisaq crowns a mountain ridge above the Urubamba valley, where Inca terraces sweep down steep slopes toward the river. Its carefully built enclosures, ceremonial precincts and channels formed part of a substantial royal estate associated with Pachacuti in the fifteenth century. Tombs were cut into the cliffs nearby, while irrigated terraces made use of the mountainside. The complex joined agricultural land, residences and sacred spaces in a commanding position above the valley.
simp_chinese: 皮萨克位于乌鲁班巴河谷上方的山脊，印加梯田沿陡坡向河流层层延伸。精心建造的院落、礼仪区和水渠构成一处大型王室庄园的一部分，传与十五世纪的帕查库特克有关。附近的峭壁上开凿了墓穴，灌溉梯田则利用山坡土地。这一建筑群在俯瞰河谷的高处，将耕地、住宅和神圣空间结合起来。

english: The Piscataquis is a tributary of the Penobscot in the forested interior of Maine. Its eastern and western branches meet near Blanchard, from where the river flows generally eastward for about sixty-five miles to join the Penobscot at Howland. Together the branches drain a broad stretch of upland country, carrying its waters toward the larger river and the Atlantic coast.
simp_chinese: 皮斯卡塔基斯河是缅因森林内陆的一条支流，最终汇入佩诺布斯科特河。它的东、西两支在布兰查德附近汇合，此后河水大致向东流约六十五英里，在豪兰与佩诺布斯科特河相接。各条源流汇集广大高地的水，送往大河和大西洋海岸。

english: Piscopeek was the Lenape name for the stream now known as Lawrence Brook, a tributary of the Raritan River in New Jersey. The brook flows north through a low, wooded landscape before joining the Raritan near New Brunswick. Its later name recalls Thomas Lawrence, a New York baker who acquired land in the vicinity in the seventeenth century. The stream and its tributaries drain a broad area south of the Raritan.
simp_chinese: 皮斯科皮克是莱纳佩人对一条溪流的称呼，这条溪流后来被称为劳伦斯溪，是新泽西拉里坦河的支流。它向北流过低平的林地，在新不伦瑞克附近汇入拉里坦河。后来的名字纪念纽约面包师托马斯·劳伦斯，他在十七世纪取得了附近的土地。溪流及其支流汇集拉里坦河南方广大地区的水流。

english: Piscoutagami, later known as Nighthawk Lake, lies in the forested interior west of Lake Abitibi. Its outlet leads into the Frederick House River and thence toward the Abitibi River and James Bay. A French trading post stood at the lake’s outlet in the seventeenth century. In 1785 the Hudson’s Bay Company moved its Frederick House post upriver to the same general area, seeking trade along these inland waters.
simp_chinese: 皮斯库塔加米湖后来被称为夜鹰湖，位于阿比蒂比湖以西的森林内陆。湖水流入弗雷德里克豪斯河，继而流向阿比蒂比河和詹姆斯湾。十七世纪时，湖泊出口处曾有一座法国贸易站。1785年，哈得孙湾公司将弗雷德里克豪斯商站沿河迁往这一带，以争取内陆水道上的贸易。

english:
Písek stands on the Otava in southern Bohemia, its name meaning 'sand' after the riverbeds where early inhabitants panned for gold. King Ottokar II founded a royal town here in 1254. A castle rose above the ford, a monastery was established and a stone bridge crossed the river. A mint also operated here before it was moved to the silver town of Kutná Hora.

Písek became the administrative centre of Prácheňsko in the fourteenth century; under Charles IV its salt and grain warehouses were among Bohemia's largest. Hussite forces later took the town and destroyed the monastery. In 1619–1620, during the Thirty Years' War, the army of Count Bucquoy conquered Písek and killed most of its inhabitants. The royal chamber recovered it in 1623, and its status as a royal town was restored in 1641.
simp_chinese:
皮塞克坐落在南波希米亚的奥塔瓦河畔，城名意为“沙”，源自早期居民淘金的河沙。1254年，奥托卡二世国王在此创建王室城镇。城堡耸立在渡口上方，修道院随之建立，石桥也横跨河流。这里还曾有铸币厂，后来迁往产银的库特纳霍拉。

十四世纪，皮塞克成为普拉亨斯科的行政中心；查理四世统治时期，当地盐仓和粮仓是波希米亚最大的仓库之一。胡斯派军队后来攻取城镇，摧毁修道院。1619至1620年三十年战争期间，布夸伯爵的军队攻克皮塞克，杀死大部分居民。1623年王室财务机构重新取得此地，1641年恢复其王室城市地位。

english: Pishagar lies at the foot of the Molguzar mountains in the country east of Jizzakh. Its name has been interpreted from Sogdian words for the front of a mountain, fitting its position between the heights and the plain. A cave near the village preserves traces of much older human occupation. The streams and valleys descending from the range join the cultivated country around Zomin, while the mountains rise steeply above the settlements at their foot.
simp_chinese: 皮沙噶尔位于吉扎克以东、莫尔古扎尔山麓。地名被解释为来自粟特语中“山前”的词语，与它处于高地和平原之间的位置相符。村附近洞穴保存着更早人类活动的痕迹。山脉流下的溪流和河谷与佐明周围的耕地相接，山峦则在山脚聚落上方陡然升起。

sources.title: 401144678 Toponomic analysis of the names of sacred places in the Jizzakh region

english: Piskorowice lies along the San near Leżajsk, in the river country of Red Ruthenia. The village was part of a royal estate before passing into private ownership, and its farm was leased to tenants. A Polish school with a single class was established here in 1789. The San, running beside the settlement, formed a prominent feature of the local landscape.
simp_chinese: 皮斯科罗维采位于莱扎伊斯克附近的桑河沿岸，属于红鲁塞尼亚的河流地带。村庄曾是王室地产的一部分，后来转入私人所有，其庄园农场出租给佃户。1789年，这里建立了一所单班波兰语学校。桑河沿着居民点流过，是当地地貌的重要特征。

english:
Pismachi' was the second capital of the K'iche' Maya, built after their first mountain seat. According to K'iche' tradition, the founders moved southwest and raised a great ritual centre here. Under the king K'otuja, the ruling lineage tightened its grip on the neighbouring Kaqchikel through marriages between ruling houses. The unity of the K'iche' cracked here when one lineage rebelled against K'otuja and attacked Pismachi'; it failed, and withdrew north to found a town of its own.

Around 1400 K'otuja's son Q'uq'umatz led the ruling lineage a short way north to Q'umarkaj, “the place of old reeds”, and Pismachi' became one of the satellites of Greater Q'umarkaj. From there the K'iche' kingdom expanded under K'iq'ab, until a rebellion in 1470 split the Kaqchikel away to found their own capital, Iximché. The kingdom fell to Pedro de Alvarado in 1524, when Q'umarkaj was burned.

The later city of Santa Cruz del Quiché lies here.
simp_chinese:
皮斯马奇是基切玛雅人的第二座都城，建在他们最初的山中据点之后。基切传统说，先祖向西南迁徙，在此建起一座大型礼仪中心。国王科图哈在位时，统治宗族通过王室联姻加强了对邻近卡克奇克尔人的控制。基切人的团结也在这里出现裂痕：一支宗族反叛科图哈，进攻皮斯马奇，未能得手，向北撤走，另建了自己的城镇。

约1400年，科图哈之子库库马茨带领统治宗族向北迁了不远的路，到库马尔卡赫，意为“古芦苇之地”，皮斯马奇成了大库马尔卡赫的卫星聚落之一。此后基切王国在基卡布治下不断扩张，1470年一场叛乱使卡克奇克尔人脱离，另建都城伊西姆切。1524年，王国败于佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多，库马尔卡赫被焚。

后来的圣克鲁斯德尔基切即位于此地。

english: Monte Pissis rises in the high desert Andes, a vast volcanic massif among the mountains of northwestern Argentina. Despite the aridity of the surrounding landscape, its great elevation allows snow and ice to persist on its slopes. The massif separates the basin of Laguna Verde to the north from the headwaters of the Vinchina and Bermejo rivers to the south. Its exposed heights are a formidable part of the Andean frontier.
simp_chinese: 皮西斯山耸立在干旱的安第斯高地，是阿根廷西北部群山间一座巨大的火山山体。尽管周围地带干燥，极高的海拔仍使其山坡上留有积雪和冰川。山体分隔了北面的韦尔德湖流域与南面的温奇纳河、贝尔梅霍河源区，裸露的高峰构成安第斯边地中一片险峻的山地。

english: The high Andes rise between the dry valleys of Chile and the inland basins of Argentina. In this part of the range, steep ridges and snow-covered summits surround difficult passes, while streams fed by mountain snow descend towards the valleys. Farther north the volcanic massif of Pissis towers above the desert. The great elevation and scarcity of vegetation distinguish these mountains from the inhabited valleys below.
simp_chinese: 安第斯高山耸立在智利干旱河谷与阿根廷内陆盆地之间。这段山脉峰岭陡峭，积雪覆盖的山顶环绕着难以通行的隘口；融雪汇成溪流，向下流入河谷。更北面的皮西斯火山山体高出荒漠。极高的海拔和稀疏的植被，使这里与下方有人居住的河谷迥然不同。

english: Pisticoui is an early French name for the Fox River, which flows south through lakes and prairie country to meet the Illinois River. Its waters drain a broad region west of Lake Michigan. The Jesuit traveler Pierre François Xavier de Charlevoix described the river in the early eighteenth century as coming from Mascouten country, and noted a fall near its mouth called the Coal Fall because coal was found nearby. Rivers like this connected the communities of the interior with the greater Mississippi system.
simp_chinese: 皮斯蒂库伊是福克斯河的早期法语名称。河流向南穿过湖泊与草原，汇入伊利诺伊河，流域覆盖密歇根湖以西的广大地区。十八世纪初，耶稣会旅行者皮埃尔·弗朗索瓦·泽维尔·德·夏勒瓦记载这条河来自马斯库滕人的土地，并提到河口附近一处瀑布，因周围发现煤而称为煤瀑。这类河流将内陆社群与更广大的密西西比水系连接起来。

english:
Pistoia lies northwest of Florence on the Ombrone, beneath the Apennines. A bishop's seat since late antiquity, it became a free commune in 1177 and erected walls and public buildings during its medieval prosperity. Its churches and squares preserve the imprint of a city deeply involved in the politics of Tuscany.

Florence conquered Pistoia in 1254, but submission did not end its internal struggles. Rival noble families aligned with the Black and White Guelph factions, whose violence became known through Dante's account in the Inferno. Florence finally deprived Pistoia of its civic autonomy in 1401. The city's later history was tied to the fortunes of Florence and the Tuscan state, while its cathedral and civic buildings remained reminders of its earlier communal independence.
simp_chinese:
皮斯托亚位于佛罗伦萨西北的翁布罗内河畔，背靠亚平宁山脉。自古代晚期起这里就是主教驻地，1177年成为自由公社；中世纪繁荣时期，城市修筑城墙和公共建筑。教堂与广场保留了这座深度参与托斯卡纳政治的城市的印记。

佛罗伦萨于1254年征服皮斯托亚，但归顺没有结束内部争斗。敌对贵族家族分别支持黑党和白党圭尔夫派，他们之间的暴力因但丁《地狱篇》的描述而为人所知。1401年，佛罗伦萨最终剥夺了皮斯托亚的自治权。此后城市的命运与佛罗伦萨和托斯卡纳国家相连，主教座堂与市政建筑仍使人想起它早先作为独立公社的岁月。

english: The Pitaguary are an Indigenous people of the hills and foothills inland from the Ceará coast. Their communities are associated with the country around the Serra da Aratanha. Local traditions connect their ancestry with Indigenous settlements formed after the conflicts among native peoples, Portuguese and Dutch in the seventeenth century. The memory of shared origins and subsequent division remains important in their history.
simp_chinese: 皮塔瓜里人是塞阿腊海岸内陆山丘和山麓地区的原住民族，其社区与阿拉塔尼亚山地周围的土地相联系。当地传统将他们的祖先与十七世纪原住民、葡萄牙人和荷兰人发生冲突后形成的原住民聚落联系起来。共同起源及后来分离的记忆，在他们的历史中仍占有重要地位。

english:
The Pitahauerat, also called the Tappage, were one of the principal Pawnee bands of the central North American Plains. Their villages lay in the Platte River country, where families lived in earth-covered lodges and planted maize and other crops. Seasonal bison hunts took them away from the villages onto the grasslands. Their name was associated with a position downstream or to the east among the Pawnee communities.

By the late eighteenth century the Pitahauerat were recorded as a distinct band alongside the Chaui, Kitkehahki and Skidi. Pawnee villages moved and sometimes combined as circumstances changed. In the early nineteenth century smallpox epidemics in 1803 and 1825, and growing pressure from neighboring peoples and newcomers strained the Pawnee communities of the Platte River valley.
simp_chinese:
皮塔豪埃拉特人又称塔帕日人，是北美中央平原波尼人的主要群体之一。他们的村落位于普拉特河地区，家庭居住在覆土房屋中，种植玉米等作物。季节性猎牛时，居民离开村落进入草原。他们的名称与波尼社群中靠下游或东方的位置有关。

至十八世纪末，皮塔豪埃拉特已与乔伊、基特克哈基和斯基迪一同被记为独立群体。波尼村落随着环境变化迁移，有时也相互合并。十九世纪初，1803年和1825年的天花疫情以及邻近民族和新来者的压力加重，给普拉特河谷的波尼社群带来困难。

english:
Pitcairn is a small volcanic island in the southeastern Pacific, its steep shores rising above the ocean. Polynesian people inhabited it before European arrival, leaving tools and other traces of their communities. In 1767 Robert Pitcairn sighted the island from HMS Swallow; Captain Philip Carteret named it for him.

In 1790 Fletcher Christian and eight other Bounty mutineers reached Pitcairn with Polynesian men, women and a child from Tahiti. They settled on an island that had been uninhabited when they arrived and burned the Bounty. The island’s incorrect position on the charts helped make it a remote refuge from pursuit. The community’s early years were marked by violence and conflict among the settlers, but their descendants made the remote island their home.
simp_chinese:
皮特凯恩是东南太平洋的小火山岛，陡峭海岸高出海面。欧洲人到来前，波利尼西亚人曾在此居住，留下工具及社群活动的其他痕迹。1767年，罗伯特·皮特凯恩从燕子号上望见此岛；菲利普·卡特雷特船长以他的名字将其命名。

1790年，弗莱彻·克里斯琴与另外八名邦蒂号哗变者，带着来自塔希提的波利尼西亚男女和一名儿童抵达皮特凯恩。他们在当时无人居住的岛上定居，焚毁了邦蒂号；海图上的位置误差使这座偏远岛屿成为躲避追捕的避难地。社群早年充满定居者之间的暴力与冲突，但后裔在这座偏远岛屿建立了家园。

english: Pitcairn is a small volcanic island rising steeply from the southeastern Pacific. Polynesians had lived here before it was sighted by HMS Swallow in 1767. In 1790 nine Bounty mutineers arrived with Tahitian men and women, settled on the island and burned their ship.
simp_chinese: 皮特凯恩是从东南太平洋陡然升起的一座小火山岛。“燕子”号于1767年望见它以前，波利尼西亚人曾在岛上生活。1790年，九名“邦蒂”号叛变者与塔希提男女来到这里定居，随后烧毁了船只。

english: North of Pitcairn, open ocean stretches between the island and the low coral atoll of Oeno. Polynesians had once lived on Pitcairn before nine Bounty mutineers and their Tahitian companions arrived in 1790. They settled there and burned their ship after landing.
simp_chinese: 皮特凯恩以北的开阔大洋延伸在该岛与低矮的奥埃诺珊瑚环礁之间。1790年九名“邦蒂”号叛变者与塔希提同伴到来之前，波利尼西亚人曾在皮特凯恩生活。新来者在此定居，登陆后烧毁了船只。

english: West of Pitcairn, a wide expanse of Pacific water separates the island from the Gambier group. Pitcairn had been inhabited by Polynesians before the arrival of Bounty mutineers and their Tahitian companions in 1790. Their settlement remained remote from the established routes of European shipping.
simp_chinese: 皮特凯恩以西，广阔的太平洋水域将该岛与甘比尔群岛隔开。1790年，“邦蒂”号叛变者和塔希提同伴到来之前，波利尼西亚人曾在皮特凯恩居住。他们的聚居地远离欧洲船只的既有航线。

english: North of Henderson Island, the open Pacific surrounds one of the remote raised coral islands of eastern Polynesia. Henderson was once inhabited by Polynesians.
