In 1819 Captain James Henderson reached it aboard the Hercules, more than two centuries after the expedition of Pedro Fernández de Quirós probably sighted it.
simp_chinese: 亨德森岛以北的开阔太平洋环绕着东波利尼西亚偏远的隆起珊瑚岛之一。波利尼西亚人曾在亨德森岛生活。1819年，詹姆斯·亨德森船长乘“赫拉克勒斯”号抵达此岛；两个多世纪前佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的船队可能曾望见它。

english: North of Ducie, open water extends beyond the low coral atoll at the eastern end of the Pitcairn group. Edward Edwards encountered Ducie in 1791 while searching for the Bounty mutineers aboard HMS Pandora. The atoll lies far east of Pitcairn itself.
simp_chinese: 迪西以北的开阔水域延伸至皮特凯恩群岛东端的低矮珊瑚环礁之外。1791年，爱德华·爱德华兹乘“潘多拉”号搜寻“邦蒂”号叛变者时遇见迪西。该环礁位于皮特凯恩岛远东。

english: East of Ducie Atoll, the open Pacific stretches far beyond the Pitcairn Islands. The low coral atoll was encountered in 1791 by Edward Edwards aboard HMS Pandora. He was searching for the Bounty mutineers, who had settled on Pitcairn the previous year.
simp_chinese: 迪西环礁以东的开阔太平洋远远延伸至皮特凯恩群岛之外。1791年，爱德华·爱德华兹乘“潘多拉”号遇见这座低矮珊瑚环礁。他当时正在搜寻“邦蒂”号叛变者，后者已于前一年在皮特凯恩定居。

english: Southeast of Ducie, the Pacific opens beyond the easternmost atoll of the Pitcairn group. In 1791 Edward Edwards sighted the low coral land from HMS Pandora during his search for the Bounty mutineers. The island he named Ducie lies far from the group’s volcanic island of Pitcairn.
simp_chinese: 迪西东南方，太平洋延伸至皮特凯恩群岛最东端的环礁之外。1791年，爱德华·爱德华兹乘“潘多拉”号搜寻“邦蒂”号叛变者时望见这片低矮珊瑚陆地。他命名的迪西岛远离群岛中的皮特凯恩火山岛。

english: Between Henderson and Ducie, the open Pacific Ocean separates a raised coral island from a low atoll. Pedro Fernández de Quirós’s expedition probably sighted both in 1606. Later, in 1791, Edward Edwards encountered Ducie while searching the Pacific for the Bounty mutineers.
simp_chinese: 亨德森与迪西之间，开阔大洋将一座隆起珊瑚岛与低矮环礁隔开。佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的船队可能于1606年望见两岛。后来，爱德华·爱德华兹于1791年在太平洋搜寻“邦蒂”号叛变者时遇见迪西。

english: South of Ducie Atoll, the ocean reaches into the open southeastern Pacific. Ducie is a low ring of coral in the remote Pitcairn group. In 1791 Edward Edwards encountered it while commanding HMS Pandora on a search for the Bounty mutineers.
simp_chinese: 迪西环礁以南，海洋延伸至开阔的东南太平洋。迪西是偏远皮特凯恩群岛中的低矮珊瑚环。1791年，爱德华·爱德华兹指挥“潘多拉”号搜寻“邦蒂”号叛变者时遇见该环礁。

english: South of Henderson Island, open water lies between the isolated islands of the Pitcairn group. Polynesians once lived on Henderson, a raised coral island. Captain James Henderson reached it in 1819 aboard the Hercules, and the island later came to bear his name.
simp_chinese: 亨德森岛以南的开阔水域位于皮特凯恩群岛的孤立岛屿之间。波利尼西亚人曾在亨德森这座隆起珊瑚岛生活。1819年，詹姆斯·亨德森船长乘“赫拉克勒斯”号抵达此岛，岛屿后来以他的名字命名。

english: South of Pitcairn Island, the open Pacific surrounds a small and steep volcanic landfall. The island had once been inhabited by Polynesians. In 1790 nine mutineers from the Bounty arrived with Tahitian men and women and established a settlement, burning their ship after coming ashore.
simp_chinese: 皮特凯恩岛以南的开阔太平洋环绕着这座陡峭的小火山岛。波利尼西亚人曾在岛上居住。1790年，九名“邦蒂”号叛变者与塔希提男女来到岛上建立聚居地，并在登陆后烧毁了船只。

english:
The Pitchibourenik were an Indigenous people of the eastern James Bay country, and their name is attached to the Eastmain River, which the Cree call Iismeniiu-siipii. A Jesuit account of 1660 names the Pitchibourenik among the peoples of the region, and Louis Jolliet's 1679 map called the river the Rivière des Pachibourouniou after them.

The river rises in the Otish Mountains and runs more than 700 km to James Bay. In 1672 mica found at its mouth gave it the name Slude, an old word for mica, and by 1675 the name East Main had spread over the eastern shore of the bay. A trading post, called Slude River Post or East Main Post, was set up on the river in 1684. Guillaume Delisle's map of 1703 still marks the river as the Pitchibourouni.
simp_chinese:
皮奇布伦尼克人是詹姆斯湾东部地区的原住民，其名称与东梅恩河相连，该河在克里语中称为 Iismeniiu-siipii。1660年的一份耶稣会记述将皮奇布伦尼克人列为该地区的民族之一，1679年路易·若利埃的地图则以他们之名将该河标为“帕希布鲁尼乌人的河”。

这条河发源于奥蒂什山，流入詹姆斯湾的路程超过700公里。1672年，河口发现的云母使它得名 Slude（一个旧词，意为云母）；到1675年，东梅恩这一名称已扩展至海湾东岸。1684年，河上设立了一座小型贸易站，称为斯卢德河站或东梅恩站。1703年，纪尧姆·德利尔的地图仍将该河标为皮奇布鲁尼河。

english:
Piteå grew at the mouth of the Pite River, where the inland waterways reach the Gulf of Bothnia. Its church and market served a broad hinterland, bringing coastal farmers and merchants into contact with the people of Lapland. As the land slowly rose, the harbour and town moved downstream more than once to remain accessible to ships.

The earliest church and market site lay at Gamla Kyrkbyn, upstream from the coast. In the fifteenth century the parish centre moved to Öjebyn, where a stone church was built. Gustavus Adolphus granted Piteå town privileges there in 1621. Its merchants competed fiercely with neighbouring Luleå, even asking the government in 1634 to abolish their rival town. After a fire devastated Öjebyn in 1666, Piteå was moved to Häggholmen near the coast, where the approach was deeper. The new town was burned by Russian forces during the Great Northern War in 1721 and had to be rebuilt.
simp_chinese:
皮特奥兴起于皮特河口，内陆水道在此通向波的尼亚湾。它的教堂与集市服务于广阔腹地，使沿海农民、商人与拉普兰居民相互往来。随着土地缓慢抬升，港口与城镇不止一次向下游迁移，以便船只继续驶入。

最早的教堂与集市位于海岸上游的加姆拉许尔克比。十五世纪，堂区中心迁至厄耶比，并在那里建起石教堂。1621年，古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫在此授予皮特奥城市特权。当地商人与邻近的吕勒奥竞争激烈，甚至于1634年要求政府撤销对手的城市地位。1666年大火烧毁厄耶比后，皮特奥迁至靠近海岸的海格霍尔门，那里航道更深。1721年大北方战争期间，俄军焚毁新城，城镇只得重建。

english: The Maly Uzen flows through the dry steppe around Piterka, southward toward the enclosed Kamysh-Samara lakes. Its winding course crosses the open land east of the Volga without reaching the sea. Seasonal changes in water and pasture shaped movement across this part of the Caspian lowland. The village of Piterka was established later; the river valley had long been part of the pastoral country between the Volga and Ural.
simp_chinese: 小乌津河流经皮捷尔卡周围的干燥草原，向南流向内流的卡梅什-萨马拉湖群。它蜿蜒穿过伏尔加河以东的开阔地带，并不流入海洋。水量与牧场的季节变化影响着人们在里海低地这一地区的迁徙。皮捷尔卡村庄建立于较晚年代；此前河谷已长期属于伏尔加河与乌拉尔河之间的牧业地区。

english:
Pitești lies on the Argeș River in Wallachia. Its first known documentary mention dates to 1386, when Prince Mircea granted a local mill to Cozia Monastery. Situated on important routes toward Transylvania, it developed as a trading town and served as a temporary residence for Wallachian princes. An Armenian community was present by the late fourteenth century.

Several rulers issued documents from Pitești, and Prince Constantin Șerban financed the Orthodox church of Saint George, completed in 1656. The town also suffered from conflict: Habsburg troops occupied it in 1689 and attacked again in the wars of the early eighteenth century. A traveller described some 250 houses and seven churches in 1780.
simp_chinese:
皮特什蒂位于瓦拉几亚的阿尔杰什河畔。已知最早的文献记载是1386年，彼时君主米尔恰将当地一座磨坊赠予科济亚修道院。这里处于通往特兰西瓦尼亚的重要道路上，发展为商贸城镇，也曾是瓦拉几亚君主的临时驻地。14世纪末，当地已有亚美尼亚人社群。

多位君主曾在皮特什蒂颁布文书。君主康斯坦丁·谢尔班出资修建的东正教圣乔治教堂于1656年竣工。城镇亦受战争影响：哈布斯堡军队于1689年占领这里，并在18世纪初的战争中再次进攻。一位旅行者在1780年记载镇上约有250座房屋和七座教堂。

english:
Pithapuram, the ancient Pishtapura, is a place of pilgrimage as well as an old seat of kings. The Kukkuteswara temple complex includes a shrine to Puruhutika Devi, revered as one of the great Shakti pithas. Pithapuram was the birthplace of the fourteenth-century saint Sripada Sri Vallabha. Long before his time, the Eastern Chalukyas had made it their first capital before moving their court to Vengi.

The family that became the zamindars of Pithapuram arrived in the Godavari country in 1571 and received the jagir of Anaparthi. They served as military leaders at Rajamahendravaram, commanding troops. In 1749 Rustum Khan, a general of the Nizam of Hyderabad, granted them a sanad confirming their zamindari. They entered a permanent revenue settlement with the British in 1802.
simp_chinese:
毗多补罗古称比湿多补罗，既是朝圣之地，也是历代君王的驻地。库库泰什瓦尔神庙群中有供奉普鲁胡蒂卡女神的圣祠，被尊为重要的性力派圣所之一。十四世纪圣者室利波陀·室利伐腊跋出生于此。更早以前，东遮娄其王朝曾以此为首都，后来才将宫廷迁往文吉。

后来成为毗多补罗柴明达尔的家族于1571年来到戈达瓦里地区，获授阿纳帕尔蒂采邑。他们在拉贾蒙德里担任军事首领，指挥军队。1749年，海得拉巴尼扎姆的将领鲁斯塔姆汗颁发文书，确认他们的柴明达尔地位。1802年，这个家族又与英国达成永久土地税安排。

english:
Pitic stands near the meeting of the Sonora and San Miguel rivers in the dry interior of Sonora. Its name has been interpreted as “where two rivers meet.” Indigenous communities lived in this river country before Spanish military and missionary settlements changed the balance of power in the region.

In 1741 Governor Agustín de Vildósola established the presidio of San Pedro de la Conquista del Pitic. It formed part of the Spanish response to conflict with the Seri, whose homeland extended west toward the coast. In 1771 Seri people who had resisted Spanish forces at Cerro Prieto settled near Pitic, where a mission and irrigation ditch were built. The settlement later grew into Hermosillo, briefly the capital of Sonora after Mexican independence.
simp_chinese:
皮蒂克位于索诺拉河与圣米格尔河汇合处附近，地处索诺拉干旱内陆。其名称被解释为“两河汇合之处”。西班牙军事和传教聚落改变这一地区的力量关系之前，原住民社区已生活在河谷中。

1741年，总督阿古斯丁·德·维尔多索拉建立圣佩德罗·德·拉·孔基斯塔·德·皮蒂克要塞，作为西班牙人应对与塞里人冲突的措施之一。塞里人的故土向西延伸至海岸。1771年，曾在普列托山抵抗西班牙军队的塞里人迁居皮蒂克附近，当局为他们建立传教区和灌渠。此地后来发展为埃莫西约，在墨西哥独立后曾短暂成为索诺拉首府。

english:
Pitigliano rises on a rocky height in southern Tuscany, its clustered houses and fortress overlooking the deep valleys below. The district was inhabited in Etruscan times, and the medieval town became the seat of a county under the Aldobrandeschi. A Jewish community later made its home here, earning Pitigliano the name of Little Jerusalem.

The county passed to the Orsini family in 1293, beginning a long series of intermittent wars with Siena that lasted for some 150 years. A settlement in 1455 recognized Pitigliano's status as a county while placing it under Sienese sovereignty. The Orsini castle remained the centre of their lordship. In 1604 Count Giovanni Antonio ceded the fief to Grand Duke Ferdinando I de' Medici, bringing it into the Tuscan state.
simp_chinese:
皮蒂利亚诺高踞托斯卡纳南部的岩石高地，房屋与堡垒俯瞰下方河谷。伊特鲁里亚时代这一地区便有人居住，中世纪城镇后来成为阿尔多布兰代斯基家族伯国的驻地。犹太社群后来在此定居，使皮蒂利亚诺获得“小耶路撒冷”之名。

1293年，伯国转入奥尔西尼家族手中，由此开始与锡耶纳断断续续持续约150年的战争。1455年的协议承认皮蒂利亚诺的伯国地位，同时将其置于锡耶纳宗主权之下。奥尔西尼城堡仍是领地的中心。1604年，乔瓦尼·安东尼奥伯爵将封地转让给大公费迪南多一世·德美第奇，使它归入托斯卡纳国家。

english: Pititinga lies on the northern coast of Rio Grande do Norte, where low dunes and sandy beaches meet the tropical Atlantic. The shore is exposed to winds that move sand along the coast, while shallow coastal waters support fishing communities. This is part of the northeastern Brazilian coast near the great bend where the shoreline turns westward toward Ceará.
simp_chinese: 皮蒂廷加位于北里奥格兰德州北部海岸，低矮沙丘和沙滩在此与热带大西洋相接。海岸暴露在沿岸搬运沙粒的风中，浅海水域则养育着渔民社区。这里属于巴西东北海岸，靠近岸线向西转向塞阿拉州的大弯处。

english: The Pitkachi were a Yokuts people of the San Joaquin River, whose territory lay along the river's southern bank and the plain to the west. Their villages stood near dependable springs, streams and sloughs. For much of the year people lived in established villages, then traveled through their territory in the warmer months to gather plants and obtain game and fish. Across the river lived the Hoyima, another Yokuts community, while the Gashowu occupied country nearer the foothills.
simp_chinese: 皮特卡奇人是圣华金河地区的一支约库茨人，其土地沿河南岸和西面的平原分布。村庄建在水源可靠的泉水、溪流与河汊附近。一年中大部分时间，人们居住在固定村庄；天气转暖后，他们在领地内移动，采集植物，捕猎和捕鱼。河对岸住着另一支约库茨人霍伊马，靠近山麓的地区则是加绍乌人的土地。

english: Pit’laxá is the name used by the Pilagá, an Indigenous people of the central Chaco. They speak a Guaycuruan language related to those of the Qom and Mocoví. Their homeland includes the wetlands and dry woodlands of the Pilcomayo basin, a landscape transformed by seasonal floods. Traditionally people hunted, fished and gathered wild foods, moving between places where water and other resources were available.
simp_chinese: 皮特拉夏是皮拉加人的自称，他们是查科中部的原住民族。他们使用瓜伊库鲁语族语言，与科姆人及莫科维人的语言有亲缘关系。故土包括皮尔科马约河流域的湿地与干林，季节性洪水不断改变当地景观。人们传统上狩猎、捕鱼、采集野生食物，在有水源和其他资源的地点之间迁徙。

english: The Pitlyar flows from the Poluy uplands toward the lower Ob, through a country of forest-tundra and wetlands. Its largest tributary, the Uryogan, joins from the left. Near the Ob the river reaches a floodplain of shallow waters and channels, where fish move as water levels rise and fall. Fishing at the mouths of rivers such as the Pitlyar formed part of the seasonal life of Khanty communities along the Ob.
simp_chinese: 皮特利亚尔河从波卢伊高地流向鄂毕河下游，穿过森林苔原和湿地。其最大支流乌里约甘河从左岸汇入。接近鄂毕河时，河流进入浅水与水道交错的泛滥平原，鱼类随着水位涨落移动。在皮特利亚尔等河口捕鱼，是鄂毕河沿岸汉特人社区季节生活的一部分。

english:
Pitsunda occupies a wooded promontory on the Black Sea coast, the site of ancient Pityous. Its great domed cathedral, built at the end of the tenth century, became the seat of the Catholicos of Abkhazia, whose authority extended across western Georgia. The church's painted walls and substantial masonry stand among the remains of a much older coastal settlement known to Greek and Roman writers.

In the late sixteenth century, as Ottoman influence spread along the coast, the catholicos moved his residence to Gelati. The cathedral nevertheless retained its ceremonial importance. The traveller Jean Chardin reported that the catholicos returned with bishops and princes to consecrate holy chrism, preserving a link between the old coastal see and the church's new inland seat.
simp_chinese:
皮聪大位于黑海岸一处林木茂盛的岬角，是古代皮提乌斯的所在地。十世纪末建造的穹顶大教堂成为阿布哈兹大牧首的驻地，其教会权威遍及格鲁吉亚西部。教堂的壁画和厚重石墙矗立在希腊和罗马作家所知的古老海滨聚落遗迹之间。

十六世纪末，随着奥斯曼影响沿海岸扩展，大牧首将驻地迁往格拉特修道院，教堂仍保有仪式上的重要地位。旅行家让·夏尔丹记载，大牧首与主教和诸侯返回此处祝圣圣油，使古老的海滨主教座与教会新的内陆驻地保持联系。

english:
Cape Pitsunda projects into the eastern Black Sea along the coast of Abkhazia, below the Caucasus mountains. Sea routes connect settlements that can be difficult to reach overland, carrying traders, travellers and supplies between anchorages. Fishing and nearby agriculture support livelihoods, while storms and shifting winds demand knowledge of the shore.

The wider Pitsunda area has Christian traditions connected with the eastern Roman and medieval Georgian worlds. In the later Middle Ages, Italian merchants participated in Black Sea commerce while power on the eastern shore shifted among local rulers and neighbouring states. Ottoman expansion changed trade and political relationships; increasing Russian influence in the early nineteenth century brought further competition for authority.
simp_chinese:
皮聪大角伸入阿布哈兹沿岸的黑海东部，林地与低地在高加索群山脚下接近海岸。海路连接一些陆路不易到达的聚落，商人、旅客和补给在锚地之间往来。捕鱼和附近乡村的农业支持地方生计，风暴与多变海风则要求船员熟悉岸线。

皮聪大一带与东罗马及中世纪格鲁吉亚的基督教传统有关，宗教机构使海岸与远方保持联系。中世纪后期，意大利商人参与黑海贸易，东岸的政治权力也在地方统治者与邻近势力之间变化。奥斯曼扩张改变了海上贸易和政治关系；十九世纪初俄国影响增加，带来新的权力竞争。

english: Pitt Bank is a submerged atoll in the southwestern Chagos Archipelago, its shallow rim lying beneath the Indian Ocean near Egmont Atoll. Portuguese sailors knew the Chagos in the sixteenth century, and the reefs could be treacherous: the Conceição was wrecked at Peros Banhos in 1556. French settlers established plantations on islands of the archipelago in the late eighteenth century, using enslaved labour. In 1814 the Chagos passed with Mauritius to Britain.
simp_chinese: 皮特浅滩是查戈斯群岛西南部一座没入海中的环礁，其浅礁边缘位于埃格蒙特环礁附近的印度洋水下。十六世纪葡萄牙水手已知晓查戈斯群岛，群岛的礁盘也可能危及航行：1556年，“圣母受孕号”在佩罗斯巴纽斯触礁。十八世纪末，法国殖民者在群岛一些岛屿建立种植园，役使奴隶劳动。1814年，查戈斯随毛里求斯转归英国。

english: Pitta Pitta country lies in the inland river country of western Queensland, around the upper reaches of the Georgina and neighbouring waterways. Pitta Pitta is both a people and a language name. The region's open plains and river channels form part of a network of Aboriginal homelands extending across the dry interior.
simp_chinese: 皮塔皮塔人的土地位于昆士兰西部内陆河流地区，靠近乔治娜河上游和相邻水道。皮塔皮塔既是族群名称，也是语言名称。当地开阔平原与河道属于横跨干旱内陆的一系列原住民家园。

english:
Pitten lies in the eastern Alpine foothills south of Vienna. A document of 869 records the gift of property here by the nun Peretcunda to the bishopric of Freising. The county of Pitten belonged to Styria until the early sixteenth century. Its parish was required to pay tithes to Reichersberg Abbey in 1144 and was incorporated into the Augustinian house in 1456.

Iron ore began to be mined at Pitten in the eighteenth century, and from 1789 it was smelted locally. The ore was valued for its purity and high manganese content. Early in the nineteenth century a foundry worked the iron produced there. In 1828 Vinzenz Sterz established a paper manufactory in a former flour and saw mill, adding another trade to the valley's mills and furnaces.
simp_chinese:
皮滕位于维也纳以南的东阿尔卑斯山麓。869年的文书记载，修女佩雷特昆达将当地财产赠予弗赖辛主教区。皮滕伯国直到十六世纪初都属于施蒂里亚。1144年，皮滕教区被要求向赖歇斯贝格修道院缴纳什一税；1456年，教区并入这座奥斯定会修院。

十八世纪，皮滕开始开采铁矿，1789年起又在当地冶炼。矿石以纯度高、含锰量丰富著称。十九世纪初，一座铸造厂加工这里生产的铁。1828年，文岑茨·施特尔茨在一座旧粮磨和锯木厂内建立造纸工场，为河谷的磨坊和熔炉增添了新的行业。

english: The Piu Piu forest covers a mountain range on the eastern slopes of the central Peruvian Andes. Cloud forest gives way to warmer vegetation below, while streams rise in the high ridges and descend towards the Chanchamayo and Perené valleys. The Tulumayo, Pichanaki and other rivers carry water from these steep forested slopes into the wider Amazonian drainage.
simp_chinese: 皮乌皮乌森林覆盖秘鲁中部安第斯东坡的一条山脉。云雾林向下过渡为较温暖地区的植被，溪流发源于高山脊，流向昌查马约和佩雷内河谷。图卢马约河、皮查纳基河等河流将陡峭森林山坡上的水带入更广阔的亚马孙水系。

english: Piumhi lies among the hills and river valleys of western Minas Gerais. Portuguese prospectors entered the region seeking gold during the eighteenth century, and a settlement developed around the workings. A chapel dedicated to Nossa Senhora do Livramento served the community; its parish gained formal recognition in 1803. The surrounding streams form part of the headwater country of central Brazil.
simp_chinese: 皮乌伊位于米纳斯吉拉斯西部丘陵与河谷之间。十八世纪，葡萄牙探矿者进入该地区寻找黄金，矿区周围逐渐形成聚落。一座供奉解救圣母的小教堂为社区服务，其堂区于1803年获得正式承认。周围溪流属于巴西中部的河流源头地区。

english: Piumhi lies near the headwaters of the São Francisco in western Minas Gerais, surrounded by hills and open country. In 1731 João Batista Maciel led an expedition from Pitangui in search of gold and returned with news of mineral discoveries in the Piumhi backlands. Prospectors and settlers followed, and a parish was established in the eighteenth century as a community took shape in the region.
simp_chinese: 皮乌米位于米纳斯吉拉斯西部，靠近圣弗朗西斯科河源头，周围是丘陵与开阔地。1731年，若昂·巴蒂斯塔·马西埃尔从皮坦吉率队寻金，回来时带来了皮乌米腹地发现矿藏的消息。寻矿者和定居者随后到来，随着当地社区形成，十八世纪设立了堂区。

english: Piveh Zhan lies in the upland country southwest of Mashhad, near the old route toward Nishapur. Caravanserais in this district provided shelter for travellers crossing Khorasan. Among them is the brick-built Alaqaband caravanserai near Deh Sorkh, whose form is associated with the Timurid period and which was repaired in later centuries. The village belongs to a landscape of mountain roads and scattered settlements serving movement between the two cities.
simp_chinese: 皮韦詹位于马什哈德西南的高地，靠近通往内沙布尔的古道。这个地区的商队驿站为穿越呼罗珊的旅人提供栖身之所。其中德赫索尔赫附近的阿拉格班德驿站以砖砌成，其建筑形式与帖木儿时期有关，后世又曾修缮。村庄所在的山路与散布聚落，共同构成两座城市之间的通行地带。

english: Pismanta lies in the Iglesia valley among the mountains of San Juan, where warm springs rise from the ground. The waters were known to the indigenous inhabitants of the region, who used them for their reputed healing properties. A local legend associates the springs with a Huarpe chief named Pismanta, who hid in a cave rather than surrender to the conquerors. The valley forms part of a dry mountain landscape east of the high Andes.
simp_chinese: 皮斯曼塔位于圣胡安群山之间的伊格莱西亚河谷，温泉从这里的地下涌出。当地原住民早已知道这些泉水，并因其传说中的疗效而加以利用。当地传说将温泉与瓦尔佩酋长皮斯曼塔联系在一起：据说他宁愿藏身山洞，也不向征服者投降。这座河谷是安第斯高山以东干旱山地的一部分。

english: Pi County lies northwest of Chengdu on the irrigated plain fed by the Min River. It is associated with the ancient rulers of Shu, Wangdi and Congdi, honoured together at the Wangcong shrine. Tradition credits Wangdi with teaching agriculture and Congdi with controlling floods; another tale says Wangdi became a cuckoo whose call urged farmers to begin their work. The stories connect the county's fields with the remembered origins of Shu.
simp_chinese: 郫县位于成都西北的平原，田地得岷江水灌溉。这里与古蜀国的望帝、丛帝相联系，望丛祠共同祭祀二人。传说望帝教民农耕，丛帝治理水患；又说望帝化为杜鹃，以啼声催促农人耕作。这些故事将县境田野与人们记忆中的蜀地起源联系起来。

english: The Pixipixi were one of the Indigenous peoples of Marajó, the great island at the mouth of the Amazon. Portuguese sources grouped them with other island peoples under the name Nheengaíba, a label applied to speakers of several different languages. In 1658 the Jesuit António Vieira negotiated with peoples of the island as Portuguese missionaries and colonists sought to extend their influence there.
simp_chinese: 皮希皮希人是亚马孙河口马拉若岛上的原住民族之一。葡萄牙文献将他们与岛上其他民族合称为涅恩加伊巴，这个名称被用于称呼说多种不同语言的群体。1658年，耶稣会士安东尼奥·维埃拉与岛上诸民族进行交涉，当时葡萄牙传教士和殖民者正试图将势力扩展到这里。

english:
Placentia stands beside a sheltered harbour on Newfoundland's southern coast. Its wide stony beach offered a convenient place to salt and dry fish, and Basque crews used the harbour as a seasonal fishing base by the early sixteenth century. The Beothuk also used the bay, though expanding European settlement restricted their access to its fish and seals.

The French made Plaisance their capital in Newfoundland and built a succession of forts to protect the harbour and neighbouring fisheries. During the wars of Louis XIV, its small garrison and privateers resisted English attacks. The Treaty of Utrecht in 1713 transferred the settlement to Britain, and the French inhabitants departed for Île Royale the following year. Under British rule Placentia remained a substantial fishing town; in 1786 the visiting Prince William estimated its population at between 1,500 and 2,000.
simp_chinese:
普拉森舍坐落在纽芬兰南岸一处受庇护的港湾旁。宽阔的石滩便于腌晒鱼获，十六世纪初，巴斯克船员已将港口作为季节性渔业基地。贝奥图克人也利用这片海湾，但不断扩大的欧洲定居限制了他们获取鱼类和海豹等资源。

法国人在纽芬兰以普莱桑斯为首府，先后修筑多座堡垒，保护港口及附近渔场。路易十四的战争期间，小规模守军与私掠船抵御了英军进攻。1713年《乌得勒支条约》将聚落转交英国，法国居民次年迁往皇家岛。英国统治下，普拉森舍仍是一座规模可观的渔业城镇；1786年前来巡视的威廉王子估计，这里有1500至2000人。

english:
Placentia Bay opens southward from Newfoundland into the Atlantic, its long shores broken by islands and sheltered coves. Basque fishermen were among the Europeans drawn to its cod, and by the seventeenth century Placentia was an important harbour for the seasonal fishery. The French called it Plaisance and made it the centre of their Newfoundland colony.

French authorities established a fortified settlement in 1662 to protect their fishing interests. Residents and visiting crews shared the work of the fishery, while forts guarded the harbour through wars with England. The colony also offered ships a port of call on the route through Cabot Strait. Under the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713, France abandoned its Newfoundland colony and moved its fortified headquarters to Louisbourg on Cape Breton Island.
simp_chinese:
普拉森舍湾从纽芬兰南岸向大西洋敞开，漫长海岸间散布岛屿和避风小湾。巴斯克渔民是最早被鳕鱼吸引到这里的欧洲人之一；到十七世纪，普拉森舍已是季节性渔业的重要港口。法国人称其为普莱桑斯，并将它作为纽芬兰殖民地的中心。

1662年，法国当局建立设防定居点，保护本国渔业利益。常住居民与到访船员共同经营渔业，英法战争期间堡垒守卫着港口。殖民地也是途经卡伯特海峡的船只停靠之处。1713年《乌得勒支条约》签订后，法国放弃纽芬兰殖民地，将设防的海上总部迁至布雷顿角岛的路易斯堡。

english: On the eastern fringes of the Atlas, high plains and shallow depressions interrupt the mountain chains. The Tamlelt plain lies among the low ranges of the eastern High Atlas, while the Chott Tigri basin is bordered by Jebel Lakhdar and Jebel Bouarfa. Sparse vegetation and seasonal water distinguish this open country from the better-watered mountain slopes farther north. The land falls away towards the dry interior on the edge of the Sahara.
simp_chinese: 在阿特拉斯山脉东缘，高原和浅洼地分隔着一条条山岭。塔姆莱勒特平原位于东部高阿特拉斯的低矮山脉之间，提格里盐沼盆地则以拉赫达尔山和布阿尔法山为界。稀疏植被与季节性水流使这片开阔土地有别于更北方雨水较多的山坡；地势逐渐下降，通向撒哈拉边缘干燥的内陆。

english: The Tamlelt plain lies among the low chains of the eastern High Atlas, below the high plateaux to the north. Streams descend from those uplands into the basin, where much of their water sinks into the ground or evaporates. The Oued Bouarfa crosses the plain, and springs emerge along its margins. This is an open landscape of sparse vegetation, set between the mountain ridges and the drier country towards the Sahara.
simp_chinese: 塔姆莱勒特平原位于东部高阿特拉斯的低山之间，地势低于北面的高原。溪流从高地汇入盆地，大部分水渗入地下或蒸发。布阿尔法河穿过平原，边缘也有泉水涌出。这片开阔土地植被稀疏，夹在山岭与通往撒哈拉的干燥地区之间。

english: In the eastern High Atlas, low mountain chains enclose the broad Tamlelt plain. Streams from the high plateaux to the north enter the depression and often disappear through seepage or evaporation. At the southern edge, other channels drain towards the Oued Bouanane and the Guir. The dry plain and its bordering hills form part of the transition from the Atlas uplands to the lands and oases on the northern fringe of the Sahara.
simp_chinese: 在东部高阿特拉斯，低矮山岭围着广阔的塔姆莱勒特平原。从北面高原流来的溪流进入洼地，水常因渗漏或蒸发而消失。南缘的另一些河道则流向布阿纳纳河，再汇入吉尔河。干燥的平原及其边缘丘陵，构成阿特拉斯高地向撒哈拉北缘土地和绿洲的过渡地带。

english: The Tamlelt plain occupies a depression within the eastern High Atlas, where low ranges give way to dry open ground. The northern part receives streams from the high plateaux, their waters largely lost to infiltration and evaporation. In the south, channels including the Oued Haloua flow towards the Bouanane and the Guir. Springs along the edges of the basin provide water in a landscape otherwise marked by the aridity of the Saharan fringe.
simp_chinese: 塔姆莱勒特平原占据东部高阿特拉斯的一处洼地，低山在这里让位于开阔干燥的土地。北部接纳高原流来的溪水，大部分水渗入地下或蒸发。南部的哈卢阿河等河道则流向布阿纳纳河和吉尔河。盆地边缘的泉水为这片带有撒哈拉边缘干旱特征的土地提供了水源。

english: Plasencia stands beside the Jerte in northern Extremadura. Founded by King Alfonso VIII of Castile in 1186, it became a bishop's seat shortly afterwards and governed a substantial surrounding territory. Its council was reorganised under a royal privilege confirmed in 1346, with authority concentrated in a smaller group of officials. In 1442 King John II granted the city to the Zúñiga family, ending its direct royal status. It returned to the Crown in 1488, when Ferdinand pledged at the cathedral to uphold its laws and privileges. Noble families nevertheless continued to dominate municipal government. The sixteenth century brought population growth and extensive building: work continued on the new cathedral, the town hall was enlarged, and an aqueduct was built to supply the city. Later hardship, epidemic disease and emigration contributed to stagnation in the seventeenth century. Plasencia's civic and religious buildings preserve the imprint of a city whose institutions reached well beyond its walls.
simp_chinese: 普拉森西亚位于埃斯特雷马杜拉北部的赫尔特河畔。卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索八世于1186年建立此城，此后不久这里成为主教驻地，并管辖周围广阔地区。1346年确认的一项王室特许令重组了市议会，权力集中到较少数的官员手中。1442年，国王胡安二世将城市授予苏尼加家族，结束了其直属王室的地位。1488年，普拉森西亚重新归入王室；费尔南多在大教堂前承诺维护城市的法律与特权。然而贵族家族仍控制市政事务。十六世纪人口增长，建筑活动兴盛：新大教堂继续施工，市政厅得到扩建，并修建了为城市供水的高架水渠。此后的困难、疫病和移民促成了十七世纪的停滞。城市的公共与宗教建筑，留存着一个权力延伸至城墙之外的地方中心的印记。

english:
Plauen developed in the Vogtland of central Europe, a region whose name recalls the authority of medieval imperial advocates. Its town life grew around local lordship, markets, and routes through the valleys of the region. Craftsmen and merchants depended on the surrounding agricultural countryside, while fortifications and civic institutions distinguished the town from neighboring villages. Control of Plauen mattered within the changing relationships among local lords and larger Saxon powers.

In 1430 Hussite forces took and burned the town. The Reformation was introduced in Plauen in 1524, and a major fire destroyed much of the town in 1548. Cotton textiles became important: a municipal ordinance of 1600 recognised a guild producing fine cloth. The Thirty Years' War brought plunder, fire and plague before the town recovered.
simp_chinese:
普劳恩发展于中欧福格特兰地区，地域名称保留中世纪帝国代理官权威的历史记忆。城市生活围绕地方领主、市场及河谷道路成长。手工业者和商人依赖周围农业乡村，城防与市政机构则使城镇同邻近村庄有所区别。在地方领主和更大萨克森势力关系变化之中，控制普劳恩也具有政治意义。

1430年胡斯派军队攻占并焚毁城镇。1524年普劳恩推行宗教改革，1548年大火又毁坏大部分城区。棉纺织日渐重要：1600年的市政条例承认生产细布的行会。三十年战争带来劫掠、火灾与瘟疫，城镇后来才逐渐恢复。

english: On the Plava stood the village of Sergiyevskoye, named for its wooden church of Sergius of Radonezh. An archival account dates the estate’s foundation to 1670 and associates it with Alexander Khitrovo. In the eighteenth century the village passed to the Gagarin family. They began a stone church near their estate in 1774, overlooking the trading square. The river valley and the road between Tula and Mtsensk placed the village within the rural landscape south of Moscow.
simp_chinese: 普拉瓦河畔曾有谢尔吉耶夫斯科耶村，以供奉拉多涅日的谢尔盖的木教堂得名。一份档案记载将庄园创建追溯到1670年，并与亚历山大·希特罗沃联系起来。十八世纪，村庄转归加加林家族。1774年，他们在庄园附近动工修建石教堂，俯瞰贸易广场。河谷和图拉至姆岑斯克的道路，使村庄成为莫斯科以南乡村的一部分。

english: Pleasant Bay lies near the elbow of Cape Cod, behind a long barrier of sand that separates its sheltered waters from the Atlantic. Tides enter through openings in the beach, while waves and currents reshape the outer shore. The bay and its watershed were part of the homeland of the Nauset, Monomoyick and Wampanoag peoples, who occupied the area for thousands of years. Marshes, islands and shallow water form a varied landscape within the curve of the cape.
simp_chinese: 普莱森特湾位于科德角弯曲处附近，长长的沙质屏障将较受遮蔽的湾水与大西洋隔开。潮水通过沙滩缺口进入，波浪与水流则不断重塑外侧海岸。海湾及其流域是瑙塞特人、莫诺莫伊克人和万帕诺亚格人的故土之一，他们在此居住了数千年。沼泽、岛屿和浅水在海角弧形海岸内构成多样的景观。

english: Plenița lies in western Oltenia, on the northern edge of the Wallachian plain, inland from the Danube. Shallow valleys cut through the land around the settlement, their intermittent streams flowing after rain and the melting of snow. Archaeological finds at the nearby place known as Cetățuia lui Matei Bârdău testify to occupation in the area long before the villages of the plain took their later form.
simp_chinese: 普莱尼察位于奥尔泰尼亚西部、多瑙河以北的瓦拉几亚平原边缘。村庄周围地势被浅谷切开，间歇性溪流在降雨或融雪之后才有水流。附近一处被称为马泰·伯尔德乌堡垒的地点出土了古代遗物，表明在平原上的村落形成后来的格局之前，这里早已有人居住。

english: The Bay of Plenty sweeps along the northern coast of New Zealand’s North Island. Māori communities had lived around its shores for centuries when James Cook crossed the bay in the Endeavour in 1769. He gave it its English name after seeing cultivated land and settlements along this part of the coast. Māori travelled the waters between the shore and its islands.
simp_chinese: 丰盛湾沿新西兰北岛北岸展开。1769年，詹姆斯·库克乘奋进号横渡此湾时，毛利社群已在其海岸居住数世纪。他望见这一带的耕地与聚落后，为海湾取了英文名称。湾岸与岛屿之间的水面，是当地各社群熟悉的航行空间。

english: Pleszew was already a town when it appeared in a document of Duke Przemysł II in 1283. A private possession of Polish nobles, it lay in Kalisz Voivodeship and grew as a centre of local trade and crafts. A royal privilege of 1493 permitted two weekly markets and two annual fairs; by the early sixteenth century the town had nine craft guilds. In the eighteenth century the road between Warsaw and Dresden brought the Saxon kings Augustus II and Augustus III through Pleszew.
simp_chinese: 1283年普热梅斯瓦夫二世公爵的文书提及普莱谢夫时，这里已经是一座城镇。它是波兰贵族的私有领地，位于卡利什省，逐渐发展为地方贸易和手工业中心。1493年的王室特许允许镇上每周举办两次市场、每年举行两次集市；到十六世纪初，这里已有九个手工业行会。十八世纪，华沙至德累斯顿的道路经过普莱谢夫，萨克森出身的波兰国王奥古斯特二世和奥古斯特三世常沿途经过。

english:
Pleven lies on the northern Bulgarian plain near the Tuchenitsa, a tributary of the Vit. Under Ottoman rule the settlements known as Upper and Lower Plevne grew together; by the late sixteenth century the town had Muslim, Jewish and Bulgarian Christian households. Religious endowments, schools and places of worship formed part of its urban life.

Wars damaged the town and surrounding villages in the late sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. A major flood in 1719 destroyed houses and shops in the lower town. Pleven expanded again after 1800, and by 1825 had a public boys' school, evidence of the town's developing educational institutions.
simp_chinese:
普列文位于保加利亚北部平原、维特河支流图切尼察河附近。奥斯曼统治时期，上、下普列文两个聚落逐渐连成一体；到16世纪末，城镇已有穆斯林、犹太人和保加利亚基督徒家庭。宗教基金、学校和礼拜场所构成城市生活的一部分。

16世纪末至17世纪的战争给城镇及周边村庄造成破坏。1719年大洪水冲毁下城区的住宅和商铺。1800年后普列文再度扩张，1825年城内已有一所公共男校，反映了地方教育机构的发展。

english: The Plieran River runs through the mountainous interior of northern Borneo, in the upper Rajang country. Its forested valley is associated with Penan communities and with Kenyah longhouse settlements of the Usun Apau highlands. The surrounding ridges divide the headwaters of the Rajang, Baram and Kayan, while tributaries of the Plieran thread through the wooded hills.
simp_chinese: 普利兰河流经婆罗洲北部多山的内陆，属于拉让河上游地区。森林覆盖的河谷与本南社群及乌顺阿保高地的肯雅长屋聚落有关。周围山脊分隔着拉让河、巴兰河和加央河的源头，普利兰河的支流则穿行于林木丘陵之间。

english:
Pljevlja lies in a high basin surrounded by wooded mountains, on a road from Dubrovnik through the Balkan interior. In the fifteenth century it was a village in the lands of the Kosača family, whose fortress at Kukanj stood nearby. Under Ottoman rule the growing market became known as Taşlıca, a name referring to its stony ground.

By the sixteenth century Taşlıca had become a judicial centre, and in 1572 the governor of the Sanjak of Herzegovina moved his seat here from Foča. Hüseyin Pasha Boljanić endowed a great domed mosque, while inns served travellers on the road. In 1667 Evliya Çelebi described a prosperous town of Muslim and Christian quarters, where the Breznica stream watered gardens, turned mills and supplied tanneries before joining the Ćehotina.
simp_chinese:
普列夫利亚坐落在森林群山环绕的高地盆地中，一条从杜布罗夫尼克通向巴尔干内陆的道路经过此地。十五世纪，它是科萨查家族领地中的村庄，附近有家族的库卡尼堡垒。奥斯曼统治下，逐渐成长的集市被称为塔什勒贾，名字与多石的地面有关。

到十六世纪，塔什勒贾已成为法官治所。1572年，黑塞哥维那桑贾克的总督将驻地从福查迁至此处。许赛因帕夏·博利亚尼奇捐建了一座宏伟的圆顶清真寺，客栈则接待道路上的旅人。1667年，埃夫利亚·切勒比描述了这座繁荣的城镇：穆斯林与基督徒各有街区，布雷兹尼察溪灌溉花园、驱动磨坊并供应制革作坊，随后汇入切霍蒂纳河。

english:
Płock crowns a high bank of the Vistula, where Cathedral Hill carried the ducal stronghold of Mazovia and the bishops' cathedral. A bishopric had stood here since 1075, and from 1138 the town was the seat of the Mazovian Piast dukes. Prussian and Lithuanian raiders burned it more than once in the thirteenth century; it received town rights under Chełmno law in 1237, and about 1300 a new town was laid out beside the old one.

King Casimir III the Great held the duchy of Płock from 1351 to 1370. He joined the old and new towns, gave them Chełmno law and freedom from rents, and built a brick castle behind a double wall and moat, with the town walled in turn and entered by three gates. His successors Siemowit III and Siemowit IV minted their own coins and ruled as dukes of Mazovia. Siemowit's wife Alexandra, Jogaila's sister, founded the Holy Trinity hospital in 1405. When the last duke, Janusz II, died in 1495, John Albert joined the duchy to the Crown, and Płock became the capital of a voivodeship. After the Peace of Toruń of 1466 it grew rich on the trade from Toruń to Volhynia and on grain floated down the Vistula to Gdańsk; by 1564 it had about 600 houses, nearly as many as Warsaw. A fire in 1616 and the Swedish wars of 1656–57 then wrecked it, and in 1782 only 1,411 people lived there.
simp_chinese:
普沃茨克坐落在维斯瓦河的高岸上，大教堂山上有马佐夫舍公爵的堡垒和主教座堂。1075年起这里设有主教区，自1138年起，是马佐夫舍皮雅斯特公爵的驻地。十三世纪，普鲁士人和立陶宛人不止一次来此劫掠焚烧；城镇于1237年获得按海乌姆诺法的城镇权，约1300年又在旧城旁规划了新城。

1351至1370年，波兰国王卡齐米日三世（大帝）兼任普沃茨克公爵。他把新旧两城合并，授予海乌姆诺法并免除租金，在城堡处建起砖砌城堡，外有双重城墙和壕沟，城镇本身也筑起城墙，设三座城门。继任的西莫维特三世和四世曾自铸钱币，统治马佐夫舍。西莫维特四世的妻子亚历山德拉是雅盖沃之妹，1405年在此创办圣三一医院。1495年末代公爵雅努什二世去世后，扬·奥尔布拉赫特将公国并入王室，普沃茨克成为一个省的首府。1466年《托伦和约》之后，它靠从托伦到沃里尼亚的商路，以及顺维斯瓦河运往格但斯克的粮食致富；到1564年城里约有600座房屋，几乎与华沙相当。1616年的大火和1656至1657年的瑞典战争使其遭受重创，1782年城里只剩1411人。

english: Ploërmel was a fortified town in inland Brittany and a favoured residence of its dukes. Its central position made it a meeting place for Breton political institutions: the parliament and later the Estates of Brittany met here repeatedly between the thirteenth and seventeenth centuries. During the Breton War of Succession, Ploërmel was held for the Montfort cause while nearby Josselin supported Charles of Blois. In 1351, thirty men from each side fought the celebrated Combat of the Thirty on the heath between the two towns. Fairs, markets, courts and religious houses helped Ploërmel prosper into the sixteenth century. The wars of the Catholic League later brought destruction to the Carmelite convent, which was subsequently rebuilt. In 1819 Abbé Jean-Marie de La Mennais founded a congregation of teaching brothers at Ploërmel, adding a new chapter to the town's religious and educational life.
simp_chinese: 普洛埃梅勒是布列塔尼内陆的一座设防城镇，也是历代公爵喜爱的驻地。由于地处中心，布列塔尼的政治机构常在此集会：从十三世纪至十七世纪，议会及后来的布列塔尼三级会议多次在这里召开。布列塔尼继承战争期间，普洛埃梅勒由支持蒙福尔派的一方控制，附近的若斯兰则支持布卢瓦的夏尔。1351年，双方各派三十人在两城之间的荒原上交战，这场“三十人之战”后来广为传颂。集市、集会贸易、法庭和宗教机构使普洛埃梅勒繁荣至十六世纪。此后的天主教同盟战争摧毁了当地加尔默罗会修道院，修道院后来得到重建。1819年，神父让－玛丽·德·拉梅内在此创立从事教学的修会，为城镇的宗教与教育史增添了新篇章。

english: Ploiești lies on the Wallachian plain north of Bucharest, along routes linking Transylvania and the Danube basin. It is recorded as a village in 1503 and became a market town under the Wallachian prince Michael the Brave in 1597. Its position helped it grow as a centre of commerce and crafts during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, eventually overtaking older nearby market towns.
simp_chinese: 普洛耶什蒂位于布加勒斯特以北的瓦拉几亚平原，处在连接特兰西瓦尼亚与多瑙河流域的道路上。1503年文献将它记作村庄，1597年瓦拉几亚君主勇敢的米哈伊使其成为集镇。凭借交通位置，它在17至18世纪发展为商业与手工业中心，逐渐超过附近较早的集镇。

english:
Plön lies on a narrow strip of land between lakes and the river Schwentine. Slavic inhabitants built a stronghold on an island in the lake, and after its destruction in 1139 the counts of Holstein established a castle on the wooded hill above the later town. A market settlement grew beneath it on the road north from Lübeck and received Lübeck town law in 1236.

The partition of the Danish royal family's lands created the duchy of Schleswig-Holstein-Plön in 1622. Duke Joachim Ernest rebuilt the castle as a Renaissance residence between 1633 and 1636, making Plön the seat of his small principality. In 1685 Duke John Adolphus founded a new town for craftsmen. The ducal line ended in 1761, when its lands returned to the Danish crown.
simp_chinese:
普伦坐落在湖泊与施文蒂讷河之间的狭长地带。斯拉夫居民曾在湖中岛屿上建立堡垒；1139年堡垒被毁后，荷尔斯泰因伯爵在后来城镇上方的山丘上设立城堡。吕贝克通往北方的道路旁，城堡下兴起了集市聚落，并于1236年获得吕贝克城市法。

1622年，丹麦王室分封领地产生石勒苏益格—荷尔斯泰因—普伦公国。公爵约阿希姆·恩斯特于1633至1636年将城堡改建为文艺复兴式宫邸，使普伦成为这个小公国的驻地。1685年，公爵约翰·阿道夫为工匠建立新城。1761年公爵支系绝嗣，领地回归丹麦王室。

english:
Płońsk lies on the Płonka in Mazovia. Mentioned in 1155, it was a centre of a castellany in the first half of the fourteenth century. Around 1400 Duke Siemowit IV granted town rights under Chełmno law; merchants and craftspeople contributed to its growth. In the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries trade and crafts developed beside a route linking Lithuania and Prussia.

Płońsk became a Polish royal town and county centre. Wars with Sweden in the mid-seventeenth century damaged it and were followed by decline. After the third partition of the Commonwealth in 1795 it passed to Prussia, then to the Duchy of Warsaw in 1807 and the Russian-ruled Kingdom of Poland in 1815.
simp_chinese:
普翁斯克位于马佐夫舍的普翁卡河畔，1155年见于文献，14世纪前半叶是一个城堡辖区的中心。约1400年，马佐夫舍公爵谢莫维特四世按照海乌姆诺法授予它城市权利，商人和工匠促进了城镇发展。15至16世纪，连接立陶宛与普鲁士的商路经过附近，当地贸易和手工业逐渐兴盛。

普翁斯克后来成为波兰王室城镇及县治。17世纪中叶与瑞典的战争使其受损，此后逐渐衰落。1795年波兰立陶宛联邦第三次瓜分后，它转归普鲁士；1807年并入华沙公国，1815年又进入俄国统治下的波兰王国。

english:
Plovdiv spreads across the Thracian plain along the Maritsa, around a cluster of rocky hills on which Thracians, Romans and Byzantines in turn built their town of Philippopolis. In the fourteenth century it passed between Bulgarian and Byzantine rule several times, and was held by Bulgaria from 1344 to 1371. After the Ottoman victory at Chernomen in 1371 the Bulgarian garrison withdrew and the townspeople, led by their metropolitan, surrendered without a fight.

The Ottomans called it Filibe and made it a sultan's estate. In 1410, during the civil war among Bayezid's sons, Musa Çelebi took the town, tore down its walls and killed or deported many of its people. Rebuilt from the middle of the fifteenth century, it gained the Dzhumaya Mosque to the west of the three hills, a new bridge over the Maritsa, and the imaret that Shahabeddin Pasha founded beside it, around which grew the inns and bazaars of the main market district. Sephardic Jews settled in the sixteenth century, Armenians from Galicia in the seventeenth, and Greeks, Bulgarians, Armenians, Paulicians and Ragusan merchants all lived in town. By the eighteenth century Plovdiv had become the leading economic centre of the Balkan interior, famed for its coarse woollen cloth and other textiles; the Kardzhali bandits of the late 1700s did not reach it, but sent many refugees to it.
simp_chinese:
普罗夫迪夫沿马里查河铺展在色雷斯平原上，围绕几座岩石山丘，色雷斯人、罗马人和拜占庭人先后在此建起腓力波利斯城。十四世纪，它几度在保加利亚与拜占庭之间易手，1344至1371年属于保加利亚。1371年切尔诺曼战役中奥斯曼取胜后，保加利亚守军撤走，市民在都主教带领下不战而降。

奥斯曼人称它为菲利贝，列为苏丹的私产。1410年奥斯曼内战期间，穆萨·切列比攻占城镇，拆毁城墙，杀害或驱逐了许多居民。从十五世纪中叶起重建：三丘以西建起主麻清真寺（朱马亚清真寺），马里查河上架起新桥，沙赫贝丁帕夏在桥边创办了施舍所（伊玛雷特），周围发展出旅店和集市，成为主要的商业区。十六世纪塞法迪犹太人迁来，十七世纪来自加利西亚的亚美尼亚人定居；希腊人、保加利亚人、亚美尼亚人、保罗派教徒和拉古萨商人都住在城里。到十八世纪，普罗夫迪夫已是巴尔干内陆首屈一指的经济中心，以粗呢和其他纺织品闻名；十八世纪末的克尔贾利匪帮没有打到这里，却让许多难民涌入。

english: Plymouth occupies a sheltered harbour on England's southwestern coast, where the rivers Tamar and Plym reach the sea. Its anchorage made it an important base for sailors, merchants and the English navy. From the high ground of Plymouth Hoe ships could be watched as they entered or left the Sound. In 1588 Francis Drake sailed from Plymouth with the English fleet to confront the Spanish Armada. In 1620 the Mayflower departed from the port carrying settlers to North America after earlier delays in their voyage. During the Civil War Plymouth held for Parliament and resisted Royalist attack, its harbour keeping the town supplied by sea.
simp_chinese: 普利茅斯坐落在英格兰西南海岸的一处避风港，泰马河与普利姆河在此入海。锚地使它成为水手、商人和英格兰海军的重要基地。从普利茅斯霍高地可以望见进出海湾的船只。1588年，弗朗西斯·德雷克随英格兰舰队从普利茅斯出航，迎战西班牙无敌舰队。1620年，“五月花”号在航程受阻后从这里启航，载定居者前往北美。英国内战期间，普利茅斯支持议会并抵御王党进攻，港口使城镇能够从海上获得补给。

english: The Plyussa runs through the wooded country north of Pskov before joining the Narva. Ancient settlement sites lie along its banks, and the river gave its name to a truce between Russia and Sweden at the close of the Livonian War. In 1583 Russian and Swedish envoys negotiated the agreement on the Plyussa, temporarily ending their fighting and confirming Swedish control of several fortresses. The river thus lent its name to a settlement of a conflict that had reshaped the Baltic frontier.
simp_chinese: 普柳萨河流经普斯科夫以北的林地，最终汇入纳尔瓦河。河岸散布着古代聚落遗址；在利沃尼亚战争结束之际，这条河还为俄罗斯与瑞典之间的一项停战协定留下了名称。1583年，两国使节在普柳萨河谈判，暂时结束交战并确认瑞典控制数座堡垒。这条河因而与一场重塑波罗的海边疆的战争结局联系在一起。

english:
Plzeň took its place in 1295, when Wenceslaus II moved the town from the old settlement below the Přemyslid hillfort to the confluence of the Mže and the Radbuza, on the road from Prague to Bavaria. Water was plentiful there, and the new town soon became the third largest and most important in Bohemia, after Prague and Kutná Hora. The church of Saint Bartholomew rose in the middle of the square, with friaries by the walls.

When the Hussite wars broke out, the radical priest Václav Koranda held great influence in the town, but in 1420 he and Jan Žižka left for Tábor and Plzeň became the bastion of the Catholic side. It withstood three Hussite sieges, one by Žižka and two by Prokop the Great. From 1467 the Prague chapter sat in Plzeň, and the town was a cradle of Czech printing, its first press working until 1533. Fire destroyed two thirds of the town in 1507. Emperor Rudolf II made Plzeň his capital for nine months in 1599 and 1600, fleeing plague in Prague, and in 1618 the army of the Bohemian estates under Mansfeld took the town.
simp_chinese:
比尔森的城址定于1295年，瓦茨拉夫二世把城镇从普热米斯尔家族山城下的旧聚落迁到姆热河与拉德布扎河的汇流处，位于从布拉格通往巴伐利亚的道路上。那里水源充足，新城很快成为波希米亚继布拉格和库特纳霍拉之后第三大、最重要的城市。圣巴托洛梅教堂矗立在广场中央，城墙边有几座修道院。

胡斯战争爆发之初，激进的神父瓦茨拉夫·科兰达在城中影响极大，1420年他与扬·杰式卡前往塔博尔，比尔森随即成为天主教一方的堡垒。它顶住了胡斯派的三次围攻，一次来自杰式卡，两次来自大普罗科普。1467年起，布拉格教士会设在比尔森，这里也是捷克印刷业的摇篮，最早的印刷所一直运转到1533年。1507年大火烧毁了城市的三分之二。1599至1600年，鲁道夫二世为躲避布拉格的瘟疫，在比尔森住了九个月，使它成为帝国首都。1618年，曼斯费尔德指挥的波希米亚等级军队攻占该城。

english: Pô lies in Kasena country south of the central Mossi plateau. The Kasena live in farming settlements across a savanna of fields, trees and seasonal streams, with communities extending south towards the country of the Nankana. Their distinctive earthen compounds and local institutions reflect longstanding ties to the land. Mossi traditions also recall Pô in connection with Naaba Rawa, an ancestral ruler associated with the origins of the northern kingdom of Zondoma.
simp_chinese: 波奥位于莫西中央高原以南的卡塞纳地区。卡塞纳人的农业聚落分布在田地、树木与季节性溪流交错的草原上，社群向南延伸至南卡纳地区。独具特色的土造院落和地方制度反映出居民与土地的长久联系。莫西传统也提到波奥，将它与北方宗多马王国起源有关的祖先统治者纳巴·拉瓦相联系。

english: The Po carries the waters of northern Italy eastward to the Adriatic, where its branches spread through a low-lying delta. River-borne sediment has continually reshaped this coast. A change in the river's course in the 12th century shifted its main channel northward, and over the following centuries the growing deposits threatened to silt up the Venetian lagoon. Between 1600 and 1604, Venice cut a new channel at Porto Viro to divert the Po southeast. Sediment carried through the new outlet built up fresh land, beginning the formation of the present delta.
simp_chinese: 波河将意大利北部的水流向东送入亚得里亚海，河道在低平的三角洲分成众多支流，携来的泥沙不断改变海岸。12世纪，河道改道，主流向北迁移；此后数百年间，日益增多的沉积物威胁淤塞威尼斯潟湖。1600年至1604年，威尼斯在波尔托维罗开凿新河道，将波河引向东南。泥沙从新出口流出并堆积成陆，开始形成今日的三角洲。

english: Pobeda lies in the mountainous Nera basin of northeastern Yakutia, near the valley of the Kurun and its larger tributary, the Burustakh. These streams belong to the river country east of the Indigirka, where high ridges enclose narrow valleys. The Nera gathers the waters of this cold interior and joins the Indigirka, which continues north through the mountains toward the Arctic Ocean.
simp_chinese: 波别达位于雅库特东北部的涅拉河山区，靠近库伦河谷及其汇入的布鲁斯塔赫河。这些溪流属于因迪吉尔卡河以东的河流地区，高山脊环绕着狭窄河谷。涅拉河汇集寒冷内陆的流水，注入因迪吉尔卡河；后者继续向北穿越山地，流往北冰洋。

english: Pocasse was an Arikara leader whose name is associated with the Missouri River country of the northern Plains. In October 1804 the Lewis and Clark expedition visited Arikara villages above the Grand River and met Pocasse, also recorded as Hay. At his house the visitors received corn, leggings and tobacco, including seeds of two kinds. Arikara communities lived in earth-lodge villages and cultivated crops along the river, while taking part in the trade that connected peoples of the Missouri valley.
simp_chinese: 波卡塞是一位阿里卡拉领袖，他的名字与北方大平原密苏里河一带有关。1804年10月，刘易斯与克拉克探险队到访大河上游的阿里卡拉村庄，遇见了波卡塞；他的名字也被记为“干草”。在他家中，来客得到玉米、护腿和烟草，还有两种烟草的种子。阿里卡拉人住在河畔土屋村庄里，种植作物，也参与连接密苏里河谷各族的贸易。

english: The Pocatalico River winds southwest through the wooded hills of the Allegheny Plateau to meet the Kanawha. Its waters join the larger river on its course toward the Ohio and the Mississippi beyond. The Kanawha valley was home to Indigenous communities for many generations, including villages of the Fort Ancient tradition that survived into the period of European contact. Later, the Shawnee and other peoples used the wider valley as a hunting ground.
simp_chinese: 波卡塔利科河蜿蜒穿过阿勒格尼高原林木覆盖的丘陵，向西南汇入卡诺瓦河。河水加入大河后，继续流向俄亥俄河与更远处的密西西比河。卡诺瓦河谷世代有原住民社群居住，其中包括延续至欧洲人接触时期的古堡文化村落。后来，肖尼人及其他族群利用更广阔的河谷作为猎场。

english: P'och'ŏn lies in the valleys northeast of the Korean capital, on a route toward the interior of Kangwŏn. Formerly called P'oju, it received the name P'och'ŏn in 1413 when the Joseon court appointed a county magistrate. Neighbouring Yŏngp'yŏng lay in the Hant'an River basin, along a road connecting P'och'ŏn with P'yŏnggang and the northern interior.
simp_chinese: 抱川位于朝鲜都城东北方的河谷，是通往江原道内陆的道路之一。此地原称抱州，1413年朝鲜朝廷派驻县监时改名抱川。邻近的永平位于汉滩江流域，沿道路可连接抱川、平康及北方内陆。

english:
Pochep stands on the Sudost River in the wooded country of Severia. It was recorded by the fifteenth century, in a frontier region contested by the rulers of Lithuania and Moscow. After the Truce of Deulino in 1618, the town came under Polish-Lithuanian authority.

Following the mid-seventeenth-century upheavals, Pochep became the centre of a Cossack sotnia, an administrative and military district of the Starodub regiment. Its defences were rebuilt on Peter I's orders in 1708–1709, during the Great Northern War. In 1750 the town was granted to Kyrylo Rozumovsky, the last hetman of the Cossack Hetmanate. These changes placed Pochep within successive systems of frontier rule and Cossack administration.
simp_chinese:
波切普位于谢韦里亚林地中的苏多斯季河畔，十五世纪已有记载。当时这片边地为立陶宛与莫斯科的统治者所争夺；1618年《德乌利诺停战协定》后，城镇归波兰立陶宛联邦管辖。

十七世纪中叶的动荡之后，波切普成为斯塔罗杜布哥萨克团下属一个百人队辖区的中心，兼具行政与军事职能。大北方战争期间，彼得一世下令于1708至1709年重修当地防御工事。1750年，城镇被赐予哥萨克酋长国末任盖特曼基里尔·拉祖莫夫斯基。这些变化反映了边地统治和哥萨克行政体制的更替。

english: In the Lacandon forest of eastern Chiapas stands Bonampak, an ancient Maya city associated with the name Ak’e. Its buildings occupy terraces above a plaza amid the forests of the Usumacinta basin. The Temple of the Paintings contains murals of remarkable detail, showing a royal court, warfare, captives and ceremony. Painted in the late Classic period, they preserve a vivid record of the people and political life of a Maya kingdom.
simp_chinese: 恰帕斯东部拉坎东丛林中坐落着古玛雅城市博南帕克，与阿克这一名称相关。建筑坐落在广场上方的台地，周围是乌苏马辛塔河流域森林。绘画神庙保存着细节丰富的壁画，描绘王廷、战争、俘虏和仪式。这些古典晚期绘画生动记录了玛雅王国的人物与政治生活。

english: Pocologan is a small river flowing south to a sheltered harbour on the Bay of Fundy, west of Point Lepreau. Its name, of Wolastoqey-Passamaquoddy origin, was also given to the bay and the island off its mouth. The powerful tides of Fundy shape the coast, uncovering broad stretches of shore as the water falls. The harbour's name appears in land records from 1785, with several spellings, and the river was recorded under a related form the following year.
simp_chinese: 波科洛甘是一条向南流入芬迪湾避风港的小河，河口位于勒普罗角以西。这个源于沃拉斯托基—帕萨马科迪语的名称，也用于海湾和河口外的岛屿。芬迪湾的强大潮汐塑造着海岸，退潮时大片岸滩显露出来。1785年的土地记录已出现这个港湾的名称，拼写有多种形式；第二年，相关写法又被用于河流。

english: Pocorosa was an Indigenous chief whose territory lay in eastern Panama, near the Caribbean coast and the lands of Comogre. Spanish accounts describe settlements inland and on the coast, the latter supplying fish to those farther from the sea. In December 1513 Vasco Núñez de Balboa entered Pocorosa’s lands on his return from the Pacific. His expedition continued through the neighboring territories toward Santa María del Darién, bringing the first Spanish incursions into this part of the isthmus.
simp_chinese: 波科罗萨是巴拿马东部的一位原住民首领，其领地靠近加勒比海岸和科莫格雷的土地。西班牙记述描述了内陆和沿海的聚落，沿海居民向远离海岸的人们供应鱼。1513年12月，瓦斯科·努涅斯·德·巴尔沃亚从太平洋返回途中进入波科罗萨的领地。他的远征队随后经过相邻地区，返回圣玛丽亚·德尔达连，将西班牙人的早期入侵带到了地峡这一部分。

english: Pocosin lies near the Chowan River and its wooded wetlands. The Chowan forms where the Nottoway and Blackwater meet, then runs south to Albemarle Sound; the Meherrin joins it from the west. Chowanoke and Meherrin communities lived along these waterways. In 1585 Ralph Lane led a party from the English settlement on Roanoke Island up the Chowan and encountered its inhabitants.
simp_chinese: 波科辛靠近乔万河及其森林湿地。诺托韦河与黑水河汇合形成乔万河，河水南流至阿尔伯马尔湾；梅赫林河从西方汇入。乔万诺克人和梅赫林人生活在这些水道沿岸。1585年，罗阿诺克岛英国聚落的拉尔夫·莱恩率队溯乔万河而上，与当地居民相遇。

english: The Pocotaligo is a blackwater river of the Carolina coastal plain, flowing through wooded swamps to the Black River. Fed by smaller creeks and branches, its waters eventually join the Pee Dee system on the way to the Atlantic. The low country around the river includes wet woodland as well as higher ground suitable for cultivation. Its floodplain forms part of a network of streams crossing the inland plain.
simp_chinese: 波科塔利戈河是卡罗来纳沿海平原上的黑水河，穿过森林沼泽汇入布莱克河。众多小溪与支流为它补充水源，河水最终进入皮迪河水系，流向大西洋。河流周围的低地既有湿润林地，也有适宜耕作的较高地面；河漫滩属于横穿内陆平原的水道网络。
